tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (kha)༄༅/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so
(kha)༄༅/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ku mud mdangs 'phrog bde ba chen po'i sku// sku gsum zhal ldan gzung 'dzin spros pas stong*// stong nyid snying rje snye ma rnam par rol// rol pa'i zhabs kyis mtha' gnyis 'joms la 'dud// rgyud kun gleng gzhi dpal ldan sam+bu ṭa'i// dkyil 'khor gtso bo rdor sems rigs bsdus kyi// sgrub thabs rgyud 'grel bla ma'i zhal lung bzhin// 'phags yul mkhas pa'i srol la brten nas bshad// 'dir theg pa chen po'i grong khyer du bgrod par bya ba'i phyir/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya ba la/ gang zag gnas/ dus/ bsam pa/ bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor dang lnga'i dang po ni/ spyir theg pa chen po la zhugs shing khyad par dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer zhing 'jig rten la chags pa med pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ dur khrod dam chu 'gram la sogs pa'am/ chu dang 'bras bu la sogs pa rnyed par sla zhing 'tshe ba med la yid dga' ba'i gnas su'o// gsum pa ni/ rnam rtog nyung zhing lhas byin gyis rlob pas mtshan mo'am thun bzhi'i rim pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral 'dod kyi sems kyis so// lnga pa la sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor/ rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum gyi dang po la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ mdang nub mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la nyal nas/

tho rangs chu la nya 'phar gyi tshul gyis lha'i skur langs te bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na phyi'i khrus bya/ ma grub na nang gi khrus byas nas/ stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis dpal rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer gyi rnam par sna bug g.yas nas rlung phyir rgyu ba'i dus su nam mkhar 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i rnam pa can la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya'o// de nas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ na mo gu ra we bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī badz+ra satwa maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes dang*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ 'khor ba 'jig pa'i me byung nad dang mya ngan tshogs kyi zer 'phros pas// ltung pa chu bur nad 'gyur bzlog dkar 'gro ba'i nyon mongs zhi bya'i phyir// snying rje'i bdud rtsi'i char gyi chus gang byams pa'i chu bo ni// gang 'di kun tu rab 'bab sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la phyag byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas me tog ma la sogs pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa byung nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par bsams la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka badz+ra satwa sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa kun gyi sngon du 'gro zhing rang rang gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tshas mchod yon/ de bzhin du puṣ+pes me tog

dhu pes bdug spos/ ā lo kes mar me/ gan+dhes dri/ nai wi d+yes zhal zas/ shap+das rol mo dang*/ thams cad kyi mjug tu pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa sbyar la mchod cing*/ slar yang snying ga nas gling bu ma la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad spros te de rnams kyis kyang mchod par bsams la/ oṃ bha ga wān sogs dang*/ waṃ se/ wī ṇi/ murdza/ mṛ taṅge/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ zhes pa so so'i mthar/ badz+ri ṇī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas/ bdag gis thog ma med dus nas// log rtog dbang gis sdig bgyis gang*// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed rnams kyi// spyan sngar bshags bgyi slan chad sdom// rgyal dang de yi sras rnams dang*// rang sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom dang*// 'gro ba'i bsod nams ma lus pa// de dag kun la yi rang ngo*// kun 'dod dbugs 'byin gsol mdzad pa'i// sangs rgyas kun la bdag bskul bas// bstan pa nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam par// 'jig rten kun sdig med snang mdzod// 'gro kun sangs rgyas gyur gyi bar// de srid mgon po bzhugs nas ni// nam yang mya ngan mi 'da' bar// thal mo sbyar nas gsol bar 'tshal// lus ngag yid kyi bsod nams ni// bgyis sam bgyid du stsal ba dang*// rjes su yi rang gang ci'ang rung*// des ni 'jig rten kun mkhyen shog /gang dang gang gis 'dul 'gyur ba// de dang de yi skur ston zhing*// sna tshogs gzugs nor lta bu yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi// kun rtog ma lus dag gyur pa// rang rig yang dag ye shes bskyed// lhan cig skyes dga'i ngo bo nyid// dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi// go rim ji bzhin dbang bskur thob// ma log lam la nges gnas pa'i// sras mchog 'khor 'dus dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// yang dag ye shes me bo ches// sgrib pa ma lus spang ba'i phyir// gti mug mun pa bsal ba dang*// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi lam// spyod pa dpag yas gang yin dang*// ma bcos ji bzhin lam gnas la// da ni yang dag gnas par bgyi// zhes pas rgyun bshags bya zhing*/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta ya mi zhes pas bdag phul nas// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims dang*// tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum// so sor bdag gis brtan por bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// de nyid las ni so sor bzung*// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog rnal 'byor gyi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyi ma re re drug byas nas// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang so sor bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// thams cad so sor gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs 'byung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// zhes pas sdom pa bzung nas/ sems can la dmigs pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig

sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig dgra gnyen chags sdang nye ring rnams dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces pas tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de nas phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ ā d+ya nut+pan+ta twā ta sarba dharmā ṇāṃ pra kṛ ti pa ri shud+dha pra bha wa sarba dharmaḥzhes brjod pas sems de'ang rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur bsams pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs te tshogs gnyis bsags pa'o// gnyis pa la bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa gnyis kyi dang po la 'byung bzhi lhun po dang bcas pa bsam pa dang*/ srung 'khor bsgom pa gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis nam mkha'i dbyings su rang gi sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can mchog ma gnyis kyi ngos su g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rtse mo thur du bstan pa 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa chus gang bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ sum̐ hūm̐ las rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi ri'i rgyal po lcog brgyad dang ldan par bsgom mo// gnyis pa la thun mong gi srung 'khor dang thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo nyi shu pa rwa rnams shar dkar/

lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rdo rje nag po gdengs pa 'greng bur gyur pa bar mtshams med pa'i rwa ba dang*/ yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas steng phyogs su rdo rje'i gur/ rwa ba dang gur las 'od 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba'i phyi rol du bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga 'bar bas bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas byin gyis brlab po// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i thun mong gi srung 'khor gyi dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ ser po las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba khog pa stong pa g.yas su 'gro ba mi mngon par mgyogs par 'khor ba/ de'i dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ re re/ de'ang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ steng du ser po/ gzhan rnams sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mtha' byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje/ byang shar du 'dod pa'i rgyal po nag po lcags kyu/ mer dbyug sngon can nag po dbyug pa/ bden bral du stobs po che nag po rtse gsum/ rlung du mi g.yo ba nag po ral gri/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po g.yas gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams zhal mche ba gtsigs shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/

sku sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mtshams kyi khro bo rnams ni rol pa'i sku can/ cung zad sgeg cing yid tsam khros pa/ sku skem zhing grims pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ thams cad kyi sku las rang dang 'dra ba'i khro bo dpag tu med pa 'phro bas bgegs kyi tshogs tshar gcod par mdzad pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams te dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas khro bo bcu gcig srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba spyan drangs mchod nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar sgo ma bzhi'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas te ye shes pa dgug pa'o// lha thams cad kyi mig la sogs pa'i gnas drug tu gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa drug dang gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dgod de skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'o// slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ chu bzhi sngon 'gros mchod cing*/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las hūm̐ mdzad/ shes rab mthar byed 'dod pa'i rgyal po gnod mdzes rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gshin rje'i gshed dbyug sngon can gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed dang stobs po che la 'od dpag med/ bgegs mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa ni dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'o// de nas khro bo'i dbang po rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bdud dang log par 'dren pa rnams dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol du bskrad cing bar du gcod pa rnams las bsrung bar bsams te oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sogs brjod pa ni srung ba'i 'khor lo'o// gsum pa ni/

srung 'khor gyi rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad zhu ba las/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas phyogs kun nas gru gsum pa gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba rtsa ba phra ba thur la zug pa yangs shing rgya che ba de'i nang du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal g.yas khang pa/ sum rim gyi phyi ma la rin po che dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ bar ma la ni rin po che sngo dkar dmar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ nang ma la rin po che dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa gcig dang ldan pa'o// gsum ka'ang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rtsig pa rnams kyi steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwab dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ pha gu'i steng na mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ gzhal yas khang nang ma la ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing*/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres pa dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mdzes par byas pa/ ches mtho zhing yangs pa'i sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor dbus su chos kyi 'khor lo/ steng du gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo mig gyen du lta ba dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i rtsa ba'i phyi rol nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la pi wang ma la sogs pa mchod pa'i lha mo phyogs rer bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug 'dzum pa'i bzhin la mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ lag na rang rang gi mchod rdzas thogs pas dkyil 'khor la mchod par byed pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud dang grwa rnams su zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje rin po ches spras pa/ rgya dang tshad yongs su ma chad pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba las grub cing*/

rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang par bsams la/ de'i phyi rol rdo rje rwa ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum zhing drag pa/ byang du mthug po/ nub tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ dbang ldan du drag tu dgod pa/ mer dbang phyug nags tshal/ bden bral du 'jigs byed mun pa/ rlung du kī li kī la'i sgra sgrogs pa'i dur khrod do// de dag na yod pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shar du shi ri sha/ byang du a shwat+tha/ nub tu kaṅka li/ lhor tsu ta/ dbang ldan du shing chen po/ mer ka rañdza/ bden bral du 'khril shing can/ rlung du ardzuna'o// shing de dag gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba chen po brgyad ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa shin tu brjid pa phyag g.yon na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po rta la zhon pa mi'u thung lta bu gsus pa 'phyang ba g.yon na thod pa dang rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul gyis brgyan pa g.yon na thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa mi'u thung lta bu lto ba 'phyang ba skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa g.yon na thod pa dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa mig gsum pa can g.yon na thod pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ mer me lha dmar ser ra skyes la zhon pa phyag bzhi pa dbyug gu gsum pa dang thod pa dang spyi blugs dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ bden bral du srin po sngon po ro langs la zhon pa mi'u thung gi gzugs can gsus pa 'phyang ba skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa g.yon na thod pa dang ral gri/ rlung du rlung lha sngon po ri dwags la zhon pa zhi ba'i gdong can g.yon na thod pa dang ba dan 'dzin pa/ rang rang gi rgyan gyis brgyan cing thams cad kyi phyag g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul byed pa'o// de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad ni/

shar du sgrogs byed ser po/ byang du 'khor byed ser po/ nub tu 'jigs byed dkar po/ lhor ldog byed sngon po/ dbang ldan du mthug po dkar po/ mer 'gengs byed dmar ser/ bden bral du char 'bebs sngon po/ rlung du gtum po sngon po'o// sprin de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas ser po/ byang du 'jog po dmar po/ nub tu karko ṭa nag po/ lhor pad+ma dmar po/ dbang ldan du pad+ma chen po dkar po/ mer hu lun+ta sngon po/ bden bral du rigs ldan ljang gu/ rlung du dung skyong ser po thams cad kyang sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan zhing*/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bsnams pa smad sbrul 'jug 'khyil pa'o// shing gi rgyal po'i yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba chen po brgyad ni/ shar du lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po rta'i gdong pa can/ nub tu chu srin gyi rgyal po dmar po chu srin gyi gdong pa can/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he'i gdong pa can/ dbang ldan du yi dwags 'dus pa dud kha glang gi gdong pa can/ mer drang srong 'dus pa dmar po ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ bden bral du srin po'i tshogs can sngon po ro langs kyi gdong pa can/ rlung du rlung lha sngon po ri dwags kyi gdong pa can thams cad kyang shing lo'i gseb nas lus phyed tsam 'thon pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ bzhin 'gyur ba skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa'o// gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad/ thugs rje'i chu brgyad/ ye shes kyi me brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ ro mgo bo bcad pa dang*/ dpyangs pa dang*/ bsnyal ba dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ keng rus dang*/ ce spyang dang khwa dang 'ug pa dang bya rgod dang ro langs rnams phaiṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs par byed pa/

gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ gdon dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ sgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor bar bsams la/ de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang pa'i steng 'og thams cad shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba/ dkyil 'khor nang ma'i dbus su lha snam gru bzhi pa'i lte bar rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ 'od zer lnga'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i re mig dgu'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la thod pa'i gdan/ rnam snang dang spyan ma la sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dang thod pa'i gdan re re/ gzhan rnams la pad+ma nyi ma thod pa'i gdan/ dkyil 'khor dang po'i sgo mtshams brgyad/ bar pa'i gnas bdun dang*/ mtshams rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re/ bar pa'i lho sgo'i g.yas phyogs dang*/ dkyil 'khor tha ma'i sgo mtshams brgyad du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re bsam par bya'o// gnyis pa la bskyed rim bsgoms pa des skyo na bzlas pa bya ba la gnyis kyi dang po la/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems so sor rtog pa gang gi'ang ngo bor ma grub cing rtag pa dang rtog pa'i dri ma las grol bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ tsit+ta pra ti bai dh+waṃ ka ro mi zhes brjod nas rang gi sems sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyi ngo bo ā li phrag gnyis pa'i rnam par mthong ste/ de zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang po gru gsum dkar po ā lis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bor bsam/ de'i steng du de gsal bar byed pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ut+pa dā yā mi/ zhes brjod nas rang gi sems dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo kā li phrag gnyis ya ra la wa ḍa dha drug bsnan pa/

gnyis 'gyur gyi rnam par mthong ste zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa gru gsum dkar po 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing kā lis mtshan pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su bsam/ de nas mngon byang brtan par bya'o snyam du bsams la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod nas/ de'i steng du de dag brtan par byed pa hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer dang bcas pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor bsam/ de nas bdag nyid kun tu bzang po'i sems 'di brtan zhing bogs dbyung bar bya'o snyam du bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod nas rdo rje de las rdo rje phra mo nas 'bras tsam dpag tu med pa 'phros phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams rdo rje dbyings der zhugs par gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor bsam/ de nas bdag nyid mngon par byang chub pa yongs su rdzogs pas rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i lha'i skur bskyed par bya'o snyam du bsams la/ oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta thā a haṃ zhes brjod la ye shes thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa sku dang rtsa zhal zla ba ltar dkar zhing chu shel ltar dwangs pa nor bu rin po che ltar 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba/ g.yas zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo zhing*/ g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i shes rab ma la 'khyud cing snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba dang ldan pa/ g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog nag po spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/

de'i g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rjes spras pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna ba la rna cha/ mgul pa la mgul rgyan/ lag pa dang rkang pa la gdu bu drug rked pa la ska rags/sku thams cad la thal chen gyi rgya ste/ phyag rgya drug gis mdzes par byas pa/ sgeg pa dang dpa' ba dang mi sdug pa ste sku'i nyams gsum/ dgod pa dang drag shul dang 'jigs su rung ba ste gsung gi nyams gsum/ snying rje dang rngam dang zhi ba ste thugs kyi nyams gsum ste gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ba/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ dbang bskur zhing mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab pa rnams 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byed par slob dpon bha ba bha dras bshad pas de bzhin byas na'ang shin tu legs so// gnyis pa ni/ de nas yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa'i ngang la āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la aḥs mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams la/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra ma hā rā ga su khan+da da tsa tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ zhes pas yum gyi mkha' dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe ṣa tsa tu rā nan+da dā ya ka kha ga mu kha e ka ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me zhes pas yab kyi gsang gnas byin gyis brlab te/ thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgyu ma bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs nas thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa las thig le sum cu so bdun du gyur/

de las hūm̐ bum̐ ām̐ hrīḥ kham̐ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥtām̐/ a ā/ iṃ īṃ/ um̐ ūm̐/ am̐ āḥ aiṃ am̐ hūm̐ trām̐/ ām̐ mam̐ ham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ auṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i sa bon gyi yi ger gyur/ hūm̐ zhes pas yum gyi mkha' nas thugs kar drangs/ thugs kar yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa las/ dbus kyi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku mdog dang rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yas zhal dkar/ g.yon zhal dmar/ phyag mtshan sngar ltar bskyed nas/ de lta bu'i rang sngags kyis thugs ka nas phyir spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus nas rang la thim pas rang nyid mi bskyod pa rdo rje sems dpar bsams te/ 'on kyang sku mdog ni dkar po las mi 'gyur ro// snying ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sa bon bum̐ yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo bum̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhi ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin par gyur/ rang sngags kyis thugs ka nas phyir spros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus nas shar phyogs kyi re mig gi sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i thod pa'i gdan la rnam par snang mdzad dkar po sogs bskyed la 'khod par bsam/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ am̐ las rin po che am̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin par gyur/ sngags kyis phyir spros/ ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/

mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod nas lhor 'god/ hrīḥdang pad+ma la 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs shing*/ 'og ma gnyis kyis pad+ma dang zhags pa 'dzin par gyur/ sngags kyis phyir spros/ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod nas nub tu 'god/ kham̐ dang ral gri las don yod grub pa ljang gu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis ral gri'am rdo rje dang dril bu/ 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ sngags kyis phyir spros/ phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod nas byang du 'god/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas shing ral pa'i thor cog nag po sogs gtso bo ltar bsam/ bh+rūm̐ dang 'khor lo las sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas bzhi na 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri mda'/ g.yon bzhi na thod pa dril bu zhags pa gzhu 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med pa la bkod nas dbang ldan du 'god/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje las mā ma kī sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bcu gnyis ma/ g.yas pa drug na mda' ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che pad+ma/ g.yon pa drug na gzhu lcags kyu dril bu zhags pa thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa spros/ chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med pa la bkod nas mer 'god/ hrīḥdang pad+ma las gos dkar mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas pa bzhi na mda' pad+ma ral gri rdo rje/ g.yon pa bzhi na gzhu thod pa zhags pa dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba tshad med pa la bkod nas bden bral du 'god/ tām̐ dang ut+pal las sgrol ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas pa bzhi na ut+pal dmar po dang ral gri lcags kyu mda'/ g.yon pa bzhi na 'khor lo zhags pa thod pa gzhu 'dzin pa spros/

rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms tshad med pa la bkod nas rlung du 'god/ oṃ dang mda' las drag shul ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis mda' lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang khu bas bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad chos so so yang dag par rig pa la bkod nas lha snam gyi shar du 'god/ oṃ dang rdo rje las rdo rje gzugs brnyan ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dung*/ g.yon gnyis kyis zhags pa dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad don so so yang dag par rig pa la bkod nas lhor 'god/ iṃ dang ral gri las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyis zhag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa la bkod nas nub tu 'god/ īṃ dang ba dan las rdo rje zhi ba ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis ba dan dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyis ral gri dang sman gyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa la bkod nas byang du 'god/ um̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dkar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ut+pa la/ g.yon gnyis kyi dri chus gang ba'i thod pa dang ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad sbyin pa la bkod nas dbang ldan du 'god/ ūm̐ dang pad+ma las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis pad+ma dang me long*/ g.yon gnyis kyis chang gis gang ba'i thod pa dang dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad snyan par smra ba la bkod nas mer 'god/ oṃ dang mdung thung las sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis mdung dang dung*/

g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad don spyod pa la bkod nas bden bral du 'god/ āḥdang bum̐ pa las sa rdo rje ma ljang skya zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis bum pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyis rdzas kyis gang zhing mi lpags kyis g.yogs pa'i thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad don mthun pa la bkod nas rlung du 'god/ lha mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang ral pa'i thor cog dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod paṇa can/ phyag rgya lngas yang dag par brgyan pa/ gcer bu spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mchog tu bde ba'i gar gyis rol pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// maiṃ dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i nā ga ge sar gyi sdong bu las byams pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i nā ga ge sar dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ rtsa rgyus dang nyon yid sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rtsa dang zag zad kyi mngon shes la bkod nas dkyil 'khor bar ma'i lha snam la shar sgo'i g.yas su 'god/ am̐ dang 'khor lo las sa snying dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ mig dang mig shes sbyangs/ mig gi mngon shes la bkod nas shar sgo'i g.yon du 'god/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje las phyag rdor nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ rna ba dang rna shes sbyangs/ rna ba'i mngon shes la bkod nas lho sgo'i g.yas su 'god/ trām̐ dang rin po che las nam mkha'i snying po ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ sna dang sna shes sbyangs/ sna'i mngon shes la bkod nas lho sgo'i g.yon du 'god/ am̐ dang pad+ma las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ lce dang lce shes sbyangs/ lce'i mngon shes la bkod nas nub sgo'i g.yas su 'god/

mam̐ dang rdo rje las 'jam dpal gur gum gyi mdog can rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ yid kyi skye mched dang yid shes sbyangs/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes la bkod nas nub sgo'i g.yon du 'god/ ham̐ dang sna tshogs rdo rje las sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ lus dang lus shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i lus dang rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes la bkod nas byang sgo'i g.yas su 'god/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje dkar po las kun tu bzang po dkar po rdo rje dkar po dang dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ tshig dang kun gzhi sbyangs/ rdo rje'i tshig dang sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes la bkod nas byang sgo'i g.yon du 'god/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ral pa'i cod paṇa can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis rang gi gdan la bzhugs pa'o// oṃ dang gling bu las gling bu ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis gling bu 'dzin pa spros/ ser sna'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod nas dbang ldan du 'god/ oṃ dang pi wang las pi wang ma ser mo spros/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dri ma sbyangs/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod nas mer 'god/ eṃ dang rnga mu kun+da las mu kun+da ma dmar mo spros/ khong khro'i dri ma sbyangs/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod nas bden bral du 'god/ aiṃ dang rdza rnga las rdza rnga ma ljang gu spros/ le le'o dri ma sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod nas rlung du 'god/ ṛṃ dang me tog las me tog ma dkar mo spros/ rnam g.yeng sbyangs/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin la bkod nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi ma'i dbang du ldan du 'god/ ṝṃ dang spos snod las bdug spos ma dud kha spros/ shes 'chal gyi dri ma sbyangs/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod nas mer 'god/ l̥ṃ dang mar me las mar me ma ser mo spros/ smon lam log pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ smon lam gyi phar phyin la bkod nas bden bral du 'god/ l̥̄ṃ dang dri'i dung chos las dri chab ma dmar mo spros/ thabs la mi mkhas pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ thabs kyi phar phyin la bkod nas rlung du 'god/ phyi nang gi lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ shin tu sgeg cing bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ zur gyis blta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing ral pa'i thor cog can rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i sil sgra 'byin pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i dga' ba la rol pa/ lha'i na bza' sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ rang rang gi gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// dzaḥdang lcags kyu las rdo rje lcags kyu ma sngo bsangs zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na lcags kyu ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum na zhags pa sdigs mdzub dril bu 'dzin pa spros/ ma dad pa dang 'chi bdag gi bdud dang shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ dad pa'i stobs la bkod nas phyi'i shar sgor 'god/ hūm̐ dang zhags pa las rdo rje zhags pa ma dkar ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dkar ser/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ phyag g.yas gsum na zhags pa rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gsum na 'khor lo dril bu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa spros/ le lo dang lha'i bu'i bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs la bkod nas lho sgor 'god/ baṃ dang lcags sgrog las rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ phyag g.yas gsum na lcags sgrog rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gsum na 'khor lo dril bu lcags kyu 'dzin pa spros/

brjed ngas dang phung po'i bdud dang skye ba'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ dran pa'i stobs la bkod nas nub sgor 'god/ hoḥdang dril bu las rdo rje dril bu ma ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug pa rtsa zhal ljang*/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ g.yas gsum na rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri/ g.yon gsum na dril bu lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi rnam par g.yeng ba dang nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang las kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs la bkod nas byang sgor 'god de/ de thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// gsum pa la lnga las/ dang po sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom zhing snod bcud sbyang ba ni/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i thod pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba'i snying gar gdan sngar dang 'dra ba'i steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams la/ oṃ dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang*/ bcud thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs su byas nas tshur 'dus par bsam mo// gnyis pa ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ slar yang 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsams la/

sngar tshogs zhing gi skabs su bstan pa bzhin mchod nas/ rnal 'byor gyi bdag po sems can grol bar mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// sems can thams cad bdag nyid kyi skyes pa gcig par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i gti mug gcod par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// de kho na nyid thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu ston par mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal te bdag rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod nas thugs ka'i sa bon las sgo ma bzhi spros te dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas par bsams la/ oṃ bha ga sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā sha hūm̐ haṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ haṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā be sha ya hoḥhaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing de nyid 'dus pa nas 'byung ba'i phyag rgya rnams bya'o// gsum pa skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni/ de nas lha thams cad kyi mig tu maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna ba gnyis la daṃ las zhes sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar pam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral par oṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar nam̐ las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ mgo bor byams pa/ dbang po thams cad la 'jam dpal bsgom mo// slob dpon bha wa bha dras gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba la rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'du shes la 'od dpag med/ 'du byed la don yod grub pa/ rnam shes la he ru ka

skye mched thams cad la rdo rje sems dpa'/ sa khams la spyan ma/ chu khams la mā ma kī/ me khams la gos dkar mo/ rlung khams la sgrol ma/ nam mkha'i khams la pad+ma 'bar ba mā ma kī lta bu rnams bsgom par bshad pa ni rgyud kyi dag pa dang mthun pas shin tu legs pa yin no// bzhi pa dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la mchod nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur te/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa phyag na bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ byang shar dang shar gyi lha rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ shar lho dang lho'i la rin chen 'byung ldan/ lho nub dang nub kyi la 'od dpag med/ nub byang dang byang gi la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// lnga pa mchod bstod bya zhing bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ de nas 'du byas pa'i mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas sngar ltar mchod la/ stong pa'i snying por phyag 'tshal bstod// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshogs// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa can// dag pa'i de nyid don ston mdzad// bdag med chos las byung ba yi// rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan rnams// mgon po las ni rtag tu byung*// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod// dkon mchog gsum dang theg chen dang*// de bzhin brtan dang 'gro ba dang*// khams gsum po ni 'di dag kun// 'gro ba'i dpa' bor phyag 'tshal bstod// yid bzhin nor bu ltar gyur pa'i// 'gro ba'i 'dod pa'i don bsgrub phyir// dpal ldan bde gshegs bka' bzhin mdzad// sangs rgyas sras por phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod la/

mdun du dngos su bshams pa yod dam med na bsams pas kyang rung ste/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las thod pa dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ sha lnga po re re'i steng du shar du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/ am̐ las rak+ta/ dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ hūm̐ las dri chu ste bdud rtsi lnga lnga dang*/ de rnams kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ la sogs pa'i sa bon lnga bsams la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du ā li bcu drug g.yon skor dang*/ kā li so bzhi g.yas skor du bsam ste/ de dag gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du blta ba/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas de g.yos shing me sbar bas/ thod pa'i nang gi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga po bzhu zhing bskol bas rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog pas/ de gnyis nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung bas/ rdzas thams cad zhu nas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsams nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang brjod cing sku gsung thugs kyi lha'i ngo bor bsams la/ ha ho hrīḥyang yang brjod cing g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas dkrugs/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rang gi lce rtse la myangs te lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad do// gnyis pa ni des skyo bar gyur pa dang bzlas pa bya ba'i phyir byin gyis brlabs pa'i bgrang phreng bzung ste/ gtso bo'i sngags zlos pa'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ yum gyi zhal nas 'thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste/ sngar bzhin du steng 'og tu 'khor bar dmigs pa'am/ yang thugs ka'i sa bon la bskor bar dmigs nas bzlas pa'i 'od zer gang la phog pa de bdag gi dbang du 'gyur zhing phrin las bskul bar bsgom/ sngags kyi 'od zer ni zhi ba la dkar po la sogs pa rang rang gi las dang mthun par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su ga ham̐ swā hā/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i snying po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nā ya swā hā/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi'o// oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa bh+yo swā hā/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi'o// oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥswā hā/ 'od dpag med kyi'o// oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sha ru dhi ra an+t+ra mā lā ba lam+bi na gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzam̐ ga sarbam̐ wā ta/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kar+ḍahaya ā kar+ḍahaya/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ/ k+ṣa māṃ k+ṣa māṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ tsi li tsi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ don yod grub pa'i 'o// oṃ khaṃ lam̐ ham̐ swā hā/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ne swā hā/ spyan gyi snying po dang nye snying ngo*// oṃ gh+ri swā hā/

oṃ shaṃ ka re shān+tiṃ ka re ghu ṭa ghu ṭa ghū ṭi ni/ gha ṭa ya gha ṭa ya/ ghu ṭa ya ghu ṭi ni swā hā/ mā ma kī'i snying po dang nye snying ngo*// oṃ ka ṭe be ka ṭe ni ka ṭi ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe swā hā/ gos dkar mo'i 'o// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ sgrol ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.am̐ ham̐ swā hā/ drag mo'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.ām̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje gzugs brnyan ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.i haṃ swā hā/ rdo rje 'dod chags ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.īṃ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje zhi ba ma'i'o// oṃ āḥ.um̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma'i 'o// oṃ aḥ.ūm̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.am̐ ham̐ swā hā/ sgra rdo rje ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.āḥhām̐ swā hā/ sa rdo rje ma'i ste dkyil 'khor nang ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥmaiṃ ham̐ swā hā/ byams pa'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.am̐ ham̐ swā hā/ sa snying gi'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ham̐ swā hā/ phyag rdor gyi'o// oṃ āḥtrām̐ ham̐ swā hā/ nam snying gi'o// oṃ āḥ.ām̐ ham̐ swā hā/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi'o// oṃ ā mam̐ hām̐ swā hā/ 'jam dpal gyi'o// oṃ āḥham̐ ham̐ swā hā/ sgrib sel gyi'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ham̐ swā hā/ kun tu bzang po'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.oṃ ham̐ swā hā/ gling bu ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.oṃ ham̐ swā hā/ pi wang ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.eṃ ham̐ swā hā/ mu kun+da ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥ.aiṃ ham̐ swā hā/ rdza rnga ma'i ste dkyil 'khor bar ma'i lha rnams kyi'o// oṃ āḥṛṃ swā hā/ me tog ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥṛṃ swā hā/ bdug pa ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥl̥ṃ swā hā/ mar me ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥl̥̄ṃ swā hā/ dri chab ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥbadz+ra aṅku sha dza ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā sha hūm̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje zhags pa ma'i 'o/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥham̐ swā hā/

rdo rje dril bu ma'i ste dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha rnams kyi'o// 'di dag kyang gtso bo la ci tsam bzlas pa'i bcu cha 'khor rnams la bzla ba ni bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rtsa yi mdzes spyi las byung ba// de ni rdul bral rab tu grags// zhes bya ba'i shugs las tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang po 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa ston te/ bskyed rim gyi lha ma bsdus bar lus kyi gnad tsog pur 'dug lus sgrim lhod ran par bya/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la 'khyud/ mgo mi mtho mi dma' ran par byas la/ sems kyi gnad lte ba sprul pa'i dbus su aṃ kha dog dmar po mtshal gyi shad lta bu shin tu phra ba cig bsam/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su hūm̐ sngo skya yungs 'bru tsam cig bsgom/ gnyis ka'ang 'dab ma yi ge bkod pa dang bral bar bya'o// de gnyis rtsa dbu ma shin tu phra ba gcig gis zung sbrel bar dmigs/ de ltar gsal btab pa dang shes pa lte ba'i aṃ la drag tu gtad te steng rlung ran tshad mnan zhing aṃ la bstim/ ma bde na ci bder gtang*/ de nas drag tu bskul zhing yang nas yang du bsgoms pas thog mar lte ba'i gnas su drod 'byung*/ de nas aṃ gi me shin tu phra ba dbu ma nas 'bar bas snying ga'i hūm̐ bzhu ste/ byang sems shin tu cha phra ba aṃ gi gnas su dbab/ gal te dbab par ma nus na aṃ la res 'jog tu gtad de/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis bsgoms pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga dang yon tan brgyad ci lta ba bzhin du 'byung ba'i ye shes gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur la/ de yang sa bcu pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// gsum pa thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la dgu'i dang po lha bsdu ba ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bsam pa la phog

de thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te srung ba'i 'khor lor bsdu/ de dur khrod brgyad la bsdu/ de gzhal yas khang phyi ma la/ de bar pa la/ de nang ma la bsdu/ de drag mo sogs brgyad la/ de rnams rang rang gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la bsdu/ de bzhi dbus kyi gtso bo la bsdus nas/ rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// gnyis pa dag pa dran pa ni rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched rnams lha de dang de'i rang bzhin du dmigs la/ gzugs ni sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad// tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma ste// 'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug /de bzhin 'du byed rdo rje rgyal// rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa// kun gyi ngo bo he ru ka /mig la gti mug rdo rjer bshad// zhe sdang rdo rje mngon thos pa// phrag dog rdo rje de bzhin sna// kha ni 'dod chags rdo rjer brjod// reg la ser sna rdo rje ma// khams dang skye mched thams cad ni// dam pa'i dbang phyug he ru ka /sa yi khams ni ltung byed ma// chu khams gsod par byed mar brjod// me yi khams ni 'gugs byed ma// de bzhin rlung ni gar dbang phyug /nam mkha'i khams su brjod pa ni// pad+ma 'bar ba 'khyil ba nyid// 'di ltar lus can rnams kyi lus// phung po la sogs lha bdag nyid// bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin las// nyon mongs la sogs nges skyes pa// bskyed pa'i cha la legs gnas pas// srid dang mya ngan 'das pa thob// zhes pa'i don dran par bya'o// gsum pa mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor ni tshogs gnyis snye mar shes par bya la/ gtor ma la 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa gnyis kyi dang po ni kha zas dku bag can ma 'dres pa'i gtor ma nang mchod la sogs pas sbyangs te sngar bdud rtsi myangs pa'i skabs ltar bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na mdun du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum le tshe dgu dang bcas pa'i le tshe dbus ma la rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor sa bon tsam las yan lag bzhi rdzogs mdor bsdus pas bskyed/

mdun bskyed dang 'brel na skad cig gis gsal btab la/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan pa de las 'od byung bas gtor ma drang zhing gsol bar bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phyes nas/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka badz+ra satwa bum̐ ām̐ hrīḥkham̐/ bhūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥhām̐/ am̐ ām̐/ iṃ īṃ/ um̐ ūm̐/ am̐ aḥ maiṃ am̐ hūm̐ trāṃ/ ām̐ mam̐ ham̐ hūm̐/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa pa ri wā ra i dam̐ ba liṃ bhuñdza/ dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhūp+pa/ mām̐ sa/ piṃ ga am+bha/ sap+pa/ kadz+dza/ sā dā/ khan+ti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ ga da/ oṃ a kā ro mu kham̐ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun brjod pas phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag cing gos pa med// rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po ste// mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod cing*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab ste 'das pa'i gtor ma'o// gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni 'dod don snye mar shes par bya'o// bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/

kha zas rnams gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab pa'am/ bsdu na yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i snying gar bla ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor/ lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar ba'i khrod na zhing skyong gi tshogs 'jig rten pa'i mgron bsam gyis mi khyab pa dmigs te/ rang gi kha thab khung*/ lag pa dgang blugs/ kha zas rnams bsreg rdzas su bsams nas/ thog mar phud las lha bshos dang chang bu la sogs pa thun mong gi lugs bzhin bya ste/ kha zas rnams la chags zhen med par lha mchod pa'i bsam pas tshim zhing ran par bza'/ zos tshar ba dang lhag ma rnams mdun du bzhag ste/ yod na ma da na cung zad 'thungs te/ lag pa gnyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas pa'i nang nas ngag tu bh+rūm̐ zhes pa'am/ yang na phreṃ zhes pa dang bstun nas gtor ma la kha phrus btab ste yi ge gsum dang a kā ro'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba lin+ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod pas lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad tshim par bsams la dor ro// lnga pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnyid khar sngar ma bsdus na lha bsdu ba'i skabs su bstan pa bzhin snod bcud nas gtso bo yab yum gyi bar bsdus la/ gtso bo yab yum yang yum yab la/ yab snying ga'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ nā da yang mi dmigs par byas la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la nyal bar bya'o// drug pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ ldang ba'i tshe stong pa'i ngang las skad cig tsam gyis chu las nya 'phar gyi tshul du rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi skur langs nas de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros shing hūm̐ zhes brjod pas snod bcud thams cad lha dang dkyil 'khor du dmigs nas/ rang gzugs sku dang snod bcud phrin las 'jug pa'i yul du bsams la ldang ngo*// bdun pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/

dbang bskur gyi lha'i skabs su bstan pa ltar rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros te mdun gyi nam mkhar dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs nas dbang bzhi thob pa'i bar ci lta ba bzhin du bya la/ 'on kyang rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa ni med do// brgyad pa rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ni nye bar mi mkho bas ma bshad do// dgu pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni thun mtshams kyi skabs su rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis phung po lnga sangs rgyas lnga/ khams lnga lha mo lnga/ nang gi skye mched drug gti mug rdo rje la sogs pa drug phyi'i yul drug gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa'i lha mo drug tu shes par bya ste/ lha la lha thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod do// de ltar na rgyud snga phyi gnyis bsdebs te/ lha so bdun sgo sum sbrag can te rgyas pa dang*/ byang sems brgyad spangs te sgo rkyang du bya ba brtag pa 'og ma kho na'i dgongs pa ste dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gnyis yin la/ slob dpon a bha yas man ngag gi snye mar/ sgo rkyang la byang sems brgyad dor ba ste/ bzhad ma/ sgeg mo/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me long ma/ ro ma/ reg ma/ chos ma rnams bsnan pa'i lha so bdun byas pa rang lugs dang*/ de dag spangs te byang sems brgyad bsnan pa gzhan lugs te lha so bdun ma lugs gnyis dang*/ de dag spangs pa'i nyer dgu ma ste lugs gsum bshad cing*/ slob dpon bha ba bha dras rigs lnga yum bzhi drag shul ma sogs brgyad/ sgeg phreng glu gar bzhi/ gling bu pi wang mu kun+da rdza rnga bzhi sgo ma bzhi ste lha sum cu so gsum gyi dkyil 'khor yang bshad pas/ de dag gang yang rung ba'i rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar bar ma chad par nyams su blang zhing dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa la brten nas spyod pa dang nye ba'i rgyus mtshams sbyar te/ zung 'jug rdo rje dbyings kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur ba ni rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyi bka'o//

//dpal ldan kha sbyor rgyud 'grel rgya mtsho las// ting 'dzin rnam gsum sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor// kun dga' bzang po'i blo yi ded dpon gyis// legs par blangs te tshig gi phreng bar bsdebs// lhag bsam dang blo'i rgyal mtshan rtser bzhag nas// rtse gcig yid kyis gus par gsol ba btab na// sku gnyis dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i 'bras stsol zhing*// gzhan phan 'od kyis mi shes mun sel 'gyur// 'di bris dge ba yid bzhin nor bu des// don gnyer blo gros phongs pa'i skyon bsal nas// rgyud sde'i legs bshad nor gyis phyug pa dang*// rnam mkhyen chos kyi rgyal srid thob par shog /dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni/ blo gros kyi lus rdzogs shing rnam dpyod kyi bzhin ras gsal ba slob dpon sbyin pa grags kyi thog par bskul ba dang*/ blo gsal mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug cing brtson 'grus rnam par dag pas rgyud sde rin po che 'di nyid la thos bsam byed pa mdo khams stod pa kun dga' gzhon nus nan gyis gsol ba btab cing yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos rgyud dang rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo'i 'grel chen gzhir byas shing*/ rgyud phyi ma dang slob dpon bha ba bha dra'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel pa gnyis dpang por byas nas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug ḍom+bi he ru ka'i rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i srol dang mthun par/ dga' ba'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga la dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'o// i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu// // ༄// dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'dod don snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༈ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'dod don snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// e waṃ gnyis med mi 'gyur bde ba che// khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' la btud nas// bar chad zhi dang tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir// gtor ma'i cho ga 'dod don snye ma bshad// 'dir ji skad du bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi rdo rje slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa dpal sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi cho ga nyams su len pa'i tshe/ thog ma dang bar dang tha ma gsum du gtor ma sbyin par gsungs pas de'i cho ga bshad na/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi cho ga dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ ji ltar rigs pa'i gnas yid du 'ong bar/ ba'i rnam lnga la sogs pas skyang nul legs par byas la/ der tsan+dan dkar pos chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa byug de'i dbus su khru gang gi tshad du tsan+dan dmar po'am gur gum la sogs pa dri dmar pos dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bya/ de la thig bzhi btab pas le tshe dgur bya/ de'i le tshe dbus ma che bar byas pa la/ rang gang byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs kyi me tog gi tshom bu dgod cing snying po tshig tsam gyis bskyed pa skabs 'dir bya/ de'i phyi rol gyi le tshe brgyad la zhing skyong brgyad chung ma so gnyis dang bcas pa'i me tog gi tshom bu dgod pas le tshe re re la dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu lnga lnga bya'o// de nas rang gi g.yon phyogs nas mchod yon sogs chu bzhi dang*/ g.yas nas me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod dang*/ sha skam/ khrag nya sha/ til phye/ bag phye/ 'bras chan/ sran chen/ byis kyu/ btsong sgog la sogs pa rdzas sna tshogs dang khyad par bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i gtor ma/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am ma 'byor na brgyad dam/

de'ang ma 'byor na che ba gcig bshams la/ ba dan la sogs pas brgyan/ de nas slob dpon rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal brtan pos bgegs gdug pa can rnams bskrad pa'i phyir sgo'i slob dpon rnams dang lhan cig gos gsar pa gyon/ rus pa'i rgyan dang*/ bcos ma'i stag lpags dang*/ tshangs skud dang bcas pas brgyan cing*/ rdo rje dril bu thogs nas gar gyi bkod pa dang bcas pas rdo rje'i stabs kyis khri'u la sogs pa'i stegs la 'dug par bya'o// gnyis pa ni mchod pa rnams la bsang chu gtor zhing*/ las thams cad pas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas so sor bskyed nas zhing skyong ba brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod la so so'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab bo// de bzhin du gtor ma yang chang la sogs pas sbyangs te sgrub thabs las bshad pa ltar/ bdud rtsir byin gyis rlob pa'i cho gas zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mgron gyi maṇ+ḍal/ las thams cad pa bzlas shing bsang chu gtor bas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba le tshe dgu dang bcas pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum bcu so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ de bzhin du lha bcu bdun gyi bdag nyid kye rdo rje la sogs pa gang bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor bsam mo// de'i phyi rol gyi le tshe brgyad la paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa re re bsams la/ byang shar gyi pad+ma'i lte bar drag po nag po sku mdog skya nag khyu mchog la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/

phyag dang po gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba/ phyag 'os ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ 'og ma rnams kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul yin zhing*/ 'og ma gnyis rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa yin par shes par bya'o// de'i 'dab ma bzhi la shar du gdol pa mo/ byang du 'jigs pa'i gzugs dang*/ nub tu dka' bzlog ma dang*/ lhor mi sdug ma bzhis bskor ba'o// shar gyi pad+ma'i lte bar drag po chen po mdog ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin zhing g.yon pas glang po che la bsnun pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du rgyal ma dang*/ byang du rnam rgyal ma dang*/ nub tu mi thub ma dang*/ lhor gzhan gyis mi thub ma bzhis bskor ba'o// shar lho'i pad+ma'i lte bar lha sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ g.yas pas dgang gzar dang dbyug gu/ g.yon pas ba dan dang ghun+dhe 'dzin pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du nag mo bzang mo dang*/ byang du nag po chen mo dang*/ nub tu nag sbom ma dang*/ lhor rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug ma bzhis bskor ba'o// lho'i pad+ma'i lte bar nag po ma he la zhon pa mdog nag po/ g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon mdung 'dzin pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la zla ba mo dang*/ 'jigs pa mo dang*/ gdug pa can dang*/ lam pa kī bzhis bskor ba'o// bden bral gyi pad+ma'i lte bar/ gtsigs pa nag po ro langs la zhon pa mdog nag po g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon phub 'dzin pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dbang phyug ma dang*/ g.yo ldan ma dang*/ mar me ma dang*/ 'jibs byed ma bzhis bskor ba'o// nub kyi pad+ma'i lte bar/ mi sdug dkar po chu srin la zhon pa/ g.yas gdengs ka bdun gyis mtshan pa'i zhags pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la 'jigs pa'i gzugs dang*/ gzugs chen mo dang*/ mche ba'i gzugs dang*/ gtsigs pa ma bzhis bskor ba'o// rlung gi pad+ma'i lte bar/

dga' las 'das ljang gu ri dwags la zhon pa/ g.yas pas rlung gis bskyod pa'i ras 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la thod pa'i phreng ba ma dang*/ 'phyang ba dang*/ mthu chen ma dang*/ lag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhis bskor ba'o// byang gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ log 'dren ser po mi la zhon pa/ g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon dbyug to 'dzin pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la lag na dgra s+t+wa dang*/ lag na ral gri dang*/ rdo rje lag ma dang*/ gzhu lag ma bzhis bskor ba'o// gtso bo rnams ni rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams rang rang gi gtso bo'i sku mdog dang mtshungs shing*/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs thogs shing*/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa las/ khyad par lag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la sogs pa lnga ni rang ming gi lag cha 'dzin par bsam mo// de nas lag pa g.yon gtor ma 'dzin pa'am/ yang na gtor ma 'dzin pa'i tshul byas la/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i gung mdzub dpung pa'i thad dkar 'phyar zhing*/ rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan/ spyi bor phaṭa kyi yi ge bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas shing gcig dang dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas bcu gcig nas zhing skyong ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*// ri bo dang ni 'bab chu dang*// khyim dang grong gi ngos dang ni// zhing dang grong ni stongs pa dang*// sems can snod dang thang son dang*// chu la yang ni khyad par du'o// drag po nag po drag po che// lha sbyin mnyam du bstan pa dang*// nag po gtsigs pa 'jigs su rung*// dga' las 'das dang log 'dren ma// gdol pa mo dang 'jigs pa'i gzugs// lha mo dka' bzlog mi sdug ma// rgyal ma dang ni rnam rgyal nyid// mi thub ma dang gzhan mi thub// nag mo bzang mo nag mo che// nag sbom rnal 'byor ma'i dbang mo// zla ba mo dang 'jigs pa mo// gdug pa can dang laṃ pa ki

/sum cu rtsa gsum dbang phyug ma// g.yo ldan mar me 'jibs byed ma// grong du gnas pa rnal 'byor ma// 'jigs pa'i gzugs dang gzugs chen ma// mche ba'i gzugs dang gtsigs pa nyid// thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba can// mthu chen lag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lag na dgra s+t+wa ral gri dang*// rdo rje'i lag ma gzhu yi lag /mkha' 'gro ma yi de nyid che// las rnams rjes su grub par byed// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal mo che// de bzhin rdo rje'i dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen las// skyon med rnal 'byor 'byin pa mo// rdo rje dbang phyug bka' lung gis// thams cad gnas nas thams cad dgug /oṃ ka ka kā dha na/ ba ba ban+dha na/ kha kha khā dha na/ sarba duṣ+ṭa naṃ ha na ha na gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a mu ka s+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ a mu ka s+ya zhes pa rang don yin nam ma nges pa dang*/ gzhan don yin na de dag gi ming gzhug par bya'o// de nas pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ zhes pas gdan 'bul/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar sgo ma bzhis sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bcing mnyes dbang du byas nas/ gnas gsum yang byin gyis brlabs la dbang bskur te thams cad la mi bskyod pa'i rgyas gdab bo// de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams dpag tu med par mos la/ mdun du bzed zhal rnams bzhag ste/ ngag tu/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas pa 'bul// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ru dra ma hā ru dra zhes pa nas badz+ra haste dha nu hasta zhes pa'i bar gtor sngags ltar brjod pa'i rjes la/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su me tog sogs sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad dang*/

sngags rnams kyi mjug tu puṣ+pe la sogs pa sbyar te rol mo'i bar du dbul/ de ltar mchod yon la sogs pa rnams bzed zhal dang*/ me tog la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi gnas su dbul lo// de nas mgron rnams kyi ljags la rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan par bsams la/ de las 'od byung bas gtor ma drangs shing gsol bar bsgoms ste/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ e ka bṛk+ṣa sh+ma shā na/ sarba te kan+da re/ gṛ he gra ma pā ra she k+ṣe tra gra ma shū n+ya ga te/ satwa bhañdza s+thā la ga te/ mā ta ga na be she ṣe tā/ kṛṣ+ṇa ru dra ma hā ru dra/ de ba dat+ta sa ma shrī ta/ kṛṣ+ṇa ā ka rā la bi bhat+sa ā nan+dā tī ta/ bi nā ya kā/ tsa muṇ+ḍa gho rī rū pī/ si bhat+sa u ma de bī tsa ma tā ra/ dza ya tsa bi dza ya tsa/ a dzi tā a pa rā dzi tā/ bha drā kā lī ma hā kā lī/ s+thū la kā lī yo gī in+d+rā/ tsan+d+rī gho rī/ duṣ+ṭā tsa laṃ pa kī tri

trā ya triṃ sha tī shwa rī/ 'di dag 'dra/ da she shwa rī/ kaṃ po dza dī ba tsuṃ bi n+yā/ gra me wa sa na yo gi nī/ gho ra rū pī ma hā rū pā+e/ daṃṣ+ṭ+ra rū pa ka rā li nī/ ka pā la mā la mā li n+yā/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga aṅgi nī ma hā dhā kā/ khaḍ+ga pa ra shu hasta ya/ badz+ra hasta ya dha nu haste/ ma hā su kha a dz+nyā i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dham+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lnga brjod pas mgron rnams mnyes par bsam mo// de nas snod la sogs par grub na snyim pas gzhal zhing dbul/ ma grub na khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo lu gu rgyud du byas la oṃ tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang se gol lan gsum gtogs so// de nas nyer spyod bsdus pa dang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rdo rje can gyi rnam 'phrul las// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas rnams su// 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul 'dzin pa'i// zhing skyong ma mo 'khor bcas dang*// lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi= gnod sbyin= srin po= 'byung po'i= yi dwags= sha za'i= smyo byed= brjed byed= mkha' 'gro'i= ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams// dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa// gdug pa 'dul phyir nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol// rnal 'byor 'di zhes bya ba 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig

/dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams rgyas shing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las gzhol/ rdo rje 'chang gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams bsrung zhing skyong bar bka' bsgo zhing zhal gyis bzhes pa'i zhing skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la mthu dang nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sems can thams cad la bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba/ khyad par du yang rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don du dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po bri ba dang*/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon ma rnams dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas dngos grub blang*/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// sogs brjod la nongs pa bzod par gsol/ g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ba sa la bzhag nas le tshe dbus ma'i 'das pa'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ oṃ pad+ma tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus la/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ru dra sogs kyi sngags brjod cing mchod yon bsgreng la sngar gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa gats+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing*/ srin lag dang mthe bong brdab pa'i se gol lan gsum gtogs pas zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gshegs su gsol lo// de yang dang por sa chog dang*/

sngon 'gro'i gtor ma rnams kyi dus su dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod par bsams la/ phyi rol pa'i gtor ma'i skabs su ni/ rang rang gi phyogs su song la so sor gtor ma 'bul bas gshegs gsol mi byed pa'am/ khang pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi rang gnas su gshegs su gsol ba gang bde bya zhing*/ mjug dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i gtor ma'i tshe shing gcig dang dur khrod la sogs pa rang rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol ba ni rgyud 'grel las gsungs pas yang dag pa'i don du shes par bya'o// de nas dri'i dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing mchod rdzas dman pa rnams dang gtor ma rnams rol mo dang bcas pas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdus nas rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis bdag dang slob ma rnams bsrung bar bya'o// gang gi tshe dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel bar mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal mchod pa dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa byed pa de'i tshe gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa nas brtsams te phrin las gzhol pa'i bar bya'i/ gzhan gong 'og gi cho ga rnams bya mi dgos la sngon 'gro dang phyi rol pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i gtor ma rnams la ni ji skad bshad pa bzhin cho ga thams cad rdzogs par bya'o// lhag bsam dag pa'i mkha' dbyings dkyil 'khor du// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i sprin tshogs rab bsdus nas// rnam dag cho ga'i 'brug sgra 'di bsgrags pas// mchod yul rma bya'i tshogs kun dgyes par mdzod// ces pa 'di yang rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun ye shes zhabs kyi gsung gi tsha zer las skyes pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang po la/ rgyud 'di don du gnyer zhing blo gros phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ mdo stod pa kun dga' gzhon nus gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rgyud 'grel chen po'i dgongs pa ci lta ba bzhin du dpal sa skya'i chos grwar sbyar ba'o//

//i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu// ༄// dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis chu gter dbus su rab brjid cing*// dbang bzhi'i bang rim phreng bas nyer mdzes pa// rim gnyis nyi zla'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba// sku bzhi'i lhun po dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin chen lta bu yis// dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor dang*// sras bcas rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams mnyes bya'i phyir// mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis snye ma bri// rdo rje theg par zhugs pa rnams// tshogs gnyis rgya chen spel 'dod pas// mchod pa bsham zhing byin gyis brlab// maṇ+ḍal bsgrub cing bzhi rdzogs bya// phyag 'tshal mchod pa dbul ba dang*// rgyun bshags sdom pa bzung ba dang*// slar yang mchod bstod dngos grub blang*// bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol// mchod pa phyi nang yid las byung*// gsang dang de nyid bla na med// bstod pa bkra shis glu blang bya// phyi la chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga// rol mo gos zung 'bras bu'o// yid la thun mong khyad par dang*// rin chen nye ba'i rin chen bdun// bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dod yon lnga// zhes bya'o// de la dang po mchod pa bsham pa ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su phyag dar skyang nul legs par byas la/ der khru gsum la sogs pa'i tshad dang ldan pa'i maṇ+ḍal byi dor byas la ba'i rnam pa lngas zlum por byug de'i g.yas phyogs nas brtsams te/ mchod yon la sogs pa'i snod gser dngul lam/ ma 'byor na rdo'am shing ngam zangs la sogs pa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbyibs sum cha lte ba la yod pa byas pa'am/

nya phyis sam dung phor la sogs pa'ang rung ste/ de dag gi nang du chu dang dri bzang sbyar ba zhabs bsil dang*/ chu dang 'o mar sbyar ba zhal bsil dang*/ 'thor 'thung gi chu gtsang ma ku sha dang bcas pa dang*/ chu dang me tog dkar po sbyar ba'i mchod yon dang*/ g.yon du me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ dri dang*/ zhal zas rnams rim pa bzhin bzhag gzhan yang rol mo dang gos zung dang*/ 'bras bu la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa rnams lha grangs dang mnyam par bsham/ mdun du bzed zhal gsum dang*/ rang gi g.yon du thod pa'i nang du chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa dang*/ rdo rje g.yas dang dril bu g.yon du bzhag rdo rje'i g.yas su dung chos la sogs pa'i snod du dri bzang po'i chu ku sha'i chun po dang bcas pa bzhag go /gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu de oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las shaṃ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i dung phor mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu rdzas rnams kyi dri ma dang nyes skyon thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ gtso bo'i sngags nyer gcig dang las thams cad pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas ku shas bsang chu blangs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa dang mchod pa thams cad la gtor zhing*/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho sogs brjod cing*/ sems kyis snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis mchod pa la gnod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad bskrad pa bsgoms pas bsang*/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes mchod pa'i yo byad de rnams rang bzhin gyis stong par bsams pas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil la sogs pa rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bsam pas bskyed/

de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur sbyar ba'i gung mo gnyis rtse mo sbyar te brkyangs pa ni mchod yon gyi phyag rgya yin la/ de nyid lan bzhi'i bar du bya zhing*/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ gis zhabs bsil dang*/ oṃ ni wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ gis zhal bsil dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ gis 'thor 'thung dang*/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ gyis mchod yon dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi snyim pa gyen du 'thor ba ltar byed pa me tog gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog lag pa gnyis khu tshur kha thur du bstan pa bdug pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe ā hūm̐ gis bdug spos dang*/ khu tshur gnyis gshibs te mthe bong bsgrengs pa mar me'i phyag rgya dang*/ ā lo kes mar me/ thal mo kha phyir bstan nas gyen du brkyang ba dri'i phyag rgya dang*/ gan+dhes dri/ thal mo gnyis kha gyen du bstan pa gshibs la mthe bong gnyis cung zad bskyod pa lha bshos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ nai wi tes zhal zas/ shab+das rol mo rnams byin gyis brlab/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pas dpag tu med par spro'o// gsum pa maṇ+ḍal bsgrub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bsang chus gtor zhing*/ der tsan+dan dkar pos chos 'byung gru gsum pa ci ltar rigs pa byas pa'i dbus su/ khru gang gi tshad tsam gyi tsan+dan dmar po dang gur gum la sogs pa'i dri dmar pos dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bya/ de la zlum por bskor te thig bzhi btab nas le tshe dgur byas pa'i dbus ma la bsang chus gtor/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo nyi shu pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i bar du bskyed/ de nas lag pa bkrus te/ g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis me tog cung zad bzung*/

hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur par bsgoms te/ bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzang po'i chu dang bcas pas/ sa phyogs der g.yas skor du khye ma med par byug cing*/ dbus nas dbang ldan gyi mtshams su 'thon te/ de nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis gru bzhir byug cing*/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ yang mtha' ma legs par bskor zhing byugs te/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla re dang rwa bas bskor bar bsams la/ lag pa ma bteg par me tog gtor/ de lta bu'i srung 'khor gyi nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas bsgom pa nas/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa rim gyis bskyed nas/ dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi bya zhing gtso bo'i snying po brjod pas me tog tshom bu bkod/ de bzhin du shar gyi re mig nas brtsams te byang sgo'i mthar thug pa'i bar lha so so'i gnas su dri'i thig le zlum po dang*/ rang rang gi sngags brjod pas me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de nas tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du rang gi sems so sor rtog pa zhes sogs nas mngon byang lngas gtso bo bskyed/ 'khor rnams dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi tshul gyis bskyed pa nas brtsams te rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// bzhi pa phyag gi mchod pa ni/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ yid kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la 'dud pa'i bsam pas/ gang gi drin gyis sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod/ lnga pa mchod pa la brgyad las/ thog mar phyi mchod ni/ lag pa gnyis dku g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur kha sprad pa bcings la/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang g.yon pa'i mdzub mo nas rim bzhin bkrol te rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba byas la/ zhabs bsil la sogs pa'i rdzas gang yin pa de blangs te dngos su 'bul ba'am/

de dang de'i phyag rgya bcas la/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces dang*/ bzed zhal gyi nang du lha so so la dbul zhing*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra satwā ya nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du bai ro tsa nā/ rat+na saṃ bha we/ a mi tā bhā wa/ a mo gha sid+dhi/ lo tsa nā yai/ mā ma kā ye/ tāṃ tā la ba si nī/ tā re badz+ra ra tri/ badz+ra rū pi nī/ rā ga badz+ri ṇī/ badz+ra shān+tī/ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇī/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ shap+da badz+ra/ bhū mi badz+ra/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor dang po'i lha dang*/ mai tri/ k+ṣi ti gar+bha/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ kha gar+bha/ lo ke shwa ra/ mañdzu shrī/ sarba ṇi ba ra ṇi bi skaṃ bi ni/ sa man+ta bha dra/ waṃ s+ye/ wī ṇi/ murdza/ mṛ taṅge/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor bar pa'i lha dang*/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ aṃ ku sha/ badz+ra pā sha/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa/ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe/ zhes dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha rnams la mchod cing*/ sngags thams cad kyi mgor oṃ dang*/ mjug tu nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ/ zhes pas sbyar la mchod/ de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba la/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal bsil 'di// zhes dang*/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar ni wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ sbyar bas zhal bsil bar bsam/ 'thor 'thung 'di zhes dang*/ ku shas sku la gtor zhing*/ sarba saṃ sho dha nai swā hā/ dbul/ sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /ces dang*/ ma hā a mṛ ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon so sor dbul te/ chu gsum po ni bzed zhal gyi nang du blug go /de nas/ me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pas// bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces dang*/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog dbul/ tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba la/
