tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang*// gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /ces dang*/ dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ gis bdug spos dbul/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa// dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba// zhes dang*/ ā lo ke pū dza me sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ gis mar me/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// ces dang*/ gan+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pas dri dang*/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /ces dang*/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta ces pas zhal zas/ sil snyan la sogs pa rol mo'i tshogs// dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces dang lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pas rol mo dbul zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi tā/ nā da swa bhā ba tsa/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swā hā/ zhes bya bas kyang ngo*// de nas gos zung blangs te/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis bskon pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul gyis// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka shrī badz+ra dhā tu maṇ+ḍal la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra was+t+rā ya swā hās gos zung dang*/ de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba dang*/ bsod nams dpag bsam ljon pa las byung ba'i// mngar ba'i ro ldan 'dzam bu'i 'bras sogs kyis// zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing khams rnams// bkang ste dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ bha ga wān gyi rjes su dz+rīṃ swā hās 'bras bu dbul lo// gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni/

byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod kyi dbus nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas blangs nas gtor zhing*/ dngos grub 'gugs shing mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i rdzas// kha na ma tho med pa'i lcags kyu lngas// zhing khams sogs sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ shrī hūm̐ ghuṃ dzaṃ swā hās lcags kyu lnga dbul/ de nas mtheb srin sbyar ba'i rtse mos bdud rtsi lan gsum bskor zhing dkrugs pa'i dbus nas blangs te steng gi phyogs su gtor zhing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ grub chen ḍom+bi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ dpal ldan nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa rgyal ba dpal gyi ye shes/ slob dpon chen po mi thub zla ba/ slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan/ zhang bkra shis dpal/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ paṇa chen ma ti/ rje btsun ku mā ra ma ti/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa dbang bka'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ de bzhin du chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta yan chad gong dang 'dra ba la/ de nas 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa bkra nyis dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa chen po/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos kyi rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams te/ bshad bka'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ 'phags pa rin po che yan sngar dang 'dra ba la/ de nas bla ma zhang dkon mchog dpal/

brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bhud+dhā shrī rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas khrid bka'i bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ de bzhin du bde mchog la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la'ang 'bul lo// de nas yi dam gyi lha rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor bcas kyi sngags sam sa bon la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas yi dam gyi lha gzhan la'ang dbul/ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ dpral ba rnams su gtor zhing lus kyi lha rnams tshim par bsam/ de nas gur mgon lcam dral la sogs pa'i chos skyong rnams dang*/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga la sogs pa rnams dang*/ gzhi bdag nas 'gro ba rigs drug gi bar yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba la mchod pas/ thams cad kyang zag med kyi bde bas mnyes shing tshim nas bdag la dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ mthar rang gi lce la reg cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// gsum pa yid las byung ba'i mchod pa la drug las/ dang po thun mong gi mchod pa nyi shu ni/ rdo rje gdan bzhi dang thun mong ba ste/ de nas ngag tu/ hūm̐ glur blang zhing*/ lus kyi gar sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje khu tshur dku g.yon du bzhag la/ oṃ bha ga wān sogs sngon du 'gro bas oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ dang*/ lag pa gnyis phreng ba 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra mā le pū dzi te/ de bzhin du lag pa g.yon pas pi wang 'dzin cing g.yas pas de 'dren pa'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra wī ṇi/ lag pa gnyis gling bu 'bud pa'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra waṃ s+ye/ lag pa gnyis kas dung 'bud pa'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra phe ma/ lag pa gnyis ting shag brdung ba'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra wa d+ya/ dku g.yon du rnga kha gyen du bstan pa lag pa gnyis kyis brdung ba'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra pa ṭa ha/ lag pa gnyis spyi bor gar bsgyur ba'i tshul dang*/

badz+ra nṛ t+ye/ lag pa g.yas bsil yab g.yob pa'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra byañdza na/ lag pa g.yon gan rkyal gyi steng du g.yas pa'i gru mo btsugs te brkyang ba rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra dh+wa dza/ lag pa g.yon mnyam gzhag gi tshul dang*/ g.yas rdo rje khu tshur kha phub nas bla re bre ba'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra bi tā na/ lag pa gnyis dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar brkyang ba ba dan gyi tshul dang*/ badz+ra pa taṃ ka lag pa gnyis kas gdugs 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra ts+tshā traṃ/ lag pa gnyis rnga thogs la btags pa brdung ba'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra ta la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha 'gram du bzhag pa 'dzum ston pa'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra na kro ta/ lag pa gnyis sgeg mo'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra ha si ta/ yang phyag rgya de nyid khro gnyer bsdus pa 'jigs pa ston pa'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra kro dha/ lag pa sgeg mo'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra shriṃ kha la/ 'gying ba'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra la li ta/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ badz+ra pra ṇa mya/ zhes brjod do// gnyis pa khyad par gyi mchod pa bcu gsum ni/ me tog gi phyag rgya dang*/ gser sogs rin chen las grub 'dab stong ldan// mdangs bkra yid 'ong dri ldan me tog gis// zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing khams rnams// bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// badz+ra puṣ+pe/ rkang pa 'og ma gnyis thams cad kyi mjug tu sbyar la/ bdug pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ a gar nag sogs lhan cig skyes pa dang*// sbyar ba las byung bdug pa'i sprin tshogs kyis// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom= /badz+ra dhū pe/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang*/ nyi zla nor bu sgron me'i 'od la sogs// mun pa sel byed snang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom= /badz+ra ā lo ke dri'i phyag rgya dang*/ reg na bsil byed zhim pa'i dri dang ldan// ga pur la sogs legs par sbyar ba'i chus// zhing khams 'di dang=

/bkang ste bcom ldan= /badz+ra gan+dhe/ zhal zas kyi phyag rgya dang*/ bsod nams bde ba skyed byed lha yi bshos// sna tshogs kha dog dri dang ro ldan pas// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom ldan= /badz+ra nai wi t+ye/ gos zung 'bul ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ lha rdzas las grub yang 'jam reg na bde// kha dog lnga ldan zung du sbyar ba yis// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom ldan= /badz+ra was+t+ra/ bla re bre ba'i tshul dang*/ shin tu thags bzang sna tshogs ri mos mdzes// rin chen drwa bas brgyan pa'i bla re yis// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom ldan= /badz+ra bi tā naṃ/ lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur kha nang du bstan pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i khu tshur yang de bzhin byas nas bzhag pa dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ tshogs pa las byung stong nyid sgra snyan sgrogs// chos rnams stong nyid mtshon byed dril bu'i sgras// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom ldan= /badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis rnga yab g.yob pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ rdul yab tshad pa'i gdung ba la sogs pa// sel byed rdul yab bsil yab sbrang yab kyis// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom ldan= /tsā ma ra/ lag pa gnyis 'dud pa'i tshul dang*/ bsgo ba nyan zhing bya ba'i las la mkhas// brtson pas 'dod don sgrub byed bran tshogs kyis// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom= /dā sa dā se/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bca' zhing*/ bsam pa tsam gyis 'dod dgu 'byung ba yi// mdzes pa'i gzugs ldan 'dod 'jo'i ba sogs kyis// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom ldan= /ka ṭi ṇi/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rta mchog gi phyag rgya dang*/ mdog sngo rta rgyal brgyad khris rab bskor zhing*// shin tu brling zhing rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rtas// zhing khams 'di dang rab= /bkang ste bcom ldan= /a shwa/ glang po che'i phyag rgya dang*/ thal kar mche ba drug ldan rin chen gyi// drwa bas spras pa'i stobs ldan glang po yis// zhing khams 'di dang rab=

/bkang ste bcom ldan= /ga dza zhes pas dbul lo// gsum pa rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rin chen bdun la sogs pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul la mchod par bsams te/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /tsakra rat+na/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi rat+na/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /s+t+rī rat+na/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas theg pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /pu ru ṣa rat+na/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan thams cad rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ga dza rat+na/ rin chen rta mchog 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las yongs grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /a shwa rat+na/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍ+ga rat+na/ zhes pas dbul lo// de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ lag gnyis mkhrig ma bsnol nas kyang*// rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya// sor mo rnams bsnol lto sbyar nas// mthe bong mthil bkug 'khor lo yin// khu tshur gnyis ni rab sbyar te// gung mdzub rin chen 'dra bar byas// rdo rje thal mo mdzub mo gnyis// gung mo mnyam pa'i tshigs su sbyar// bsdams pas gung mo myu gur bya// mthe bong mthe'u chung so sor bsgreng*// lag g.yas glang po'i sna lta bu'i// gru mo g.yon par rab tu bzung*// khu tshur gnyis sbyar mthe bong dbye// gung mo srin lag brkyang bar bya// g.yon pa go 'dzin g.yas pa ni// ral gri 'debs pa ltar bya'o// zhes pa ltar ro// bzhi pa nye ba'i rin chen bdun gyi mchod pa ni/

gang zhig ral gri rin po che// bcangs pa tsam gyis yul 'khor kun// kun 'dud nye ba'i rin chen 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// khaḍ+ga rat+na/ rgya mtsho las byung klu yi lpags// grang na dro la dro na bsil// yon tan phun tshogs pags pa 'di// rgyal ba sras dang= /tsarma rat+na/ lta mdzes dro 'jam yon tan dang*// bsam gtan 'phel zhing nyon mongs zhi// yon tan phun tshogs gos bzang 'di// rgyal ba sras dang= /wasta rat+na/ nags tshal me tog 'bras bu rgyas// 'bab chu bya rnams skad snyan sgrogs// tshal mchog nye ba'i rin chen 'di// rgyal ba sras dang= /ung+yān rat+na/ rgyal po'i khang bzang rin po che// rgya che dpang mtho nor gyis gang*// tsha chu grang lhags skyob nus 'di// rgyal ba sras dang= /kū ṭa rat+na/ rin chen chag bu dbyibs mdzes shing*// ngal dub kun sel brgyar bsgrod nus// thar lam skas 'dzegs l+h+wam mchog 'di// rgyal ba sras dang= /dza kra ka rat+na/ yang zhing mtha' la mtho dman can// bsam gtan blo gros lhag par 'phel// nyon mongs zhi byed mal cha 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa 'bul// sha ya sa wan rat+na/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyis phyag rgyas dbul lo// lnga pa bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs pa'i// bsod nams rgyu las byung ba'i 'khor lo 'di// gang la phul ba de yis skad cig la// dam pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /maṅga la tsakra/ de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa 'dra ba la/ dri med shin tu mdzes pa'i dpal be'u 'di// kun mkhyen ye shes nyid dang ldan par shog /maṅga la shrī dza ba na/ rin chen bcud kyis gang ba'i bum pa 'di// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rgyan gyis brgyan par shog /maṅga la kum+bha/ 'dam skyes 'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma 'di// 'khor ba'i nyes pa'i skyon kyis ma gos shog /maṅgal pad+ma/ g.yas 'khyil shin tu dkar ba'i dung chen 'di// smra ngan 'pham byed chos sgra sgrogs par shog

/maṅga la shaṃ kha/ shin tu gsal ba'i mig ldan gser nya 'di// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol bar shog /maṅga la nya tsha/ rgyan gyis spras pa'i rin chen gdugs mdzes 'di// kun la skyabs kyi dam pa byed par shog /maṅga la tsha traṃ ka dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan dam pa 'di// phyogs bcur chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par shog /maṅga la dh+wa dza/ zhes pas so// drug pa 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo gshibs pa kha phyir bstan nas bzhag pa me long gi phyag rgya dang*/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas// lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan rgyal po ni// rdo rje rnam snang mnga' bdag nyid// rū pa kā ma gu ṇa/ sil snyan dbul zhing*/ sgra la rnam gsum= /lha rnams la ni= /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can// rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po// shab+da kā ma gu ṇa/ dri'i phyag rgya dang*/ dri la rnam gsum= /lha rnams la ni= /de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni// rin chen phung por rab tu grags// gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa/ ro'i phyag rgya dang*/ ro la rnam gsum= /lha rnams la ni= /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs nyid// rdo rje chos ni de bzhin gshegs// ra sa kā ma gu ṇa/ gos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas// lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// 'dod yon 'bras bu ster ba po// spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa zhes pas dbul lo// bzhi pa gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ rdzas 'di dag dngos su yod na bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlab/ med na bsams la/ zhing khams rgya mtsho dge tshogs rgya mtsho las// byung ba'i rnam dag mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang*// lus can rgya mtsho'i rak+ta rnam dag pa'i// bdud rtsis rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor mchod// rak+ta a mṛ ta/ de bzhin du gong 'og rnams 'dra ba la/

rak+ta zhes pa'i tshab tu/ klad rgyas/ ha ya/ dri ma/ s+ye ya/ byang sems/ shud+dha/ pags pa/ sang ṇi/ dri chen/ ra sa/ rang byung*/ me sa/ dri chu/ rā ga sha chen/ māṃ sa/ gsher ba/ tsa turba ma/ kra khaṃ/ ba la/ rkang mar/ ta ma ta/ mar khu/ ni raṃ se/ so sen/ ka pū ri/ tsha ba/ da na/ kha chu/ s+thi ta/ khu ba/ ta na ba ti/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje thal mo'i phyag rgyas dbul lo// de nas rang rang gi sa bon las gling bu ma la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad sprul te mchod par bsam zhing*/ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab sgeg ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul te// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gling bu'i sgra yis mchod// baṃ s+ye/ tshig rkang pa bar ba gnyis 'dra ba la/ gser gyi mdog can rdo rje pi wang ma// sna tshogs gos dang= /nam mkha' gang bar= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs pi wang sgra yis mchod// wī ṇi/ nyi ma'i mdog can rdo rje rnga zlum ma// sna tshogs gos dang= /nam mkha' gang bar= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnga zlum sgra yis mchod// murdza/ margad mdog can rdo rje rdza rnga ma// sna tshogs gos dang= /nam mkha' gang bar= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod// mṛ taṅge/ ku mud mdog can rdo rje me tog ma// sna tshogs gos dang= /nam mkha' gang bar= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs me tog sil mas mchod// puṣ+pe/ dbang sngon mdog can rdo rje bdug spos ma// sna tshogs gos dang= nam mkha' gang bar= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdug spos sprin gyis mchod// dhū pe/ gser bzang mdog can rdo rje mar me ma// sna tshogs gos dang= /nam mkha' gang bar= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mar me'i phreng bas mchod// ā lo ke/ li khri'i mdog can rdo rje dri chab ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab sgeg ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul te// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dri zhim chu yis mchod// gan+dhe/

zhes pas dbul lo// lnga pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ lus mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya dang ldan par byas te/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs par bsams la cung zad cig mnyam par bzhag cing*/ rdo rje theg pa mnyes byed pa// 'di ni don dam mchod pa yin// gang gis rnam rtog rnam spangs te// byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing*// lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa// de yi mchod pa bla na med// sems can gang gis dbu ma yi// theg pa bsgom pa ma bsgoms na// theg pa dman la lhag par mos// de yis mchod pa kun rdzob yin// zhes brjod do// drug pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can// thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad// yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa// dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i mchog chos can// yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de// dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod ma yin// dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams// sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol// rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*// smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can// 'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*// tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*// khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad pa'i// thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yang mi 'gyur// e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan// mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang na gong 'phang mchog brnyes pa// khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas// dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yang dag yon tan rgyal che ste// lan cig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*// sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// zhes pas kyang bstod do// bdun pa bkra shis kyi glu blangs pas bstod pa ni/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ṇa ma hūm̐ ka ra ṇa bhu ru/ se dzi bi sad+dha/ u ta ta ru/ te na hūm̐/ te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ dhaṃ ba la/ su sad khe de ha dha ru/ sar+ya swa su bo dhi tsin+dha mu hūm̐/ te na hūm̐/ te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ daṃ dha li ka ṇa yo u dha ru gha ṭa badz+ra mut+ta ru/ te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ mā ya bhi dhi hi lin dza gu/ so i a ka ran ru bi/ te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// drug pa rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ lus tsog pur 'dug thal mo sbyar te/ sgrub thabs ltar rgyun bshags lan gsum brjod do// bdun pa sdom pa bzung ba la gnyis/ rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa bzung ba dang*/ dam tshig gi tshogs gzhan dran par bya ba'o// dang po ni/ sgrub thabs ltar sdom pa bzung ba lan gsum bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ spang bya spang bar bslab pa dang*/ bsten bya bsten pa la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ bdag gi spang bya'i bslab pa rnams 'di dag yin snyam du dran par byas la/ ngag tu rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag gi ltung ba dang bcas pa'i gzhung brjod par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ las dang po pa'i dam tshig rnams dran zhing*/ rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba'i tshig brjod par bya'o// dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin pa ni/ mchod pa'i mchog yin pa'i phyir/ bla ma gong mas mchod pa'i khongs su bsdus so// de nas gtor ma gtong ba ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis ka la 'bul te/ de'i cho ga yang sgrub thabs dang gtor chog las shes par bya zhing*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang 'brel na de'i bya ba rnams rdzogs par bya'o// brgyad pa slar yang mchod bstod bya ba ni/ gtang rag gi mchod pa'i phyir/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ chu bzhi nas rol mo'i bar sngags tsam gyis dbul ba phyi dang*/ lha so so'i sa bon gyi mjug tu 'bru gsum btags la bdud rtsis gtor ba nang dang*/

gling bu ma la sogs pa brgyad kyi yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod nas/ stong pa'i snying por phyag 'tshal bstod// la sogs pa brjod par bya'o// dgu pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab las 'byung ba bzhin/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ sngags kyi bzlas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag cag gi tshe dang*/ dpal dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ yon tan dang*/ phrin las rnam par rgyas nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang*/ sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de la brten nas bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs shing*/ bdag gi bsam sbyor thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo// bcu pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod cing*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing*/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag lag pa g.yas pa brkyangs pa sa la bzhag nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs dang badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ oṃ pad+ma tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus te/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya zhing*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdo rje 'chang gi sar bsngos la/

spyod lam thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal du gnas par bya'o// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mtha' dag la// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du// mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di phul bas// bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor par shog /dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i mchod pa'i cho ga 'di yang*/ rgyud sde 'dzin pa kun dga' gzhon nu la sogs pa don gnyer mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa chos kyi rje ye shes zhabs kyi bka' drin las rgyud gsum gdams ngag dang bcas pa'i tshul cung zad rig pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos rin chen 'bar ba dang*/ bzang po yongs bzung gi mchod pa'i skabs dang*/ rgyud kyi brtag pa dgu pa rtsa 'grel gnyis la gzhi byas/ bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes kyis brgyan nas/ dga' ba'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i bcu gsum la/ dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mdo stod pa kun dga' gzhon nu zhes pas bgyis so// //i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu// // ༄// dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga dbang gi snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang gi snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig thugs chud dbyibs dang kha dog dang bral yang*// yang dag thugs rje chen po'i dbang gis mkha' 'gro kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i sku// sku gsum zhal dang thabs shes spyan mnga' phyin drug phyag ldan bden gnyis zhabs kyis rnam par mdzes// mdzes shing yid 'ong chu shel ltar dkar drug lhag sum cu'i dkyil 'khor dbang phyug de la 'dud// sku bzhi'i nam mkhar thugs rje'i sprin bsdus nas// dbang bzhi'i bdud rtsi'i char chen legs phab pas// dga' bzhi'i lo tog rnam par rgyas bya'i phyir// dbang bzhi'i cho ga rgyud bzhin bshad pa la// bde gshegs rigs lnga ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs yum bzhis bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur// byang sems rnams kyis dge legs tshigs brjod rdo rje khro bos bgegs tshogs srungs// sgeg mdzes lha mos mchod pa'i las kyis me tog sil ma'i char phob la// skal bzang slob ma dad ldan rgyud la dbang gi ye shes rgyas par mdzod// 'dir rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi gsang ba yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i rjes su 'brangs te/

slob ma yongs su smin par byed pa'i cho ga brjod na/ de la rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi myur du mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa la lam rim pa gnyis bsgom dgos la/ de'i sngon rol du dbang bskur ba 'gro dgos te/ rgyud 'di nyid kyi 'grel pa man ngag gi snye mar/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang bskyed pa'i rim pa ni dbang bskur ba med par ma yin zhing zhes so// dbang bskur ba la phan yon ci yod na/ sgron gsal las dngos grub thams cad ni dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nyid las 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na// skye zhing skye bar yang dag 'gyur// de yi skye ba bdun la ni// ma bsgoms par yang dngos grub thob// ces pa ltar ro// ma smin par rim pa gnyis bsgoms na skyon cir 'gyur na/ ye shes thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med// bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin// gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis// dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa// slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye// zhes dang*/ rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na// sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang*// slob dpon slob mar mtshungs par ni// mi bzad dmyal ba chen por 'gro// zhes dang*/ grub thob sa ra has/ dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim// shi ma thag tu stong par 'gyur// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// ye shes kun gyis stong pa nyid// ces dang*/ dper na pi wang sbyor kun tshogs// rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung*// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur ma thob pa la bla mas kyang*/ sngags kyi rgyud dang man ngag sh+lau ka gcig tsam yang bstan du mi rung ste/ rim lnga las/ dad pa med cing dbang bskur dman pa la// gtam gyi rim pa'ang de la brjod mi bya// ces gsungs shing rtsa ltung bdun pa 'byung ba'i phyir ro// slob dpon rang gis dbang ma thob par gzhan la dbang bskur ba byed na yang*/

slob ma dang bcas pa dmyal bar 'gro ste/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar/ rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par// bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba// ci srid sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar// slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro// zhes gsungs so// de ltar dbang bskur ba la'ang dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro dgos te/ rdo rje dril bu pas/ dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste// zhes dang*/ nā ro 'grel par/ da ni dkyil 'khor med par dbang bskur sbyin par mi bya zhing dbang ma bskur ba de kho na nyid kyang bstan par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa la/ dkyil 'khor yang gdul bya'i dbang gis dbye ba'i sgo mang ste/ slob dpon klu byang gis/ slob ma'i don du grub bya'i phyir// 'khor lo rnam brgyad bri bar bya// rin chen de bzhin sa bon dang*// me tog tshon dang de bzhin du// bye ma g.yo dang phye ma ste// de bzhin yid kyi dkyil 'khor bden// zhes brgyad du gsungs pa dang*/ mngon brjod bla mar/ bri ba'i dkyil 'khor dang po ste// gnyis pa mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor ro// gsum pa lag pa'i phyag rgya ste// bzhi pa gzugs su 'gyur ba'o// lnga pa me tog mchod pa ste// drug pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro// zhes drug tu bshad pa la/ de dang 'gyur mi 'dra ba las/ yi ge'i dkyil 'khor dang po ste// gnyis pa mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor yin// lag pa'i phyag rgya gsum pa ste// gzugs brnyan dgod pa bzhi pa'o// me tog dgram pa lnga pa ste// drug pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro// zhes 'byung bas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la/ lha'i sa bon yi ge dgod pa/ chos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ phyag mtshan dgod pa dang*/ chos 'chad la sogs pa'i lag pa'i phyag rgya dgod pa thugs kyi phyag rgya dang*/ sku phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs can rdzogs par bkod pa phyag rgya chen po dang*/

de rnams mi shes pa lha'i gdan mtshon pa'i me tog dgram pa ste/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ gdan du dgod pa'i cho ga bya// zhes pa dang mthun no// des mtshon nas yo ga nas brda'am thig le tsam 'god pa'ang bsdu ste/ de lnga ga'ang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'dus te/ don bsdu ba na/ 'di lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni// rtag tu bsgom zhing mchod par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du me tog tshom bu 'god pa la me tog tshom bu zhes bshad kyi rdul tshon dang ma 'brel bar/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba ma yin la/ sngar dkyil 'khor brgyad du bshad pa'i dang po bdun yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbye ba yin no// 'dir ni slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ dkyil 'khor gsum du bsdus te/ 'on kyang dkyil 'khor de rang bzhin// ci yin de ni 'di ltar bshad// ri mor gnas pa'i las dang ni// thig la tshon dgye'i rim pas bstan// 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis// grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o// bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang*// de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod// mkhas pas bsgrub bya de min te// yang dag don mthong grol phyir ro// zhes gang zag dbang po tha ma la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'bring la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ rab la lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar bshad pa la/ las dang po pa la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang nges par bskur dgos te/ nā ro pas/ dbang bskur bdun po 'di rnams rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du rnam par spangs nas gzhan ras bris la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du sbyin par bya ba ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// dkyil 'khor der dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la gsum ste/ thog mar slob ma rjes su bzung ba dang*/ de nas rgyud smin par bya ba dang*/ mthar dam tshig dang sdom pa bstan pa'o// dang po ni ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi rdo rje slob dpon la/

slob ma 'ga' zhig dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i phyir phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ rigs kyi bu btsun pa'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ khyed la bdag bla mar gsol ba 'debs kyi/ bdag dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'tshal lo// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs pa la/ slob dpon gyis 'di dri ste/ khyod sngar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs sam ma zhugs zhes dri/ zhugs zer na gang la zhugs zhes dri ste/ de'ang sngar gsang sngags la zhugs zer na/ ji ltar zhugs pa shes par byas la khas blang*/ gal te sngags la ma zhugs kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed de theg pa chen po la zhugs so zhes zer na/ de'ang 'os su gyur pas na khas blang*/ gang du theg chen la'ang ma zhugs kyi so sor thar pa la bslabs so zer na/ de ma thag dbang bskur bar khas mi blang gi /snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed la gdod rjes su gzung bar bya'o// gal te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ma zhugs so zhes smra na/ de la khyod ci don du gnyer nas dbang bskur zhu bar 'dod ces dri/ de la rigs gsum ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod ces zer na/ de ni skye ba mang po nas theg pa chen po la zhugs pa yin pas slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga bya'o// gal te bdag nyid gcig pu 'khor ba las thar te zhi ba'ang don du gnyer bar 'dod do zhes smra na yang de yang byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed/ dpon slob phan tshun 'brel pa brtags la rjes su mthun na gdod slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga bya'o// gal te tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang nad med pa la sogs pa dang*/ skye ba pha rol du lha mi la sogs pa don du gnyer bar 'tshal lo zhes smra na/ de ni de ma thag tu rjes su gzung bar mi bya ste/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/

dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin// zhes pa la sogs pa rim gyis sbyang ba dang*/ 'brel pa brtag pa la sogs pa blo legs par sbyangs la/ byang chub kyi sems skyes pa dang rjes su gzung bar bya'o// de ltar na 'brel brtags nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar grangs kha yar ba gzung bar bya'i/ kha 'cham pa dang de las lhag pa dkyil 'khor gcig tu gzung bar mi bya zhing*/ gza' skar bzang ba dang yar gyi ngo la brtsam par bya'o// //gnyis pa ni 'grel chen las dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun te/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang*/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon gyi cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan dgram pa'i cho ga dang*/ sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dang*/ mjug gi cho ga zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyis smin byed kyi lam mtha' dag bsdus pa las zhes bshad pa ltar don bdun las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma bshams la/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can// ston pa'i bstan la legs gnas pa// rdor sems cho ga bshad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gsal bar dmigs te/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis slob ma'i lus la zhugs te/ de'i thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang bgegs thams cad bsregs par bsam zhing snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ gtor chog ltar lha dang 'byung po la gtor ma phul te kho bos ni lha mnyes par bya ba'i phyir sngon du bsnyen par bya'o// khyod kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mchod pa'i yo byad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa'i yo byad 'di dang 'di dag dgos pas 'tshog chas gyis shig

lus dang srog gi bar chad du 'gyur bas/ ya nga ba'i gnas 'di dag tu ma 'gro shig dge ba'i rtsa ba la brtson par gyis shig /ces bsgo la btang ngo*// slob mas slob dpon la phyag 'tshal te ci ltar nus par khas blang ngo*// de nas slob dpon la bsnyen pa'i yo byad phul ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis gnas dben par 'dug ste bsnyen pa bya'o// 'di la bum pa la brten pa dang ma brten pa'i lugs gnyis las/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sngon du bum pa la brten pa'i bsnyen pa bya dgos pas na/ rnam rgyal bum pa cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du legs par bcas la/ stegs bu'i steng du bzhag steng du dung chos kyi nang du dri zhim po legs par sbyar ba dang*/ rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa yang bzhag cing mchod pa dang gtor ma yang bsham mo// de nas slob dpon gyis thun bzhi'i rim pas sgrub thabs ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar rdzogs pa dang*/ bum pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bum pa tshul bzhin du bskyed pa'i nang du/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas brtsams te thun mong gi srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang gi bar skad cig ma las bskyed cing*/ gtso bo mngon byang lnga dang 'khor rnams 'byin pa'i tshul gyis yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la mchod bstod bya'o// de nas rang bdag bskyed gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du tshur 'khor du sngags phreng dmar po'am ser po las 'od 'phros pas bum pa'i nang gi lha la phog pas thams cad dmar lam song bas lha thams cad dbang du gyur par dmigs pa'am/ yang na ser po 'phros pas lha thams cad ser lam song bas bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyas par dmigs pa'am/ bum pa'i lha thams cad kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'dzag par dmigs la gtso bo la 'bum dang*/

'khor rnams la khri phrag re bzlas nas grangs kyi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa dang*/ bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod byas la/ dung chos kyi chu blugs pas bum pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu bar bya'o// gnyis pa sa'i cho ga la/ sa brtag pa dang*/ bslang ba dang*/ sbyang ba dang*/ bzung ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang drug gi dang po ni/ grong khyer ram gtsug lag khang gi byang shar gyi phyogs yid dga' ba chu dang ldan pa/ dbyibs gru bzhi pa/ shar dang byang du gzhol shing gzhan mtho ba/ kha dog dkar zhing snum pa/ thal ba dang rus pa dang rdo la sogs pa dang*/ u dum wā ra la sogs pa'i shing drug med pa/ rus sbal lam glang po che'i rgyab lta bu ma yin pa'i sa btsal nas/ der khru gang gru bzhir brkos te sa de nyid kyis dgang bar bya'o// de nas gang ba'am lhag na mchog tu bsngags so// ma gang ba ni spang bar bya'o// gnyis pa la mngon pa las bslang ba dang*/ mi mngon pa las bslang ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sa phyogs de'i bdag po rgyal po'am/ blon po la sogs pa las bslang ba ste/ gal te ma khugs na rin gyis bslu ba'i bar du byas la ji srid gnang ba'i skabs byung gi bar du bslang bar bya'o// gnyis pa la sa'i lha mo las bslang ba/ zhing skyong las bslang ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ der maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa dang gtor ma gnyis byas la/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dag pa dran pa dang bcas pa byas nas dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis sam/ yang na gtso bo rkyang par bsgoms nas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su tshom bu sa'i lha mor bskyed pa nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i tshig gis lan gsum gyis sa bslangs nas nam mkhar bteg pas/ sa phyogs bdag la byin par bsam zhing skyong rnams la bka' bsgo ba'i bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma byin la/

gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po gang dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa gzhi 'di// bdag zhu khyod kyis stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyi sa bslang bas byin par bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi lha rnams gshegs su gsol zhing*/ zhing skyong rnams bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi las ma tshar gyi bar du khang pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod par bsam mo// gsum pa la/ las kyis sbyang ba gter gzhug pa/ sngags kyi sbyang ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ lto 'phye'i rim pa shes par byas la dngos grub dang mthun par brkos te/ skyon rnams bsal la sa gzhan dang bsres te dri zhim po'i chus bkrus te bstar zhing 'thas par dgang ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de'i dbus su rdza'i snod pe'u'am zangs kyi snod la sogs par rin po che dang*/ 'bru dang sman rnams snying po'i sngags sam las thams cad pa bzlas pa bcug la bstar zhing 'thas par bya'o// gsum pa ni gal te sbyang bar mi nus pa'am nus pa rnams la'ang cho ga 'di bya ste/ lag pa sa la bzhag nas oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzlas par bya'o// de nas yang sa gzhi de nam mkha' ltar dag par bsams te oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod par bya ba ni don dam pa'i sbyang ba'o// bzhi pa ni de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa brtsigs te mdzes par byas la de'i dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi sa stegs byas la/ nye 'khor kun tu ba lci dang dri zhim pos legs par byugs te/ bla re dang ba dan la sogs pas kyang brgyan/ bris sku la sogs pa'ang bkram te bkra shis shing mdzes par bya'o// de nas stangs stabs kyi bkod pa la sogs pas sa gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su stan nang tshang can la 'dug la/ phyogs bzhir yang slob ma bzhi 'dug cing*/ de dag so so'i mdun du mchod pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams mdzes par bshams te/

las kyi rdo rjes zhu phul nas/ dpon slob rnams kyis sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar ting nge gsum mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar rdzogs par byas la/ slob dpon gyis lha'i nga rgyal bzung zhing*/ phyogs kyi slob ma rnams kyis mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ bskyed/ byin gyis brlab pa rnams byas nas/ so so'i tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa dbul zhing shar phyogs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i// dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba'i// ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong mdzad// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems can po// rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes pas gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis hūm̐ badz+rod tiṣ+ṭha zhes bya bas phyag rgya dang bcas pas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg la/ rang gtso bo las chad de phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis lag g.yas hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa de'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ bsam/ lag pa g.yon pa a las pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa de'i lte bar zla ba la aḥs mtshan pa/ de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i lag par bsgoms te/ lag pa gnyis rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba byas la/ lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje blangs te/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes brjod la rdo rje de smin mtshams kyi bar du lan gsum gsor la snying gar bzung la thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub kyi sems thugs kyi dam tshig yin snyam du dran par bya/ yang lag pa g.yon pas dril bu blangs te/

oṃ ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ zhes brjod de lan gsum dkrol la dkur kha gyen du bstan te bzung*/ srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ngo bo gsung gi dam tshig yin snyam dran par bya/ de nas rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba de nyid phyag rgya'i dam tshig yin snyam du dran par byas la dril bu phyogs mtshams brgyad du dkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇa'i sngags brjod/ de nas sems can thams cad la snying rje'i sems bskyed/ nyon mongs pa thams cad la rab tu khros nas/ des sdang ba'i bgegs thams cad gzhom par bya ba'i phyir ldang bar bya ste/ rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba dang bcas pas rdo rje gsor rkang ba g.yas pa'i skyil krung bshig dril bu dkrol te g.yon pa'ang bshig la/ rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba dang bcas te ldang la/ lag pa gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ skad cig gis bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor yongs su gyur nas khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba ming gzhan rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad ces bya ba g.yas brkyangs pa'i zhabs gnyis kyis rdo rje dang pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ rab tu khros pa bskal pa'i me ltar 'od zer gyi phung po 'bar ba/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs za ba lta bu/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon ljang ba ste/ zhal gsum gdangs pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags sgril ba/ zhal re re zhing smin ma 'khyog cing khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ dpral bar thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo'i phreng ba mgul pa las 'phyang ba/ mgo bo dang bcas pa'i ska rags can stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'phyang ba/ mtha' yas nag pos bcings pa'i dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba/

'jog po la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar te mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel zhing mdzub mo brkyang bar byas pa'i 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgyas 'od kyi shes rab dang snyoms par zhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang*/ g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ yi ge hūm̐ drag tu sgrogs bzhin par bsgoms la/ de'i snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje khro bo'i rnam par spyan drangs par bsam la/ ngag tu/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ces brjod cing mchod bstod byas la/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas su dgongs par mdzad pa dang*/ slob dpon dang de'i slob ma rnams byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la khro bo rnams thim pas/ rang nyid dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab cing*/ shin tu gdug pa drag po la// zhi bas 'dul bar mi 'gyur bas// 'di mkhyen rdo rje 'chang gis ni// khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun 'gyur// nga ni rang nyid rdo rje can// rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid dag /nga ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che// nga ni stobs chen rdo rje can// nga ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal// phyag na rdo rje brtan pa nga*// nga ni bdag po'i rdo rje che// byin gyis brlab pa mi 'dor ro// zhes pas nga rgyal bzung nas/ mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma g.yon pa ṭa las zla bar bskyed/ rdo rje'i lta bas g.yas phyogs su bltas pas bgegs thams cad bsregs la g.yon du bltas pas gsos par bsgom mo// yang rkang pa'i mthil du aḥtsheg drag can bkod la/

de las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar bar bsgoms te/ de'i 'od zer gyis bgegs thams cad bsregs shing sa gzhi thams cad rdo rje'i sar bsgoms nas/ dga' bas yongs su 'gyur ba'i 'gros kyis dbang ldan du phyin nas/ der rdo rje gsor ba dang dril bu gsil zhing*/ rnam lnga 'dod skor byas pas gar bslang ba dang*/ rnam lnga 'dod skor dang rdo rje snying ga dang dril bu dku g.yon du bzung la/ rkang pa g.yas pa sa la bsnun bzhin pas hūm̐ zhes dang gar gyi sgeg btsal ba dang*/ yang 'dod skor dang g.yon dril bu dkur bzung*/ rkang pa g.yas pa sa la bsnun pa dang bstun la g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gar bsdigs pa ste/ de dag sngon du 'gro bas/ gang yang lha dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ lus srul po dang*/ mthu che zhing rdzu 'phrul che ba rjes su 'brang ma'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rigs sngags grub pa khyod song shig sa phyogs 'dir slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya bas slob ma che ge mo zhes bya ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i don dang*/ sems can thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor rgyal po rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba 'dri bas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thos nas de dag myur ba nyid du song shig gang zhig mi 'gro ba de dag lag na rdo rje hūm̐ khros pas gdong rab tu 'bar kun tu 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba/ ye shes chen po'i rdo rje ye shes kyi rdo rjes mgo bo brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ lus kyi khro bo'i stangs stabs dang*/ rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu gsil zhing phyogs bcur bltas la yungs kar gtor/ ngag tu hūm̐ drag la ring ba dang khro bo'i sngags mang du brjod/

sems kyis snying ga nas khro bo dpag tu med pa spros la bgegs rnams tshar bcad par bsgom mo// de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa bskor nas shar du mthun pa'i rkang stabs kyis 'dug la/ shar ram dbus su kha bltas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yid kyis dmigs la phyag byas nas/ me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ byug pa dang*/ pheg rdob pa la sogs pa'i phyag rgyas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing mchod par bya'o// de nas g.yas brkyangs la sogs pa'i gar dang*/ lag stabs dang*/ 'dug stangs dang*/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang*/ rol mo'i bkod pa dang*/ glu'i bkod pa rnams lag len ltar bya'o// lnga pa ni/ de nas gnas khang stong pa nyid du bsgoms la/ hūm̐ las skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du bskyed de/ de snyoms par zhugs pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas su bsgom/ de'i nang du hrīḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma/ de'i lte bar aḥtsheg drag can las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba la rlung la sogs pa'i 'byung ba bzhi/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rnam par snang mdzad yab yum du bsgom/ de gnyis snyoms par zhugs pas de rnams 'od du zhu nas 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang ltar byin gyis brlab bo// drug pa ni/ de nas seng ldeng ngam lcags sam rus pa las byung ba'i phur bu srid du sor bco brgyad pa sboms su sor drug pa'am/ srid du bcu gnyis/ sboms su bzhi pa'am/ srid du brgyad/ sboms su drug cha dang bcas pa'i phyed dang*/ gsum la/ stod rang rang gi khro bo'i gzugs la smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can lnga 'dus byas te/ tsan+dan dmar pos byug tshon sna lnga'i srid bus dkris/ dar dmar po'i cod paṇa bcing*/ yungs kar gyi thum bu btags nas snod gsar par bzhag go /de nas oṃ shū n+ya tās stong par bsgoms pa'i ngang las/

raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ mda'i drwa ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar bas bskor ba'i srung 'khor du bsams la/ oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra prā kā ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañdza ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ sa phyogs srung 'khor gyi rang bzhin du bltas la/ rang hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis phur bu rnams bsang sbyangs te pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las dbang ldan gyi phur bu 'khor los sgyur ba ser po zhal gsum phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ mer rnam rgyal sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ phyag dang po gnyis khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgyas rdo rje dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de 'og gnyis mda' gzhu/ de 'og gnyis ral gri dang lcags kyu/ de 'og gnyis rdo rje dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ bden bral du sprin sgra sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs drug pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang dgra s+t+wa/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang gtun shing bsnams pa/ rlung du gsus po che sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum pa dbus ma bzhad pa/ g.yas gdangs pa/ g.yon tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag drug gis g.yas rdo rje be con/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang*/ bcas pas nu ma 'dzin pa/ tho ba dang gzhu/ dbus su rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum pa dbus ma bzhad pa/ g.yas ljags 'dril ba/ g.yon tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ phyag brgyad kyis g.yas rdo rje/ dbyug tho/ lcags kyu mda' dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub nu ma 'dzin pa/ pad+ma/ zhags pa/

gzhu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang stod khro bo'i rnam pa can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ smad phur bu'i gzugs can bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar bar bsgoms nas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ ye shes kyi phur bu dpag tu med pa bkug nas sgo ma bzhi'i sngags rgyas dam tshig gis phur bu dang ro gcig tu byas nas/ dbus kyi phur bu la gtso bo'i sngags dang mtshams kyi bzhi la drag mo la sogs pa bzhi'i sngags dang thun mong du oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba bigh+nān hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ dkar po'i phyogs rnams skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa la bkod/ gdul dka' ba'i bgegs rnams kyi snying ga nas lcags kyus bkug mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis bsdigs bzhin pas bkug nas rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol me ri 'bar ba'i shar dang mtshams kyis bzhir hūm̐ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa rnams kyi nang du bcug par bsam/ rang khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi nga rgyal gyis lag pa g.yon pas rdo rje khu tshur gyis phur bu dang*/ g.yas pas rdo rje tho ba me tog dmar po'i phreng ba bcings pa bzung nas/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ādz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā k+tsit+ta kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod cing bgegs rnams kyi mgo bor phur bus btab la/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ka rā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ zhes brjod cing brdungs pas spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug cing 'og gzhi dang lhan cig tu byas pas bgegs rnams kyi lus g.yo 'gul med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa dang bral nas 'od gsal bde ba chen po de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin du ro gcig par gyur cing*/

bgegs kyi tshogs lhag ma rnams kyang ring du bros par bsams la/ dbang ldan nas mtshams bzhir g.yas skor dang*/ dbus kyi phur bu shar du btab la/ sa phyogs bgegs dang bral bar bya ste sa'i cho ga'o// //gsum pa lta gon la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ de ltar sa'i cho ga byas pa'i gnas su/ phyag dar dang skyang nul bya/ bla re dang yol ba la sogs pa'i rgyan dgram/ bris sku dang lugs ma la sogs pa'i rten rnams ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor yang thig chen brgyad skya thig tu btab nas/ rtsig pa'i nang phan chad stong par bzhag la/ de'i phyi rol dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas bdag gi g.yon nas g.yon skor gyis zhabs bsil la sogs pa'i chu bzhi dang*/ rang gi g.yas dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon nas me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod lnga g.yon skor gyis bsham/ de dag kyang 'byor pas tshad med la/ ma 'byor na'ang lha grangs dang mnyam par sum cu so bdun dang*/ sa'i lha mo'i mchod pa dang*/ bum pa'i dang*/ las thams cad pa'i mchod pa ste mchod pa tshar bzhi bcu tham pa bsham/ gzhan yang ba'i rnam lnga dang*/ dri bzang po'i lde gu dang*/ me tog dang*/ bzed zhal gsum dang*/ gos zung dang*/ bum pa sta gon gyi phyir mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa bcu 'dus byas la/ rdo rgyus la sogs pas dkar por byugs la/ lha'i kha dog dang mthun par dar ram ras dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul chings prog lnga pa'am bdun pa byas la/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i srad bu dkar pos bcing*/ rnam rgyal lam rtsa ba'i bum pa la nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po sogs rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rnams/ shar gyi la zla ba la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dkar po/ lho'i la rin po che ser po/ nub kyi la pad+ma dmar po/ byang gi la ral gri ljang gu/ dbang ldan gyi la 'khor lo/ me yi la rdo rje/ bden bral gyi la pad+ma/ rlung gi la ut+pa la/ las thams cad pa la sna tshogs rdo rje ste 'di rnams nyi ma la gnas pa bris nas/

drag mo la sogs pa'i sngags sam las thams cad pa bzlas pas bum pa rnams la yungs kar gyis brab cing gu gul gyis bdugs nas bgegs bskrad/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ 'bras/ til te 'bru lnga/ gser dngul/ byi ru/ mu tig dung ste rin po che lnga/ lan tshwa/ bu ram/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi ste snying po lnga dang*/ tsan+dan dkar po/ dmar po/ gur gum/ dzā ti/ ga pur te dri lnga dang*/ bṛ hasti/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ a pa ra dzit+ta dkar po/ ha sa ha sa de ba ste sman lnga dang*/ sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga rnams ci 'byor bcug rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las lha mo mdog sna tshogs pa spros te/ chu bo gad+gā nas chu blangs te 'gengs par bsams la/ oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ zhes lan bdun bdun bzlas la bum pa'i sum cha dri zhim po'i chus dgang*/ am̐ hūm̐ swā hās shing rlon pas kha brgyan la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su ku sha'i gdan la rnam rgyal bum pa dbus dang gzhan rnams phyogs mtshams ma nor ba dang las bum byang shar du bzhag la/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du mchod yon gyi snod thod pa'am dung chos dri zhim po'i chu dang 'o ma bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar bas bkang ba/ de'i steng du rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa rnams bzhag cing*/ bum pa rnams kyi mtha' skor du mchod pa rnams bsham/ slob ma sta gon gyi phyir me tog dang dri chab ma gtogs pa'i mchod pa rnams dang*/ so shing dang ku sha che chung gnyis dang*/ srung skud slob ma du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa dang*/ kha bshal gyi chu rnams kyang sta gon bya'o// gzhan yang 'das pa'i gtor ma dang sgos kyi chos skyong la sogs ci tsam dgos pa'i gtor ma dang*/ sngon 'gro dang sa'i lha mo'i gtor ma gnyis kyang bshams shing*/ spyin sreg byed na de'i yo byad dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i rdzas thams cad 'dir 'tshog par bya ba ni sta gon gyi sbyor ba'i cho ga'o//

//gnyis pa la sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon dang bzhi'i dang po ni/ slob dpon 'khor bcas stan bde ba la 'khod nas gtor chog ltar sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab/ las kyi rdo rje lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab/ dpon slob thams cad kyis sgrub thabs ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang dag pa dran pa'i bar bya'o// de nas bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu bkod la/ de bsang zhing sbyangs pa'i ngang las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhi ba'i cha byad can rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs par bsams te bsnyen pa'o// rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ sngar sa chog byas na nam mkhar bteg pa'i lha mo de nyid dam/ ma byas na sa 'og nas ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ tshur sbyon tshur sbyon sa yi ni// lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyi rab gang ma// bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma// do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor las ni legs grub mdzod// hī hī hī hī hāṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas spyan drangs la mchod nas sgo ma bzhi'i sngags rgyas dam tshig pa dang ro gcig tu byas te nye bar sgrub bo// de nas skye mched drug dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni sgrub pa'o// dbang gi lha spyan drangs te mchod cing dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur te rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam pa ni sgrub chen no// de ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs pa la/

oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa thams cad kyi mgor sbyar la/ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ zhes pas zhabs bsil bzed zhal du dbul/ de bzhin du zhal bsil nas rol mo'i bar so so'i sngags rgyas dbul zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod kyang dbul la/ gtor ma chab la sogs pas sbyangs te/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas lag pa g.yon mchog sbyin du byas la/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta hūm̐ phaṭa oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul bas mnyes par bsams la/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa// de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi stobs// bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod pas mkhyen par gsol nas/ lha mo des dkyil 'khor bris shig pa'i gnang ba byin par bsams la oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas sa de nyid la thim par bsam zhing mchod gtor me tog rnams bsdu bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bsang chus gtor dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi bar mchod phreng ltar byas nas/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ sngar sa chog gi skabs su nam mkhar bteg pa'i dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod nas/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod cing bstod nas de dag kyang dgug gzhug byas te ro gcig par bsams la/ so so'i sngags bzlas pas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gsal gdab/ de nas sta gon gyi lha la dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa dang*/ phyi mchod nas brtsams te sdom pa bzung ba'i bar mchod phreng ltar byas la/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma'ang phul nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das// rig pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod// dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// mgon po bdag ni bri bar 'tshal// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la// de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os// 'gro ba'i 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa// sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// sems can bstan la dga' ba dang*// gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pa yis// rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor 'di// yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis// 'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'dri bas// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor par bcas thams cad kyis// thugs rjes dgongs nas nye bar mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab pas lhas gnang ba byin par bsam mo// gsum pa ni/ de nas 'dus byas pa'i bum pa rnams la las thams cad pa'i sngags brjod cing bsang chus gtor bas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba yangs pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul par dkris shing dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis gang ba bcur bsams la/ rnam rgyal bum par mngon byang lngas gtso bo dang*/ bum pa gzhan rnams su 'khor rnams 'byin pa'i tshul gyis bskyed de/

shar gyi bum par rnam snang drag shul ma/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/ byams pa/ sa snying*/ gling bu ma/ me tog ma/ lcags kyu ma/ lho'i bum par rin 'byung*/ rdo rje gzugs can ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phyag rdor/ nam snying*/ pi wang ma/ bdug spos ma/ zhags pa ma/ nub kyi bum par 'od dpag med/ rdo rje 'dod chags ma/ sgra rdo rje ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dpal/ mu kun+da ma/ mar me ma/ lcags sgrog ma/ byang gi bum par don grub/ rdo rje zhi ba ma/ sa rdo rje ma/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang*/ rdza rnga ma/ dri chab ma/ dril bu ma rnams dang*/ mtshams bzhi'i bum par dbang ldan du spyan ma la sogs pa yum bzhi dang*/ las bum du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ sbrul la sogs pa'i mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa rnams gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'byin pa'i tshul gyis bskyed de dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o// de nas skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ ye shes pa dgug pa dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya zhing*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la ni don yod grub pa'i rgyas gdab bo// de nas phyi nang yid las byung ba rnams kyis mchod cing*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che la sogs pas bstod nas/ pad skor dang bcas pas gzungs thag blangs nas/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po byung nas de gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha rnams la 'phog pas lha rnams dmar por byas nas bdag la dngos grub ster zhing*/ de dag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag par bsams la/ lha so so'i sngags dang*/

las thams cad pa la/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭ+ro t+ka ra bhai ra wā ya badz+ra san+to ha dar+pa ya a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas la/ slar yang phyi nang yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod cing bstod nas/ dung chos kyi nang gi mchod yon de bum pa rnams su phul nas lha rnams 'od du zhu bar blta'o// de nas sngar gtor ma ma btang na skabs 'dir btang*/ slob ma'i sdig pa zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kyang byas la tshogs kyi yo byad rnams blangs te byin gyis brlab cing phud dkyil 'khor la phul ba nas lhag gtor gyi bar tshogs 'khor gyi gzhung bzhin bya/ slob ma sta gon khang pa de nyid du byed na tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dang bum pa dang bris sku la sogs pa rnams mi snang bar byas nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma btang*/ 'das pa'i gtor ma bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir bzhag go /bzhi pa ni/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi sdom pa dang ldan zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed pa snying rje dang ldan zhing mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams 'khor ba las bsgral ba'i don du tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blo dang ldan pa gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus byas nas mdun du 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ khyed rnams chos bsgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa la 'jug 'dod kyi blo skyes pa de shin tu legs pa yin no// rdo rje theg pa la 'jug pa'i sgo yang ji skad du/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la// zhes pa ltar rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi las/

rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud nyid ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas skal bzang dag 'di dag la 'jug par bya bar rigs la/ 'di dag la'ang thabs kyi rgyud dang shes rab kyi rgyud gnyis las/ 'dir drang ba'i don du shes rab zab mo'i don gtso che zhing*/ nges pa'i don du thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin rgyud sde 'bum phrag sum cu so drug gi gleng gzhi'am rtsa ba bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal sam+pu ṭa nas 'byung ba rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bsgrub par bya ba la/ slob ma sta gon du gnas pa'i chos bcu gnyis te/ lus kyi bya ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ sngags kyi theg pa sbyin pa gzung bar gdams pa/ bsrung ba bya ba/ rgyun bshag bya ba/ srung sku gdags pa/ so shing dor ba/ ku sha sbyin pa/ khyor chu blud pa/ mchod pa bya ba/ chos zab mo bshad pa/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba bya ba rnams las dang po ni/ khrus byas gtsang zhing gos dkar gyon// yo byad rnam pa kun dang ldan// byams pa'i sems ni nyer bzhag nas// dkyil 'khor drung du nye bar 'dong*// zhes pa ltar khrus byas gos gtsang ma gyon phyag dang maṇ+ḍal byas te snyim pa me tog gis bkang nas tsog pur 'dug pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ skye rga na dang 'chi ba yi// chu srin la sogs 'jigs dang bcas// srid pa'i rgya mtshor bying ba las// 'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo// gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod de/

bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun// de bzhin kun kyang gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// drag po chen po bdud kyi sde// stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /bzhi pa ni/ slob ma rnams gtso bo'i sngags bzlas pa dang*/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis sdig sgrib rnams bsregs nas cho ga gsum gyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed la/ dri chus snying gar gtor/ snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ mgrin par pad+ma la gnas pa'i āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ spyi bor nyi ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje rnams bsgoms nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri chus gnas gsum du reg cing mas rim gyi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ zhes dang*/ yas rim gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la dang pos phyag mtshan/ gnyis pas yig 'bru gsal btab bo gsung*/ lnga pa ni/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i 'dun pas sgrub thabs nas bshad pa ltar rgyun bshags lan gsum bya'o// drug pa ni/ srad bu dmar po lus kyi tshad dang mnyam pa sum sgril byas pa la hūm̐ bzlas shing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor te/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzhag la/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bur bskyed la/ snying ga'i sa bon gyis sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu bkug la gnyis su med par bstim/

gtso bo'i snying po dang las thams cad pa'i sngags bzla bzhin pas skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas par bcings la yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o// bdun pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor dri'i maṇ+ḍal khru gang gru bzhi pa byas la/ der me tog gi tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i mdun du slob ma shar ram byang du kha phyogs pa la gtso bo'i sngags kyis so shing sor bcu gnyis pa/ mgo bor me tog gi cod paṇa dang ldan pa bsngags nas/ slob ma thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byin la/ des so la reg pas sdig sgrib rnams phyir phyung bar bsams la/ tshom bu'i dbus su oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes brjod cing dor bas/ so shing gi rtse mo rang la bstan na dngos grub rab/ steng du 'bring*/ phyogs bzhir bstan na zhi sogs phra mo/ 'og tu bstan na 'og gi dngos grub 'grub ces go bar bya'o// brgyad pa ni/ dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha chung ba sngas kyi phyir lag pa g.yas dang*/ ha las byung ba'i ku sha che ba stan gyi phyir g.yon du sbyin no// dgu pa ni/ dri zhim po'i chu oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsā s+ya bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpā na a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas bsngags la g.yas pa'i khyor mor lan gsum sbyin no// bcu pa ni/ slob ma lhar gnas pa'i spyi bor me tog shangs la bdug spos/ spyan la mar me/ snying gar dris byugs la mchod do// bcu gcig pa ni/ zab mo'i chos bshad pas spro ba bskyed par bya ste/ ji skad du/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā' ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// bla med byed par nus pa yin// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag

/de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas nas smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa bla med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams 'dir ni dwang bas na// rang byung skal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes brjod la de'i don bshad do// bcu gnyis pa ni/ sang nyin par dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur bas sngar byin pa'i ku sha dag sngas dang stan du gyis la/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu phob la nyol zhig dang rmi lam du sngags kyi dngos grub ci ltar 'grub pa'i tshul mthong bar 'gyur ro// zhes bsgos la nyal du gzhug go /slob dpon gyis bsrung ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i sngags mang du bzlas shing*/ sang nang par slob ma dag gi rmi lam dris te/ de la dge ba'i rmi lam ni/ sangs rgyas dang de'i sku gzugs dang*/ mchod rten rnams mthong zhing de dag la mchod pa byed pa dang*/ dge slong la sogs pa las chos nyan pa dang*/ glegs bam klog pa dang*/ rgyal por dbang bskur ba dang*/ bzhon pa la zhon pa dang*/ nas dang 'bru dang zas thob pa la sogs pa dang*/ mi dge ba'i ltas ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzeg pa dang*/ ka ra bī ra'i me tog rgyas pa thu ba dang*/ bye ma'am thal chen la 'dzeg pa dang*/

bong bu zhon te lho phyogs su song ste ma log pa dang*/ spre'u zhon nas shar lho dang shar phyogs su 'gro ba la sogs pa rnams yin la/ de ltar dge ba'i ltas rnams la sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring gsum 'grub par bstan cing*/ mi dge ba'i ltas mthong ba rnams la ni chos thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu'i rang bzhin du bstan la gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bsrungs la/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor man ngag ji lta ba bzhin byin la/ bsreg blugs brgya rtsa brgyad dbul la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o// gsum pa ni de ltar sta gon rnams yongs su rdzogs nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la phyi nang yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod nas bstod pa bya zhing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa dang ma 'byor pa sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskangs la/ hūm̐ badz+ra u t+tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes pa'i sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg la/ slar yang mchod bstod bya/ bdag nyid bsrung zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan dgram pa la thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba/ rgyan dgram pa dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ sta gon byas pa'i gnas su dri bzang dang ba byung lngas byugs nas me tog gcal du bkram la/ der las thig gis cha dbye bar bya ste/ shar nub drang por tshangs thig gdab// tshangs pa'i thig gi shar nub tu// sor drug dor bar mtshan ma bya// de yi tshad kyis de steng nas// shar nub nya ris nya dang ni// mtshan ma'i steng du rgya gram gdab// de yis tshangs zur thig tu 'gyur// khru phyed tshad kyis rtsa thig gdab// de ni nang ma'i rtsa thig yin// de nyid nyis 'gyur bar ma'o// de yang nyis 'gyur phyi ma ste// rtsa thig gsum gyi phyi rol du// rang rang dkyil 'khor gsum po yi// cha chung gcig gnyis gcig gnyis gcig /gcig rnams zur thig bar du'o// tshangs las g.yas g.yon rtsa thig nas// drug pa'i bar du gnyis gsum gnyis// gcig gcig gcig go phyi ma yi// mda' yab rtse nas cha chung re// thig lnga gnyis gcig dor bar thig

/dang po ka rgyan rtse dang mnyam// de nas gsum po re re phri// lnga pa tshangs las g.yas g.yon du// gnyis dor de nas tshangs rtser thig /rwa dbus de las g.yas g.yon du// gnyis dor gdugs sogs rta babs kyi// rtsa ba'i tshangs las g.yas g.yon du// cha lnga dor bar cha gnyis pa'i// gyen du thig go de nang du// gnyis dor snam bu bzhi pa'i mtha'i// tshangs rtser zlum thig de nang du// cha phyed bskor la mda' yab nas// tshangs pa'i thig las g.yas g.yon du// cha chung gnyis re dor ba nas// snam bu dang po'i rtse nas bskor// slar yang 'phred du cha chung gnyis// dor zhing steng du gcig spangs nas// bskor zhing de bzhin pu shu yi// zur las gnyis bzhi gnyis bzhi ni// zlum thig pad rwa la sogs pa'o// dkyil 'khor gsum ka'i nang du ni// cha chen re re'i lha snam dang*// nang ma'i tshangs pa'i dbus nas ni// cha chen gsum gyis bskor bar bya// de nang gcig dang gcig nas bskor// tshangs pa'i thig gi g.yas g.yon du// cha chung gnyis dang gcig la ni// thig re btab pas le dgur 'gyur// zhes pa ltar ras bal gyi skud pa ring du dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur dang*/ sboms su sgo'i nyi shu cha dang ldan pa/ rdo rgyus sam thod le skor dang lhan cig tu sbags la gdab par bya'o// de nas ye shes kyi thig gis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ srad bu rkyang pa lnga lnga gcig tu byas pa lnga/ tshon sna lngas kha dog bsgyur la snod so sor bzhag mchod pa lnga bsham/ slob dpon lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas thal mo sbyar ba'i dbus su srad bu lnga go rim bzhin bzhag la/ de dag bum̐ ām̐ hrīḥkham̐ hūm̐ rnams las sgrub thabs ltar rigs lngar bskyed la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la khyed kyis bdag la rdo rje'i thig stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab cing*/ mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla bar bskyed la/

'bar ba'i lta bas sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu spyan drangs la dam tshig gi srad bu la bstim ste de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi srad bur bsams la/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// de nas srad bu rnams sgrub grogs kyi lag par rim pa bzhin gtad la/ sangs rgyas sems can dbyer med par bsgoms nas/ oṃ a n+yo3 n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥs+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa/ sarba dharmāḥ.a t+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ zhes brjod cing dang po so so dang de nas gcig tu sgril nas gser la sogs pa'i snod du bzhag la mchod pas mchod cing lag pas reg la/ oṃ sū tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma ho hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod cing yi ge gsum bkod do// de nas oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes dang las bum gyi chus dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la gtor zhing slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas shar du bltas te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas thig skud rdo rje la dkris pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis lte bar bzung la sgrub pa'i grogs rnam snang du dmigs te/ shar nas nub tu bltas te 'dug pa'i lag tu dzaḥ lan gsum mam dgur brjod pas brkyang zhing*/ des kyang dzaḥgasum la sogs pa brjod la blangs te/ slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yas pas nam mkha' la thig gdab cing*/ oṃ badz+ra sū tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs// khyed kyi don mdzad dus 'di lags// thig skud sgra yis bskul nas ni// khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du slob dpon byang dang slob ma lhor gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa/ slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi logs thig dang*/ slob dpon rlung dang slob ma srin por gnas pas nub kyi logs thig dang*/

slob dpon de nyid du 'dug la slob ma dbang ldan du song la byang gi logs thig dang*/ slob dpon me dang slob ma srin por gnas pas lho'i logs thig dang*/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po dang*/ slob dpon bden bral dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa gdab cing*/ thams cad kyang g.yas su bskor bas so// de nas ye shes kyi thig skud la mchod bstod byas la badz+ra muḥs sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs su gsol// gnyis pa ni/ 'bras la sogs pa la kha bsgyur ba'i tshon sna lnga la dur khrod kyi thal bas sbags pa'i snod so sor bzhag ste/ dbus su sngon po la hūm̐/ shar du dkar po la bum̐/ lhor ser po la ām̐/ nub tu dmar po la hrīḥ byang du ljang gu la kham̐ bri/ mchod pa dang gtor ma yang bsham/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas tshon rnams la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge so so las sgrub thabs ltar rigs lngar bskyed/ sta gon gyi lha la khyed kyis bdag la rdo rje'i tshon stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab cing mig byin gyis brlabs la ye shes kyi tshon bkug nas bstim zhing*/ oṃ tsi tra sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ mchod pas mchod/ gtor ma phul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi phung po'i rang bzhin gyi tshon du bsam mo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub sgor song la/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hoḥzhes pa'i sngags rgyas ye shes kyi thig nam mkhar bteg la rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs te phyogs bzhir bltas la hi hi zhes brjod cing*/ sgo'i thad ka'i logs thig rnams dbyi la/ de nas kha shar du bltas la/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste// sems can khams ni grol byed pa// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// rnam snang mdzad rgyal bdag ces pa'i// tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam// oṃ tsi tra mā ti kra ma ye sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes brjod cing dbang ldan nas brtsams te/

sgo tshad gcig gi bar la g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis tshon rtsi blangs la nang nas rim pa bzhin re kha lnga bris nas thod pas bkab rdo rjes mnan la mchod pa bya zhing dbus kyi phur bu'i khung bu yod na dgang ngo*// de nas las kyi rdo rjes bri bar bya ste/ dbus kyi re mig ni sngon po/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang thams cad phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ dbus kyi ka ba dang gdung zlum rnams kyi gzhi sngon po la rdo rje rtse gsum pa ser pos mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol 'od zer lnga'i phreng ba/ re mig dang lha snam gsum phyogs mdog nang ma'i rtsig pa dkar po/ bar ma'i phyi nas sngo dkar dmar/ phyi ma'i dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba/ rtsig pa rnams kyi phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po/ pha gu ser po/ drwa phyed kyi gzhi sngon po la drwa ba dkar po/ shar bu sngon po/ mda' yab khra bo/ sgo'i phyi rol gyi nam mkha' stong pa cha chung gcig sngon po/ dkyil 'khor nang ma gnyis kyi sgo la rgyan sna drug sogs sgo rgyan ci mdzes/ phyi ma la ka ba ka rgyan phyogs mdog rta babs kyi snam bu bzhi dang pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs sogs mdzes tshon/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon gyi rdo rje'i rwa dang kyog po'i nang rnams phyogs mdog 'og gzhi'i khyams ljang gu/ pad+ma sna tshogs/ rdo rwa gzhi nag po la rdo rje dkar po/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi nag po la phyogs skyong brgyad kyi mtshan ma dang*/ klu dang*/ shing dang*/ sprin dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ me dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ chu dang*/ rnal 'byor pa dang*/ ro dang 'dre la sogs pa ci nus bri/ me ri kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas skor du bri'o// de nas sgrub thabs ltar lha so so'i gnas su nyi ma la gnas pa'i gdan bkod la/ der lha'i sku lha so so'i sngags zlos shing dngos su bzhugs su gsol ba'am/ so so'i sa bon bri ba'am/ so so'i g.yas kyi phyag mtshan dang po rdo rje la sogs pa 'od zer lnga'i phreng bas brgyan pa bri'o// de ltar bri ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la yang yang brtags la nor ba rnams bcos shing dag par byas nas tshon lhag ma rnams la mchod bstod byas nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ
