zhes pas sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs su gsol zhing ye shes kyi thig sngar nam mkha' la bteg pa de nyid kyang dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bstim par bya'o// gsum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu dri yis byug chu bzhi me nas g.yas skor dang*/ me tog la sogs pa dbang ldan nas g.yon skor du bsham zhing*/ mchod pa rnams kyang sngar sta gon las mi nyung bar bsham/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ sngon 'gro nas phyi rol pa'i gtor ma rnams kyang bsham/ bla re dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang gos zung la sogs pas kyang mdzes par byas/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i phyir gdong g.yogs dang*/ me tog phreng ba dang*/ dbu rgyan dang*/ rdo rje dril bu rnams slob ma du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa thun mong du me long*/ mda' gzhu/ pusti dang*/ dung*/ 'khor lo rnams dang*/ mchod pa lnga tshan drug dang*/ las thams cad pa'i mchod pa rnams kyang bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor yang bri'o// de nas bum pa sta gon gyi skabs ltar bum pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa dang bzlas pa byas te bum pa kun nas chu cung zad re dung chos kyi nang du blugs la/ de rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du bzhag las kyi rdo rjes bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas shing las bum bzung nas de'i chus phyogs kun tu gtor/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa dang gzhan rnams kyis bum pa rnams bzung nas gtso bo'i sngags bzla bzhin du rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la lan gsum du bskor te rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang gi shar du gtso bo'i snying po lan bdun bzlas pas rnam rgyal bum pa dbul/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes brjod cing bdug pas bdug de bzhin du so so'i sngags bdun bdun bzlas pas rnam rgyal gyi g.yas su shar gyi bum pa dang gzhan rnams phyogs so so dang las bum dbang ldan du bkod la bgegs rnams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol zhes brjod la gu gul gyi dud pas bdug par bya'o// bzhi pa sgrub cing mchod pa la/

sngon 'gro bdag gi rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa/ rjes lhag chad kha bskang ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ phyi ma red dam srod kyi dus su khrus bya/ 'khor los sgyur ba'am he ru ka'i chas gang rung gi rgyan la sogs pas brgyan/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor stan la 'dug ste sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang ba dang mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ zhu phul ba nas brtsams te ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor dag pa dran pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab bo// gnyis pa la dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'byin pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bya ba'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa dang bzhi'i dang po ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor las thams cad pas bsang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs la stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa nas brtsams te gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ rang shar phyogs kyi sgo khang na gnas pa'i thugs ka nas/ yi ge hūm̐ spros la de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi mtshan ma la thim pas de rang gi sems so sor rtog par mos la/ dang por sbyor ba'i tshul gyis gtso bo bskyed/ de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi tshul gyis 'khor rnams thugs ka nas spros mdzad pa mdzad/ slar 'dus so so'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu gyur pa las 'khor rnams bskyed do// gnyis pa ni rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar gnas pa la lus kyis rdo rje gsor zhing ngag tu las thams cad pa dang drag mo la sogs pa brgyad kyi sngags brjod pas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad la/

lha mo brgyad kyis mchod nas/ sgo ma bzhi'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas/ slar yang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa la mchod nas dgug gzhug ro gcig tu bya'o// gsum pa dang bzhi pa yang sgrub thabs su bstan pa ltar byas nas lha so so'i sngags bdun bdun dang thun mong du yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas pas brtan par bya'o// gsum pa la nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa dang*/ phyi rol du 'byung po la gtor mas mchod pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de ltar mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrubs pa de nyid la/ phyi'i mchod pa nas brtsams te/ dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin pa'i bar mchod phreng ltar rgyas par bya zhing*/ 'das pa'i gtor ma skabs 'dir 'bul ba'am/ 'og bdag 'jug gi rjes su bya ba gang bde bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa'i grogs la gtso bo'i sngags zlo bas dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug nas slob dpon rang rdo rje dril bu bzung la/ sgrub g.yog gzhan gyis dung dang cha lang la sogs pa khyer la sgo las phyi rol du song la 'dug ste/ maṇ+ḍal bri ba nas brtsams nas gshegs su gsol ba'i bar gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ gtso bo'i sngags bzlas pas bar du gcod pa rnams zhi bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i nang du log pa dang cho ga lhag chad dang yo byad ma 'byor pa la sogs pa thams cad bshags pa'i phyir/ dngos su dkyil 'khor la shong na rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing lan bdun bskor ba bya/ dngos su mi shong na yid kyis 'dod yon gyi sa nas skor ba byed par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing ngag tu yi ge brgya pa ci nus pa bzlas par byas te/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa thams cad dang*/

cho ga lhag pa dang ma tshang bar gyur pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor pa dang*/ nyams pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la skyon du gyur pa la sogs pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo// de nas sbyin sreg gi cho ga ltar rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gis lha mnyes par bya'o// drug pa bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor mngon sum ltar dmigs la de'i shar phyogs kyi sgo khang la 'dug par mos te/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po la gsol ba gdab pa nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga ma lus pa dang*/ dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod pa'i bar dbang gong ma dang bcas pa rdzogs par blang bar bya'o// de'i tshe las kyi bya ba thams cad ni gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pa zhig gis mdzad par bsgom mo// de ltar bdag 'jug rdzogs pa dang slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing glu 'di dag blang bar bya ste/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyis rjes chags pa// 'dod pa chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod// shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems su bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi yid la bzhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid// 'dod chags mnyam pa'i bdag nyid mchog

/ces dang*/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// bden pa de yis mgon bdag la// khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*// de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// dri med kun gyis mthong bar shog /ces brjod/ de nas sngar ma btang na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma cho ga bzhin du btang la tshogs kyi yo byad bza' ba dang btung ba rnams blangs la byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa nas brtsams te/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams bza' ba dang btung bas tshim par byas la lhag ma'i gtor ma btang*/ de'i rjes la 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'ang btang ste/ 'das pa'i gtor ma bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir bzhag la slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga bya'o// gnyis pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ der dbang bskur ba gnyis kyi dang po la/ phyi rol du bya ba'i cho ga nang du gzhug pa/ nang du bya ba'i cho ga gsum gyi dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang*/ gdong g.yogs dang me tog phreng ba la sogs pa nye bar dgos pa'i yo byad kun bzung la/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa yod na de'i sgo drung tu song la bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa med na dkyil 'khor dang bar du yol bas bcad la bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas la/ sta gon dus ji ltar gral la 'dug pa ltar gral rim bzhin 'khod/ maṇ+ḍal phul te me tog gis snyim pa bkang la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol// sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba'i// mi ldog 'khor lo'i 'byor par ldan// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog

/gsang ba chen por 'jug par bgyi// gsang ba'i rigs mchog thams cad du// slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod// mi ldog pa yi dbang bskur ba// skal ba chen po bdag la stsol// mtshan rnams kun gyi rgyas gdab cing*// dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan// sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba// slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol// dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che// sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur// slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol// zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs la/ rnam dag slob ma 'di zhes pa// byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin zhing*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nas// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa 'tshal// zhes lan gsum brjod pas gsol ba btab nas/ gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag las// gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa ru// bdag po chen po khyod 'dod dam// zhes dri/ slob mas kyang*/ gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag las// gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni// sems dpa' chen po bdag 'tshal lo// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas sdom pa bsgrag par bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// blo chen khyod kyis gzung bya ste// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon khyod kyis gzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsung*// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bya// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya// de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni// phas pham par ni rab tu bshad// spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste// rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// nyin re zhing ni bzla bar bya// gal te nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya// ma byin par yang blang mi bya// 'dod pas log par mi spyad cing*// brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o// phung krol kun gyi rtsa ba yi// chang ni rnam par spang bar bya// sems can 'dul phyir ma gtogs pa// bya ba ma yin thams cad spang*// dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*// rnal 'byor pa kun bsnyen bkur bya// lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*// ngag gi rnam pa bzhi rnams dang*// yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni// ci nus par ni rjes su skyong*// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs// 'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang*// rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// khyed kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing*// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o// 'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad// khyed kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya// rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni// gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad// ces lan gcig brjod la de'i don bshad do// de nas slob mas/

bdag ni thog ma med dus nas// la sogs pa'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// zhes sogs sdom pa bzung ba lan gsum bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis gos dmar po dang rdo rje bzung bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra bo dhi a laṅkā ra was+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pas gos dmar po byin/ phyag len la oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa ham̐/ zhes pas stod g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ gis gtsug tor bcing ba yang kha bskang ngo*// de nas oṃ tsak+ṣurban+dha wa ra ma na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas ras dmar pos gdong bcing*/ las thams cad pa'i bum chus gtor zhing bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod pas bsrung*/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ zhes pas me tog sna tshogs pa'i phreng ba lag tu gtad/ slob ma'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ nag po bsams la/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams sbyang bar bsams la/ yi ge gsum brjod cing gnas gsum du phyag rgyas reg ste/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa las/ mthe bong gnyis bteg pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ste/ sku byin gyis brlab pa'i phyag rgya'o// de nyid las g.yon pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug ste g.yas pa'i mthe bong bteg pa ni 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ste gsung byin gyis brlab pa'i phyag rgya'o// de nyid las g.yas pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug ste g.yon pa'i mthe bong bteg pa ni rdo rje 'chang gi ste thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i phyag rgya'o// zhes pa ltar bya/ yang na lag pa gnyis rgyab sbyar nas sor mo rnams phan tshun dkris la mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug pa 'khor lo'i phyag rgya gnas gsum lte ba gsang gnas rnams su reg cing hūm̐ zhes brjod par bya'o// de nas rigs nges pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis/

bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dri/ des kyang*/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes lan gdab/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes dri/ des kyang sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes brjod/ de nas slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba gcig dpon slob gnyis kas bsgoms la/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi zhes brjod la/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas brtan par byas nas/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes pas gsang bar gdams so// gnyis pa ni/ oṃ ki li ki li ma li gu ni twaṃ badz+ra satwa tsa le yum̐ yum̐ swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'don zhing lag pa nas bzung ste dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i nang du gzhug par bya'o// gsum pa la sngon 'gro byin gyis brlab cing lus dbul ba/ dngos gzhi dam la bzhag cing ye shes dbab pa/ mjug snang ba 'dri zhing dkyil 'khor bstan pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ slob ma sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed la/ de'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la āḥ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ bsams la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor/ oṃ sangs rgyas kun du nyer gnas phyir// bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// oṃ slob dpon du ni nyer gnas phyir// bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// oṃ sems can thams cad skyabs don du// bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// ces brjod cing phyag byas nas lus dbul bar bya'o// gnyis pa la sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa/

dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa/ rjes brtan par bya ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ de nas rdo rje dril bu gnyis 'dzin pas slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bzung la/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje bsgoms nas/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes dang*/ slob mas sa ma ya a haṃ zhes brjod la/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzung nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ de lta bu'i sems bskyed par bya yis khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra shig dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa dang*/ snying gar rdo rje bzung la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes pas nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu blud cing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub pas// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ āḥswā hā/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta ud ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes pas gnyis ka'i sgo nas dang*/ yang mgo bor rdo rje bzung la/ de ring phan chad bu khyod kyi// phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis// nga yis cung zad gang smras pa// de dag thams cad khyod kyis ni// nges pa kho nar bya dgos so// bdag la smad par bya ba min// smad na bar chod ma spangs par// dus kyi bya ba byas nas ni// dmyal ba nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes brjod pas bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/

zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ lus kyi spyod lam tsog pu long bu bgrad pa ma snyes par 'dug du bcug ste/ dmigs pa la langs nas 'dug par bsams la/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor yaṃ gis mtshan pa gzhu'i dbyibs can/ chang zung thur la bstan pa'i steng du slob ma skad cig gis gsung rdo rje 'od dpag tu med pa bsgoms pa'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa'i bar du/ me'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i dbus na dzhaiṃ ljang gu/ snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi rdo rje rtse gsum pa la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po bum pa la āḥ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor la ha bsgoms la/ 'og gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyod pas me sbar/ de long bu'i rtsa nas zhugs te lte ba'i bar du 'bar bas/ de'i drod kyis snying ga'i sa bsreg mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis yas mar mnan/ 'og gi rlung gis mas yar 'degs bzhin pa la/ mdun gyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu so bdun gyi thugs ka dang phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes dang po'i rdo rje'i rnam pas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas dpag tu med par 'jug par dpon slob gnyis kas bsgoms la/ slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃ zhes brjod cing yang yang du gsal bar byas la/ ro ras dang zla mtshan dang ldan pa'i 'doms gyi ras/ byi la'i brun/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ro'i kha nas byung ba'i gu gul rnams thod pa'i nang du ro sol gyi mes bsregs pa'i dud pas bdug cing*/ rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis 'dug la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing*/ oṃ lo le lo le hūm̐ āḥzhes dang*/ ā be sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃ zhes brgyar bzlas shing rol mo dang bcas pas dbab pas sku babs na 'phar g.yo/

gsung babs na sngags smra ba/ thugs babs na dus gsum yongs su shes pa skye/ gal te gsung babs nas smra ma 'dod na lce la a dkar po bsams la/ gsungs shig rdo rje dge'o dge /zhes dris na dge mi dge ston par 'gyur ro// gsum pa ni de ltar babs pa'i ye shes pa de brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod cing*/ phebs pa ma zhi na oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya pra ti pā li ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swā hā/ zhes pas dmigs pa brtan du gzhug go /gsum pa ni/ gdong g.yogs dang bcas pa'i slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du khrid de/ khyod kyi mig lam na ji ltar snang zhes dris pas dkar ser dmar nag ljang ba'am sna tshogs su snang ngo zhes zer na zhi rgyas dbang drag las sna tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi skal ba dang ldan no// bla mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// rdo rje sems dpa'i grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces pas dkyil 'khor la gsol ba btab la/ sngar gyi me tog gi phreng ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung*/ sgo gsum gyi yi ge gsum las spros pa'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang gsal zhing sdig pa bkrus par mos/ bla mas kyang de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas gus pa sngon du 'gro bas gtso bo'i mdun du gnas te me tog phul bar mos la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod pas me tog 'dor du gzhug lha'i mdzod spu'am gtsug tor du me tog lhung na phyag chen/ spyan nam zhal la sngags/ sku stod la mchog bar la 'bring*/ 'og gi cha la dman pa/ slar yang phyir lhung na phra mo'i dngos grub 'grub/

rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol du lhung na dngos grub kyang med pas dkyil 'khor yang mi bstan/ de nas me tog slob ma'i mgo la bcings te/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba laṃ/ stobs po chen po sems dpa' che// 'di ni so sor gzung bar bya// zhes brjod la rigs kyi lha ngo sprad cing*/ de'i rnal 'byor sbyin te me tog phreng ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas slob ma'i snying gar zla ba la rigs kyi bdag po'i sa bon/ dpral bar raṃ/ mig gnyis la 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ bsgoms nas/ bla mas/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ ā swā hā/ zhes brjod la gdong g.yogs phye/ slob mas bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas la/ bla mas/ dkyil 'khor 'di la da lta nyid// dad pa'i shugs kyis blta bar bya// khyod kyang sangs rgyas rigs las skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab// ces spro ba bskyed la dkyil 'khor bltar gzhug /slar yang slob mas bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so// oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor bdag gis de ring mthong*// oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ sa ma ya ho ho ho zhes brjod la bris pa'i dkyil 'khor phyi rol srung 'khor dur khrod nas gzhal yas khang dang shar phyogs kyi sgo drung nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i bar du rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ming rgyas par brjod pas bstan par byas te dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// //gnyis pa dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ shis par bya ba/ dbang bskur ba dngos dang gsum gyi dang po ni/

slob mas bla ma la phyag byas te maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste// bde gshegs rnams kyis bde stsol mdzod// byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi// yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa// ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yis// dbang gi mchog ni bskur ba bzhin// de bzhin bdag la 'khor ba yi// sdug bsngal rnams ni bsal bar mdzod// rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig pa yi rab rib 'joms// gang gis byang chub bla med pa// de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ gnyis pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khru do tsam gyis legs par byugs pa la/ tshon dkar pos nang pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ phyi gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ 'dod yon/ pha gu/ drwa ba/ drwa phyed/ mda' yab la sogs pa tshang mar bris la/ de'i steng du khri bzang po bzhag de'i g.yas bdag gi g.yon phyogs nas zhabs bkru ba'i chu dri zhim po dang*/ zhal bsil gyi chu 'o ma dang sbyar ba dang*/ bsang gtor gyi chu gtsang ma la me tog dkar po bcug pa ste bzhi dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ chu gtsang ma ste sbyang ba'i yo byad gnyis bsham mo// bdag gi g.yas slob ma'i g.yon phyogs nas me tog dang spos dang mar me dang dri dang lha bshos te mchod pa'i yo byad lnga bsham mo// mdun du bzed zhal gyi snod gnyis dang mes bkang ba'i kham phor bzhag go /steng du bla re dang*/ g.yas su gdugs dkar po dang*/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang*/ dung la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad rnams ci ltar 'tsham pa'i gnas su sta gon byas la/ slob ma rnams la ba'i rnam lnga dang*/ dri lnga dang*/ mar khu dang*/ shun lpags lnga dang*/ dri zhim po'i chus kyang khrus byas la dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag la/ de thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa rdo rje sems dpar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la/ dang por oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ zhes pas zhabs bsil dang*/ nai wi tis zhal bsil gnyis bzed zhal du blug go

/ku shas lus thams cad la sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā zhes brjod la gtor/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ zhes brjod la mchod yon phyag tu phul/ de nas khu tshur gnyis kyis yungs kar blangs la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra sa twa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing g.yas dang g.yon gyis bskor la kham phor gyi mer dor/ de bzhin du khu tshur gyis chu blangs la oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bskor la mer dor la me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ bum pa rnams lag tu blangs la sgrub g.yog dang bcas pas/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin gser gyi ri bo lta bu'i mdog /'jig rten gsum mgon dri ma gsum ni rab tu spangs// sangs rgyas chu skyes 'dab rgyas lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir khyod la bkra shis shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// dam chos rab mchog skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'jig rten bkra shis gnyis pa deng 'dir khyed la shog /dam pa'i chos dang ldan zhing thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /dge 'dun lha dang lha ma yin dang mis mchod pa// ngo tsha dpal gnas tshogs kyi nang na rab kyi mchog /'jig rten bkra shis gsum pa deng 'dir khyod la shog /dga' ldan lha yi gzhal med khang ni snying por gnas// 'gro la phan phyir bde gshegs dbang por bcas pa'i lha// rjes su 'brang ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /'dab gsar 'tsher ba'i me tog char 'bab lum+bi'i tshal// mang po lha yis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na// srid pa'i mthar gyur pa yi bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir= /sna tshogs skyon rnams rnam par gzhom par bya ba'i phyir// dgyes pas dka' thub tshal du nam phyed mngon par byung*// dbang bcas lha rnams rjes su 'brang ba'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir=

/chu bo'i 'gram du mchod yon phreng bas yongs su bskor// zhi phyir ngo mtshar gyur pa srid pa dag byed pa// klu yi rgyal pos legs par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir= /grong khyer mchog gyur ser skya zhes ni bya ba der// smad du grags pa chen po'i lha yis mngon bstod pa// bsam yas dge bsgrub de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir= /sems can thams cad la ni phan phyir byang chub pa// dam chos rin chen tshogs ni thub pa las byung ba// sems can don bsgrub rab rgyas brtson pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir= /rab tu 'od 'bar gser mdog lta bu'i sku mnga' ba// bai ḍūr+ya mdog lta bu'i rtswa gdan steng du bzhugs// skyil krung legs bcas mi g.yo sku mnga'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir= /shing gi rgyal po'i rtsa bar bcom ldan byams stobs kyis// bdud tshogs kun las rnam par rgyal tshe sa dang mkhar// rnam pa sna tshogs ngo mtshar gyur pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir= /bā ra ṇā sīr bzhugs nas bde bar gshegs ston pas// sa dang mkha' la ngo mtshar shin tu gsal byung bas// chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor ba'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir= /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa mchod phyir thogs// bsod nams bya byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa// bcom ldan thub pa shākya seng ges gang gsungs pa'i// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /ces brjod cing me tog dor bas shis par bya'o// gsum pa la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rnam par rgyal bar bum pa kun gyi chu bsdus la maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag ste/ bdag dang slob ma dbang rdzas gsum ka shū n+ya tās stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum dang bcas pa sgrub thabs ltar bskyed pa ni bsnyen pa'o// snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te sgo ma bzhi'i sngags rgyas rang dang slob ma dbang rdzas gsum ka la bstim pa ni nye bar sgrub pa'o// skye mched drug dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni sgrub pa'o// slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs pa la/

oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis slob dpon dang dbang rdzas la dbang bskur bas mi bskyod pa'i rgyas gdab pa ni slob dpon dang dbang rdzas kyi sgrub chen no// de nas slob ma'i sgrub chen bya ba'i phyir mdun gyi dbang gi lha rnams la slob dpon gyis mchod cing*/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de bzhin 'di la stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ slob ma rnams kyis kyang*/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur te/ bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur/ yum bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ sgo ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i las byas par bsams la/ bum pa mgor bzhag cing*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// zhes dang lha so so'i sngags kyi mjug tu badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes btags pas dbang bskur/ chu 'thung zhing khrus byas pas lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam pa ni slob ma'i sgrub pa chen po'o// de ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs pa la mchod pa lngas mchod la/ mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phur po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go zhes rtogs pa bskyed pa ni chu'i dbang ngo*// de bzhin du ām̐ dang rin po che las slob ma dang dbu rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/

yum mā ma kī sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bcu gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor bar bskyed/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du bsams la/ rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs cod paṇa dag gi dbang*// de ring khyod la dbang bskur bas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// oṃ mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ zhes gsung zhing dbu rgyan spyi bor bcing*/ lho phyogs kyi bum pas dbang bskur te rin 'byung gi rgyas btab la/ rin 'byung gi sgo nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces go bar byas la/ gzhan gong 'og gi cho ga rnams sngar dang 'dra bar bya ba ni cod paṇa gyi dbang ngo*// yang hrīḥdang pad+ma las 'od dpag med dmar po phyag bzhi pa/ gos dkar mo phyag brgyad ma dang mnyam par sbyor bar bskyed/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer bltas la/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang gis ni// de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// shin tu grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho badz+ra wa ra ta ka hūm̐/ zhes dang nub kyi bum pas dbang bskur te 'od dpag med kyi rgyas btab la/ 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med yab yum gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed pa ni rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// yang kham̐ dang ral gri las don yod grub pa phyag bzhi pa sgrol ma phyag brgyad mas 'khyud pa bskyed/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur bltas la/ oṃ a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dril bu dang byang gi bum pas dbang bskur te don yod grub pa'i rgyas btab la/

don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog dag 'du byed gyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed pa ni dril bu'i dbang ngo*// yang slob ma buṃ las rnam snang phyag bzhi pa spyan ma phyag brgyad mas 'khyud pa bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi badz+ra nā maḥ a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal rdo rje zhes bya'o// zhes rigs dang mthun pa'i ming gdags te/ bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ a la la rdo rje/ shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje/ myu gu rdo rje/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ kye'i rdo rje/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rnam snang chen po/ rang byung rdo rje/ rdo rje ā ral+li/ skems pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje bdud rtsi/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor/ rdo rje khro bo/ snying rje'i stobs/ he ru ka rdo rje ste mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi ming bcu bdun no// rnam par snang mdzad/ mdzes pa'i rdo rje/ ye shes rdo rje/ pha rol phyin pa'i rdo rje/ rtag pa'i rdo rje/ gti mug rdo rje/ thams cad skyob/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje/ oṃ mdzad rdo rje/ sku rdo rje/ sa'i snying po/ gti mug rdo rje/ gshin rje'i gshed/ tho ba'i dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs pa/ shākya thub pa/ sangs rgyas te rnam snang gi rigs kyi ming bcu bdun dang*/ shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ yid bzhin nor bu/ dam pa dga' ba'i rdo rje/ shin tu bde ba dga' ba'i rdo rje/ nyi ma rin chen bdag po/ rin chen rgyal po/ rdo rje gzi brjid/ rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje bdud rtsi zil gnon/ snang byed rdo rje ste rin chen rigs kyi ming bcu gnyis dang*/

'od dpag tu med pa/ pad+ma rdo rje/ pad+ma myu gu rdo rje/ pad+ma lcags kyu rdo rje/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo rje/ rta mgrin/ 'jig rten bdag po/ rdo rje chos/ spyan ras gzigs/ pad+ma gar dbang ste 'od dpag med kyi rigs kyi ming bcu'o// nam mkha' rdo rje/ 'jug pa'i rdo rje/ shes rab myu gu/ shes rab rdo rje/ snying rje'i myu gu/ dam pa'i rta/ rta'i rgyal po/ bdun gyi rgyal po/ lcags rgyal/ dam tshig rdo rje/ rta mchog don yod rdo rje/ don yod grub pa/ las kyi rdo rje/ mgyogs 'gro rdo rje ste don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi ming bco lnga'o// rdo rje sems dpa'// rdo rje can/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje/ phyag na rdo rje/ dpe med rdo rje/ ro mnyam rdo rje/ shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje/ dam pa dang po'i rdo rje/ bde ba'i rdo rje ste drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi ming dgu'o// bud med kyi rigs kyi ming ni 'dir nye bar mi mkho bas ma bris so// de lta bu'i rigs kyi ming btags shing shar phyogs kyi bum pas dbang bskur te rnam snang gi rgyas btab la/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed de ming gi dbang ngo*// de nas/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba// gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha// chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med gang*// sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar bya// zhes brjod la de'i don bshad pas ngo sprad do// yang slob ma stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum pa phyag drug par bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur zhing mi bskyod pas rgyas btab nas/

rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las gser la sogs pa las grub pa'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ steng gi rwa lnga la dbus su rnam par snang mdzad/ shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa/ rwa'i 'og gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad la shar du spyan ras gzigs/ lhor byams pa/ nub tu nam mkha' mdzod/ byang du kun du bzang po/ byang shar du phyag na rdo rje/ shar lhor 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ lho nub tu sgrib pa rnam sel/ nub byang du sa'i snying po/ 'og gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad la shar du rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa ma/ nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ byang du rdo rje sgrol ma/ byang shar du skul byed ma dkar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos mchog sbyin g.yon dang pos pusti dang bcas pa'i pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis kyis lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ zla ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar lhor rin chen glog ma ser mo phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rin po che kha sbyor 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa dang mda'/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu lu gu rgyud ma nag mo nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje/ mda'/ rtse gsum/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu gzhu/ thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gzhan gyis mi thub ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje zhags pa dang rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon pa rnams kyis snying gar sdigs mdzub dang*/ dril bu dang dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa'o// 'og gi rwa lnga la/ dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal can phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang dgra s+t+wa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gsum na dril bu dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o// shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/

lhor gtum mo dmar mo/ nub tu ro langs ma sngon mo/ byang du 'jigs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gser btso ma'i mdog can thams cad kyang seng ge la sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa phyag gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa rnams bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur te lha thams cad la mi bskyod pa'i rgyas btab la de slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yas par bzung ste/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// rdo rje snying po'i brtul zhugs brten// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod la slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par gtad pa ni brtul zhugs kyi dbang ngo*// de nas slob mas/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// zhes pas gsol ba btab la/ slob dpon rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las/ sngags phreng gnyis pa 'od zer dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i snying gar thim pas sngags rnams la dbang thob par bsgoms la gtso bo'i sngags sam lha thams cad kyi snying po lan gsum du rjes zlos byas la/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod la mgo bor me tog bzhag go /de nas khyod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ sgrub thabs dang*/ phyag rgya la sogs pa thams cad su yang rung ba la smras na khyod nyams par gyur ta re/ de bas na thams cad su la yang ma smra shig ces bsgos la/ slob mas gtso bos ci ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal// zhes brjod cing lus longs spyod thams cad blos phul la/

deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags te// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol// zhes brjod la phyag 'tshal te/ rdo rje slob ma'i skal ba tsam la dbang ba rnams gzhan du 'gro bar bya ste rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi cho ga'o// gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la/ bum pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba'i dbang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ bzhi pa'i dbang dang bzhi'i dang po la/ sngon 'gro yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ dngos gzhi slob dpon du dbang bskur ba/ mjug mtha' rten sbyin pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ slob dpon du 'os shing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa gcig la dbang bskur bar bya ba yin gyi thams cad la dbang bskur bar bya ba ni ma yin la/ gal te slob dpon du 'os pa 'ga' zhig yod na/ dang po gsol ba dus gcig tu btab nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi dbang stegs kyi khar slob ma re re nas dbang bskur nas de'i mtha' rten rnams dus gcig la bya ste/ de'ang phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// ji ltar mchod chen stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa ni/ dbang stegs kyi steng du slob ma rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya chen pos bzhag la/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi snying ga'i sa bon las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa nam mkha' gang ba sprul la/ de dag gis kyang mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa bsnams nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing dbang bskur bar bsams la/ dngos su yang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas mdzes pa dang*/ bkra shis kyi glu dang rol mo bya zhing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po che// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// zhes sogs kyi rig pa'i dbang lnga mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bskur nas/

dam tshig gsum sbyin par bya ste/ rdo rje hūm̐ las ci skad bshad pa'i rnam pa ltar bskyed la/ 'di de zhes bya ba la sogs pas slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par byin la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /ces de kho na nyid bstan pa rdo rje'i dam tshig go /de nas dril bu āḥlas 'khar ba la sogs pa las grub pa tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yab dang bcas pa/ khog pa'i steng gi ut+pa la gyi 'dab ma la shar du lha mo sgrol ma/ lhor spyan ma/ nub tu mā ma kī/ byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du nor rgyun ma ser mo g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon 'bras so ba'i char pa dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor tsun+da ma sngar bzhin/ lho nub tu khro gnyer can ma ser mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis kyis dbyug gu gsum pa dang ril ba chung ngu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rdo rje phreng ba ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis sgeg pa dang bcas pas me tog phreng ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i phreng ba 'dzin pa rnams bsgom/ steng gi rdo rje la ni sngar rdo rje'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin rigs lnga dang byang sems brgyad bsgoms te thams cad kyang skad cig tsam gyis bskyed la/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur la lha thams cad la don yod grub pa'i rgyas btab la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces pas slob ma'i lag pa g.yon par byin la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog

/srid pa mchog ni byed pa yin// zhes pas de kho na nyid brjod pa ni dril bu gsung gi dam tshig go /de nas shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// ces brjod pas slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la/ lag pa gnyis 'khyud pa'i stangs ka byed du bcug la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung shig rdo rje rab gnas pa// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes dang*/ de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*// sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir// shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni// ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du// rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa// dam tshig phyag rgya zhes su bsgrags// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// zhes pa ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig go /de nas nam mkhar dkyil 'khor spro ba'i ting nge 'dzin snga ma lta bu dang ldan pas/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ glu dang rol mo dang bkra shis dang bcas pas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la// zhes sogs tshigs bcad dang gtso bo'i sngags kyi mjug tu badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur/ de bzhin du lha so so'i sngags kyi mjug tu a bhi ṣiñtsa btags la bum pa so sos dbang bskur zhing khrus byas dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la dngos su dbur brgyan cing*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā zhes brjod cing me tog gtor mchod pas mchod/ de ltar slob ma re re nas rdzogs pa dang slob ma rnams la de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/

dkyil 'khor pad+ma zhes su gsungs// yid kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa nyid// gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ste// sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs 'phags// de yi phyi rol gru bzhi pa'i// tshad ni mnyam par gyur pa'o// gang zhig byams pa la sogs sems// thig skud bzhir ni brjod pa'o// thig gdab yang dag bshad pa ni// sbyor ba chos kyi rjes dran pa'o// lta ba kun las rnam rol ba// ye shes thig tu brjod pa yin// rgyan gang yang dag bshad pa nyid// tshul khrims sogs kyi sdom pa mchog /dbang po lnga la sogs pa'i sems// rwa ba lngar ni 'byung ba nyid// gang zhig sgo zhes bshad pa ni// rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi// rta babs ka ba bzhi po ni// yang dag spang ba bzhi zhes brjod// dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi// kha khyer bzhir ni brjod pa nyid// sgo khang bzhi ni gang yin pa// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi// de bzhin me tog phreng brgyan pa// byang chub yan lag bdun po yin// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni// ka ba brgyad po zhes brjod do// lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni// rnga yab tu ni yongs su grags// gang zhig do shal bshad pa ni// nyon mongs thams cad gcod pa ste// kun du gcod pa'i ngo bo yis// nyon mongs 'phrog pas drwa ba nyid// tshogs gnyis dag gi sbyor ba las// 'khor lo bskor ba gang yin pa// nyon mongs phyed ni gcod pas na// do shal phyed pa nyid du brjod// ces dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang*// phung po lnga ni mdor bsdu na// sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags// rdo rje skye mched nyid dag ni// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan zhes bya bar bshad// chu yi khams ni mā ma kī// gos dkar mo dang sgrol ma ni// me dang rlung du rab tu grags// gti mug gti mug longs spyod pas// gti mug zad pa gshin rje mthar// de ni phung po mthar byed de// des ni shes bya mthar byed pa'o// zhe sdang zhe sdang mthar byed pas// nyes pa zad pa shes rab mthar// des na sems kyi mthar byed de// des ni nyon mongs mthar byed 'gyur// 'dod chags 'dod chags longs spyod pas// 'dod chags zad pa pad+ma mthar// des ni ngag gi mthar byed 'gyur// de bzhin snyoms 'jug mthar byed do// nyon mongs kun zad gang yin dang*// de bzhin las kun zad pa nyid// sgrib pa kun zad ye shes ni// bgegs ni mthar byed ces byar bshad// ces pas lha'i de kho na nyid kyang brjod cing don rgyas par bshad do// gsum pa la/

rjes gnang sbyin pa/ lung bstan pa/ dbugs dbyung zhing gzengs bstod pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ slob ma rnams rang rang gi phyag rgya 'ching du bcug la/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas pa rnam rol zhing*// rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// dga' ston bde bas mchod par gyis// a/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya// des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur// phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no// oṃ/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi// glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya// de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni// myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur// gī/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya// sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyi// gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis// ho// rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs bgos pa'i// lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su// ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis// hūm̐/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog dor// byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis// bh+rūm̐/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas// rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru// sems can ma rig ldongs pa la// ye shes sgron mes gsal bar gyis// pra/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas// tshul khrims shes rab ting 'dzin dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi// byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos// ga /zhes pa lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// gser gyi thur ma med na rdo rje la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags bzlas te/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// ling tog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa hā ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥpram̐/ zhes mig la byug pa'i tshul du byas nas me long bstan te/

chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med par// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes brjod la/ aḥlas skyes pa'i dril bu byin la// thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas// kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal// zhes brjod cing dkrol du gzhug go /de nas hoḥzhes bya bas mda' gzhu byin la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig ces brjod de phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og tu mda' re 'phen pa'i tshul byed du gzhug go /yang me long bstan la/ a badz+ra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso// zhes dang*/ gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems 'di nyid yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod do// de nas chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang sbyin par phyir/ slob ma re re nas dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ zhes pas 'khor lo rkang pa'i 'og tu gzhug oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su dung dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes pas g.yon du dril bu dang*/ as lag pa gnyis kyi steng du rgyud kyi pusti byin la/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun du gang bar gyis// sngags kyi tshul gyi cho ga yis// skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan btags drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*// khyod la rtag tu srung bar mdzad// ces brjod la/

so so'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rnal 'byor du byas nas/ ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba// de lta de ltar sems can don// 'dod chags la sogs gtsang ba yis// sems can rnams la nye bar sbyor// zhes dang*/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// de bzhin du chos kyi gnas su rdo rje dang*/ rin chen dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ sna tshogs kyi sgra bcug ste tshigs su bcad pa lngas rjes su gnang ba byin nas/ byang chub snying po'i bar du ni// phyogs kun du ni 'khor lo ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med// kun du mchog tu rab tu bskor// thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas// sbyor med bral zhing ma zhum pas// sems can don ni da lta gyis// zhes chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin no// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon chos gos gyon te lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi sna seng ge'i rna ba lta bu byas la bzung*/ g.yas pas rdo rje dril bu bzung ste/ skye dang rga dang 'chi mi 'gyur// 'jigs dang mya ngan nad mi 'byung*// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// bu khyod nga yis lung bstan bya// 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan khyod// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bsgral to// kye che ge mo zhes bya ba yi// de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'og dang*// mi yul mtho ris nyid du 'grub// gang yang ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes brjod la che ge'i gnas su slob ma so so'i ming gzhug la lung bstan par bya'o// gsum pa ni/

mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi// dkyil 'khor mthong dang rab zhugs pas// sdig pa kun las nges grol bar// khyed rnams deng nas legs par gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// slar yang 'chi bar 'gyur ma yin// mi tshugs pa dang mi 'chi bas// cis kyang mi 'jigs rol par gyis// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir// ston pa mchog tu gyur pa yin// zhes pa 'bras bu'i dus kyi dbugs dbyung ba dang*// dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di// khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no// zhes pa dang*/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi// srog dang lus la bab gyur kyang*// dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems// slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya// rdo rje spun rnams bkur sti zhing*// sdang la byams shing chags bral ba// nam yang bya ba ma yin no// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas kyis// khyod ni dmyal ba'i nang du 'dor// zhes dang*/ srog chags bsad par mi bya zhing*// bud med rin chen yongs mi spang*// des ni slob dpon smad mi bya// sdom pa shin tu 'da' bar dka'// shes rab thabs kyi bsam pa yis// mi bya cung zad yod ma yin// ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ci bzhin// 'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde ster bsten par gyis// 'gro ba bde ba myur la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams phyin par 'gyur// zhes pas dbugs dbyung zhing gzengs bstod nas/ de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ sdom pa dang*/ dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang*/

sa dang po nas drug pa'i bar thob/ brda lnga bsdus rtse mos mnan pa/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub gyi rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed de bum pa'i dbang bskur ba 'khor dang bcas pa'o// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas// stong pa'i snying por phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba sh+lau ka lnga dang*/ de nyid bla med phyag 'tshal bas// yon tan mchog khyod bka' drin las// kun mkhyen rdo rje'i dbang gis ni// da lta nyid du bka' drin skyobs// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni// ci ltar dpal thugs rdo rje yis// rdo rje chos can la gsungs pa// de bzhin mgon pos bdag grub mdzod// bcom ldan zhabs pad spangs nas ni// gzhan du bdag ni 'gro ma mchis// 'khor ba'i 'gro las nges rgyal bar// de phyir mgon pos thugs rjes mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ slob dpon gyis gdong bcings ste/ slob dpon rang rnam par snang mdzad dang spyan ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba slob ma'i lce la bzhag par dpon slob gnyis kas bsgoms la/ sngon du bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu'am chang ngam zho'am sbrang rtsi la sbyar ba lce la bzhag cing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras la dbang bskur bzhin// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro// zhes brjod cing bdud rtsis dbang bskur nas/ de nas de kho na nyid kyang brjod par bya ste/ 'di ni de nyid bla na med// gnyis med yi ges brjod mi nus// chos dbyings rnam pa lta bu yis// dam pa'i bde ba yang dag myong*// zhes brjod cing bde stong 'dzin pa med pa la sems bzung*/ de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ de ltar na slob dpon gyi lus dang phyag rgya'i bha ga dang gnyis ka'i byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/

ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ dam tshig tu sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa la dbang*/ sa brgyad pa la dbang bar byas/ brda mtheb srin e la rig byed gcig 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas zhes rtogs pa bskyed de gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ yang slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed rdo rje rab sgrub phyed// rdo rje rnal 'byor yang dag 'byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// gtso bos bdag la de mdzad do// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs su ni// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ dpon slob gnyis ka 'od dpag med du bsgoms te gdong bcings nas/ rang gi sems la mngon par 'tshams pa ci skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can lo bcu drug lon pa'i mi'i bu mo mngon par bsams la/ de nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ngo bor mos la/ de'i lag pa thabs kyi g.yon par gtad de/ lha mo mthar byed dga' ster ma// sna tshogs gzugs ldan brtse ldan ma// zung shig zung shig sems dpa' che// bzung bar byas nas mchod par gyis// zhes brjod la gtad pa dang*/ phyag rgya des/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par// bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam// zhes dri bar bya'o// slob mas kyang de lta bu nus par dngos su lan bya ste/ bu spro'am zhes pa'i gnas su bdag spro zhing zhes pa dang*/ bu khyod ces pa'i gnas su bdag ni zhes pa dang*/ taṃ zhes pa'i gnas su to zhes bya'o// de nas slob ma 'od dpag med dang phyag rgya gos dkar mor bskyed/

mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab/ thabs 'di la bsten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa'i 'du shes gsum dran par byas la/ phyag rgya de gcer bur phyung nas pad+ma bltar gzhug cing*/ rmad byung nga yi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// rtag tu rim bzhin 'di la spyod// 'di dang nam yang mi 'bral lo// chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rnam par grol// bde chen rgyal po 'di nyid ni// rang bzhin thams cad la 'dun gnas// nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la// pad+ma la bzhugs bar du gsung*// bha ga nang du nam mkha' bzhin// 'byung ba lnga po rgyan bzhin 'chang*// lte ba la ni ge sar bcas// 'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan// der gnas na ni bsgom par bya// mi 'chi lha yi gzugs su ni// 'di la rtag tu 'jog pa yin// zhes brjod cing rang dang lhan cig tu gnas pas thog mar phyag rgya'i gzugs la blta ba dang*/ sgra la nyan pa la sogs pa chos drug nyams su myong bas bde ba de dang mi rtog par gyur ba dga' ba'i ye shes/ rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba mchog tu dga' ba'i ye shes/ phan tshun drud pa la sogs pa dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes dal bar rgyu ba'i rlung gi rtsa gnas rnams nas gnyis ka'i thig le dkar dmar babs pa/ de nyid rlung gi 'dren pa'i stobs kyis bzung bas bde ba mi rtog pas brgyan par gyur pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin la/ de nyid dkyil 'khor lha dang phyag rgya dang de kho na'i dbang dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa dang*// stobs rnams dang ni dbang rnams dang*// sa bcu po ni la gnas pa// rdo rje'i mtshan mar de 'gyur ro// rdo rje bcing ba'i sbyor ba yis// rdo rje mchod pa yang dag brtsam// rdo rje sems ni nges phyung nas// rdo rje lce yis bza' bar bya// mnyam par 'byung ba'i cho ga yis// dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bya// ting 'dzin las skyes sbyin sreg ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar bde ba dang mi rtog pa'i ngang la sems cung zad mnyam par 'jog tu bcug la gdong g.yogs bkrol nas/

de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam dbang chos kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ dam tshig tu bza' bsrung dang phyag rgya la mi smad cing mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang*/ sa bcu gcig pa thob/ brda byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku'i rten 'brel rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas zhes rtogs pa bskyed de dbang gsum pa'o// bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa ni/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ da ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// bdag la bka' drin legs par skyobs// ji ltar bla med byang chub de// byin gyi rlabs kyis bdag gis bsgrub// bla na med pa'i byang chub gnas// kun mchog spyod pa yang dag mchod// sems can gnas gsum 'khor ba rnams// de nyid la ni gzhag par bgyi// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas gdong bcings la/ tshig tsam gyi sgo nas ngo sprad par bya ste/ de yang rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi brtag pa gnyis pa'i rab byed dang por/ dbang chog 'dis sbyin par bya ste/ slob ma'i lhag par mos pa dang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i rigs pas/ lhag par mos pa'i yid kyis shes par byas nas/ tshig dbang rin po che sbyin par bya ste/ gang thob dbang rab mchog ni rigs kyi bdag pos bzung ba rnyed par dka' zhing mtshungs pa med pas bsdams// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing gi dpal dag blang bar byas pas byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dbang bskur ba// bka' yi gnang ba rnyed nas 'jig rten gsum gyi dgra bo las rgyal rtsom pa'i go cha bgos pa'i blos// byang chub dag la 'god pa'i sems rgyas 'dir ni de nyid rnal 'byor pa yi dri ma med par spyod// ces gsungs pa'i don cung zad bshad na/ dbang bzhi pa bstan pa'i yul/ de la bstan pa'i dbang dngos/ dbang thob nas nyams su blang bar gdams pa dang gsum gyi dang po ni/

bum dbang sogs sngon du song nas dbang bzhi pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga 'dis sbyin par bya'o// dbang de thams cad la sbyin par bya'am zhe na/ slob ma bla ma dang shes rab ye shes kyi nyams myong la lhag par mos pa dang*/ zab mo stong pa nyid dang*/ thabs rgya che ba'i rigs pas rim pa gnyis la lhag par mos pa'i slob ma la sbyin par bya'i gzhan la ni ma yin te/ bla ma la mos pa med na bla ma'i tshig la nges pa mi skye/ dbang gi nyams la mos pa med na pha rol tu phyin pa'i thos bsam byas pa dang khyad par med par 'gyur/ spros bral la mos pa med na 'dod chags dang khyad par med de/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i sems mi skye/ thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos pa med na gzhan 'dzin pa'i mthu med pas nyan thos rang rgyal dang khyad par med par 'gyur bas na de dag la mi sbyin no// des na dbang gong ma ni gong gi mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan mi ldan slob dpon gyi yid kyis legs par brtags la shes par bya ste/ grub thob la wa pas/ du ba las ni mer shes shing*// chu skyar las ni chur shes bya// byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi// rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes// bzhin gyi pad+ma rab dwangs shing*// dga' bas ba spu langs pa ni// mthong na mkhas pas de nyid kyis// slob ma dam par yongs su 'dzin// zhes pa ltar mtshan nyid shes nas/ tshig gi bzhi pa/ don gyi bzhi pa/ bzhi pa rten can/ mngon du gyur pa'i bzhi pa rnams las/ 'dir dbang gsum pa ltar don nyams su myong rgyu med pas tshig nyid kyi dbang rin po che sbyin par bya ste/ zab cing rgya che la mos na// tshig gi rin chen bskur bar bya// zhes pa ltar ro/ gnyis pa la bzhi pa skye ba'i rgyu dang*/ bzhi pa dngos kyi dang po ni/ dbang bzhi pa de rgyu gang las skye zhing thob ce na/ a bha yas/ de'i rjes la tshig kho nas dbang bzhi pa sbyin par bya'o// shes rab ye shes de nyid myu gur gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes bshad pa ltar/

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rab mchog rigs kyi bdag po'i kha dang rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bor rlung 'dren pa'i sgo nas thig le bzung bas gsum pa'i nyams myong man ngag med pa rnams kyis rnyed par dka' zhing dbab pa dang bzlog pa dang dgram pa la sogs pa mtshungs pa med pa'i man ngag gi sgo nas bde ba'i rten khams byang chub kyi sems nyid pha rol du 'phos pa med par rang gi lus la bsdams pa las skyes pa'i ye shes ni dngos kyi rgyu yin la/ bum pa la sogs pa dbang gzhan ni brgyud pa'i rgyu yin la/ de'i rgyu gsang dbang ste/ de'i rgyu ni bum pa'i dbang yin te/ dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ bzhi pa ngo sprod pa'i dpe ris su bri ba ni/ 'og tu bum dbang mtshon pa'i bum pa ser po dang*/ de'i steng du gsang dbang mtshon pa'i rdo rje dmar po dang*/ de'i steng du gsum pa mtshon pa'i chos 'byung dkar po dang*/ de'i steng du bzhi pa mtshon byed pad+ma'i sdong bu bdun la/ dang po la longs sku dkar po/ gnyis pa la bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang*/ gsum pa la bde ba chen po dang*/ bzhi pa la gsung rdo rje rnams dmar po/ lnga pa la btang snyoms kyi ye shes dkar po/ drug pa la thugs rdo rje nag po/ bdun pa la 'gog pa'i brda thig le nag po dang*/ 'gog pa dang bral ba'i sku bris nas/ steng phyogs su longs spyod rdzogs dang zhes sogs kyi sh+lau ka gnyis bri bar gsungs pa'i don yang*/ rgyu snga ma la brten nas 'bras bu phyi ma 'di dag skye zhes bya ba'i don yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar rgyu dbang gsum pa'i nyams myong la brten nas 'bras bu gang skye zhe na/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ de'i zhing gi dpal ni de skyed byed chos sku ste yan lag bdun gyi 'bras bu thob ste/ de gang zhe na/ dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med// snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med// yan lag bdun po nyid dang ldan pa'i bsgrub bya 'di// bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs bsgos blo can rnams kyang bsngags// zhes te de la longs spyod rdzogs ni mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku ste/

'di smos pas chos sku dang sprul sku yang shugs kyis bstan te sku gsum tha mi dad pa'i phyir ro// kha sbyor ni rang gi lha mo dang sbyar ba ste kha sbyar spangs pa'i longs sku tsam zhig ni phar phyin theg par yang bshad la/ de las khyad par du bya ba'i phyir kha sbyor smos so// gal te de ni mi dgos te lus thams cad la khyad par byed pa'i bde ba'i ngo bo tsam gyis don thams cad grub pa'i phyir ro zhe na ma yin te/ skye bo 'dod chags can rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyal bas kha sbyar bstan to// bde chen gyi kha sbyor yod kyang sgyu ma mkhan gyi skyes bus sprul pa'i skyes pa dang bud med kha sbyar ba bde ba chen por mi 'gyur la/ 'di ni 'byung ba'i phyir na bde chen te/ de la lus kyi bde ba nyams su myong bas lus bde ba dang*/ sems las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba ni yid bde ba yin la/ chen po ni rgya che ba dang*/ zag pa med pa dang*/ gya nom pa dang*/ 'khor ba ji srid par gnas pas na bde ba chen po'o// rang bzhin med pa ni bsgrub bya'i sangs rgyas nyid kyang rang bzhin med pa ste/ mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos gzhan zhig yod na'ang*/ de'ang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes pa ltar rang bzhin med pa yang rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid yin gyi/ ri bong gi rwa lta bu'i stong nyid du mi bzung ngo*// des na/ mdo las/ sbyin pa nas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi bar rnams dang ma bral ba'i stong nyid la rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid du gsungs pas/ longs sku la sogs pa'i ngo bo dang*/ sbyin sogs phar phyin rnams ni mchog yin te bum pa dang shing rta la sogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir ro// snying rjes yongs gang ni ji ltar lus kyi rnam pa med par sems can gyi don mi 'grub pa ltar/

snying rje chen po med par sems can gyi don bsgrub mi nus pas snying rje smos te de'ang gsum las 'dir dmigs med kyi snying rje yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar rnam par mi rtog bzhin du sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin la/ rgyun mi chad pa ni longs sku sngar bshad pa'i yon tan rnams dang ldan pa'i rgyun nyid du rab tu 'jug pas srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir rgyun mi chad pa nyid yin gyi/ skabs kha cig tu 'jug pa dang ldog pa'i mtshan nyid bar chad dang ldan pa ni ma yin no// 'gog pa med pa ni/ longs sku de dus re zhig bzhugs nas mi brtan pa ma yin gyi 'khor ba ji srid par rgyun mi chad par bzhugs te/ snying rjes gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i phyir dang*/ sems rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir ro// de ltar na yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i 'bras bu 'di nyid ni ngag dbang grags pa bdag 'dod cing der ma zad mkhas pa gzhan rnams kyang 'dod do// gal te sngags kyi 'bras bu yan lag bdun ldan nyid dbang bzhi par 'chad pa ci zhe na/ dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ de ltar sgra don ldan nyid phyir// yang gi sgra don ldan phyir dang*// de bzhin sgra don skyes nyid phyir// bzhi pa de bzhin nyid bdag 'dod// ces te gsang ba 'dus pa brtag pa gnyis pa dang*/ rgyud 'di nyid la sogs pa rgyud sde chen po rnams su/ dbang bzhi pa bstan pa// de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yang*// zhes gsum pa dper byas nas des mtshon te bzhi pa bstan pa'i tshig de la/ de ltar dang*/ de bzhin dang*/ yang zhes pa'i sgra gsum yod pas/ bzhi pa ni yan lag bdun ldan du grub ste/ de ltar zhes bya bas ni/ gsum pa'i dus su rang gi lha yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam par yod pa de bzhin du bzhi pa yang de lta bu'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin no// 'dis longs sku dang kha sbyor gnyis bzhi pa la yod par grub bo// yang zhes pas ni gsum pa la bde ba yod par ma zad bzhi pa la yang bde ba yod par snga ma las khyad par du gyur pa'i bde ba yod par grub bo// de yang gsum pa'i tshe las rgya'i rten las byung ba'i bde ba skad cig ma tsam dang*/

zag pa dang bcas pa dang*/ phyag rgya la 'khyud pa la sogs pa sdug bsngal bas gya nom pa ma yin pa dang*/ nor bu tsam la gnas kyi thams cad la ma khyab pa dang*/ dus yun thung ba yin la/ bzhi par ni rgya che ba dang*/ zag pa med pa dang*/ gya nom pa dang*/ rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ 'khor ba ji srid par gnas pa la sogs pas khyad par du 'phags so// de bzhin zhes pas ni dbang gsum pa la 'du shes gsum la mkhas pa'i las rgya dang*/ thabs la sogs pa tshogs pa las skyes pa de bzhin du/ bzhi pa yang thabs shes tshogs pa las skye'i gzhan ni ma yin par bstan to// yan lag lhag ma rnams ni bzhi pa la ldan tshul slob dpon gyis ma bshad kyang de bzhin pas bsten te/ 'grel par/ de lta bu'i shes rab thabs tshogs pa dang ldan pa gang yin pa las skyes pa de bsgrub par bya bar 'gyur ro// zhes pas shes te gsum pa'i skabs su bde ba'i rang bzhin stong par shes pa yod pa/ de bzhin du bzhi pa la yang dngos po thams cad gcig dang du ma la sogs pa'i rang bzhin stong zhing brdzun pa/ dri za'i grong khyer dang chu zla lta bur mkhyen pa'i rang bzhin med pa dang*/ gsum pa'i skabs su sems can sdug bsngal can rnams la snying rje'i sems skyes te de dag mchog gi go 'phang la dgod pa'i phyir dbang gsum pa nyams su len pa'i sems yod pa de bzhin du bzhi par yang sems can dang chos su rnam par mi rtog pa'i dmigs med kyi snying rje mthar thug pa smra ba dang*/ dbang gsum pa nyams su len pa'i tshe lha'i rnam pa rgyun ma chad par yod pa de bzhin du bzhi par yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang rtag tu rgyun mi chad par bzhugs pa dang*/ dbang gsum pa la bde ba nyams su myong ba'i bar la 'gog pa ste mya ngan las 'da' ba med pa de bzhin du bzhi par yang 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs pa yin no// de ltar na 'bras bu yan lag bdun dang ldan pa de bzhin du lam rnams kyang yan lag bdun cha mthun gyi tshul du yod pas zab mo'i dbang bzhi pa yang yan lag bdun ldan du ngo sprad dgos kyi/

stong pa kho na dang*/ bde ba 'ba' zhig dang*/ sems kyi gnas cha tsam la bzhi par ngo mi sprod ste/ grub thob la wa pas/ de nyid ma lus pa'i don phun sum tshogs par byed pa rtog pa'i rnyog pa dang bral ba nyid kyis bla na med par yang dag par rig pa dang*/ tha mi dad du thub pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'od zer 'phro ba'i bdag nyid yid bzhin gyi nor bu bstan pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi tshig sbyin par bya'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ de nyid grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dpal 'dzin gyis gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi dkyil chog gnyis su lung drangs pa dang*/ mkhas grub chen po a bha yā ka ras/ byang chub kyi sems rab tu bsgoms pas rab tu 'phel bzhin pa sgrib pa med pa nyid du gyur pa'i de kho na nyid chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin can dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo brjod par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// don de nyid rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal brtag pa gnyis par yang gsungs te/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po'i mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes yan lag bdun ldan du gsungs te/ ches phra zhes pa'i don rje btsun rtse mos/ yod pa dang med pa gnyis ka dang gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mtha' thams cad las grol la/ brjod par mi nus pa snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa/ gsal ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid do// de ni zab cing rtogs par dka' bas na phra ba'o// zhes bshad pa 'dis longs sku'i yan lag bstan te zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de nyid/ snang stong dang 'khor 'das la sogs pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir ro// rdo rje ces pa'i 'grel par mi phyed pas na rdo rje'o zhes pa 'dis kha sbyor gyi yan lag bstan te/

yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa dbyer mi phyed par gyur pa ste/ shān+ti pa dang nag po pa'i 'grel par yang rdo rje ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams so// zhes pa dang mthun no// snying po zhes pa'i 'grel par thams cad 'byung bas na snying po'o// zhes pa 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag bstan te mya ngan las 'da' ba med par chos thams cad de las byung ba'i tshul gyis 'khor ba ji srid par bzhugs pa'i phyir ro// nam mkha'i zhes pa'i 'grel par gang du yang ma grub pas nam mkha'o// zhes pas rgyun mi chad pa'i yan lag bstan te/ sam+bu ṭar/ rgyun mi chad par du ma zhig /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// mi rtog pas na rdul bral lo// zhes pas snying rjes yongs su gang ba'i yan lag bstan te/ sems can dang chos su rnam par mi rtog pa'i snying rje nyid dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje yin pa'i phyir ro// mya ngan las 'das pas na mthar ster ba'o// zhes pas bde ba chen po'i yan lag bstan te/ 'khor ba pa'i zag bcas kyi bde pa spangs te lhag med mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ slob dpon nag po pas/ mthar ster ba ni 'khor ba las shin tu 'das pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// rtog pa zhi bas na zhi ba'o zhes pas rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag bstan te// zhi ba chos kyi sku can phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na rdo rje'i tshig 'di dag yan lag bdun ldan du legs par grub pas/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes pa'i don yang 'jig rten na phas bu bskyed pa'i bya ba byed pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa khyod kyis kyang rig ma la brten nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes cung zad cig rgyud la skyes pa de'i rgyun bskyangs pas mthar sgrib pa thams cad zad pas dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa dbang bzhi pa nyid thob bo// zhes bya ba'i don yin no// zhes zhib tu ngo sprad cing*/

slob mas de dag gi don nyams su blangs pa las sku gsum gyi nyams skye'o// de'ang ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dbang bskur ba ste ye shes de mngon du byas pa ni de kho na nyid mthong ba nyid yin te khyad par med pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dbang bzhi pa'i man ngag gis bka'i gnang ba rnyed nas da ni dbang dang man ngag thob pa ste snyam pa'i rlom sems bskyed nas bag med par 'dug par bya ba ma yin gyi/ 'jig rten gsum gyi dgra bo nyon mongs pa dang de'i rgyu rnam rtog las rgyal te mtshan ma dang rnam rtog med par bya'o// snyam pa tsam pa'i go bgos pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i blo ste shes rab dang*/ sems can thams cad byang chub la 'god par 'dod pa'i byang chub kyi sems rab tu rgyas pa'i snying rje'i sgo nas sems can gzhan gyi don la 'dir ni chags par bya'o// de ltar gzhan don byed kyang de kho na nyid thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas ni sems can du zhen pa'i dri ma med par dpyod cing*/ thabs shes kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba la 'bad dgos so// zhes brjod la gdong g.yogs pa yod na bkrol te/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag lam mthar thug gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig tu dgongs te gsung pa bzhi bsrung ba la dbang*/ sa bcu gsum pa mngon du byas/ brda mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel rang bzhin gyi lhun grub mngon du byas so zhes brda sprod de dbang bzhi pa'o// bdun pa mjug gi bya ba la slob ma'i bya ba dang*/ slob dpon gyi bya ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de ltar dbang rdzogs par thob pas slob ma rnams dga' ba bskyed nas/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas// bdag gi 'tsho ba'ang 'bras bur bcas// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// da ni sangs rgyas rigs su 'gyur// bskal pa rgya mtsho 'jig chen por// mnar med skye ba yang dag 'khrugs// nyon mongs 'dam dpag brgal dka' las// bdag ni mgon po khyod kyis bsgral// khyod kyi zhal gyi bka' drin las// theg pa rdzogs pa lta bur bdag

/bag chags thams cad bral bas na// bdag la byang chub 'tshal ma mchis// zhes spro ba bskyed la/ ci 'byor pa'i yon phul te/ gtso bos ci ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes sdom pa rnams bsdus te khas blang*/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag nyid 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod la slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas te dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba la 'bad par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor dang bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod bya/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces pa yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas la lhag chad kha bskang zhing nyams pa rnams bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod de dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa dang bum pa'i lha'i ye shes pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas dam tshig pa bdag gi thugs kar bsdu/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ dang*/ oṃ ghi li ghi li hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pas rdul tshon dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang por bris pa de dang por gshegs su gsol/ de nas ci bde bar gshegs su gsol/ rdul tshon 'dod pa yod na lha'i mtshan ma nas blangs la sbyin/ gzhan rnams phyags la/ rdul tshon spyan drangs pa'i cho gas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi sar dris byugs la der maṇ+ḍal bris te/ gtor chog ltar phyogs skyong rnams gtor mas tshim par byas nas gshegs su gsol/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod la me tog gi char phab cing dga' ston la longs spyod par bya'o// rnam dag rgyud sde'i gling nas legs 'ongs shing*// yang dag bla ma brgyud pa las brgyud pa'i// ma dag dri ma'i tshogs kun 'joms byed pa// rnam dag dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga 'di// rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun shing rta'i srol// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i rjes 'brang zhing*// gzhan lugs mching bu'i chogs rnams rgyang bsrings nas// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar// rgyud 'grel che la zhib par dpyad pas na// 'di la nyes pa ma mchis mchis srid na// rje btsun mkhyen pa'i ye shes me 'od kyis// rmongs pa'i bud shing mtha' dag bsreg tu gsol// 'dir 'bad dge ba lha yi dbang po des// ma dag cho ga lha min dpung bcom nas// rnam dag cho ga'i ba dan rab 'phyar te// rim gnyis bdud rtsi'i zas kyis 'tsho bar shog

/dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang gi snye ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ blo gros dang don gnyer rmad du byung ba mdo stod pa kun dga' gzhon nu la sogs pa'i don gnyer slob ma mang pos zhus pa'i ngor/ rgyud kyi rgyal po'i dkyil chog ston pa'i gong 'og gi skabs rnams dang*/ de dag gi 'grel chen rje btsun rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang*/ bla ma gong ma'i dkyil chog gi tho yig rnams la gzhi byas nas/ bzang po yongs bzung dang rin chen 'bar ba gnyis las cung zad kha bskangs te/ cho ga ma tshang ba med tsam du mdor bsdus nas bris pa ste/ rgyas par na rgyud 'di ni bla med spyi'i bshad rgyud yin pas na/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog gdan bzhi/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rnams las kha bskang bar gsungs pa ltar rgyas par byas na shin tu legs pa nyid do// zhes pa 'di nyid kyang bdag dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyi tshul cung zad rig pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos/ dga' ba'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i nyer drug la mkhas pa'i chos grwa dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mdo stod pa kun dga' gzhon nus bgyis so// i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu// //
