༄// dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las snye ma bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin ye shes lnga yi me 'od kyis// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i bag chags ma lus sreg mdzad cing*// chos kun rtog med bde ba chen por ston mdzad pa// khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal// 'dod pa'i lha yis dngos grub myur stsol zhing*// zhi rgyas dbang sogs thun mong dngos grub rnams// 'bad med bde blag nyid du 'grub byed pa'i// sbyin sreg cho ga phrin las snye ma bshad// 'dir bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gsang sngags kyi 'bras bu dbyung ba'am/ dkyil 'khor dang rab gnas la sogs pa'i don gyi phyir ram/ phrin las bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga nyams su len par 'dod na/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum gyi dang po la/ thab dang*/ phyogs dang*/ dus dang*/ bud shing dang*/ me dang*/ mchod rdzas dang*/ sgrub pa po dang bdun gyi dang po ni/ sngar gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel par sa'i cho ga byas pa yin na 'dir mi dgos la/ sngar ma byas nas sbyang ba'i phyir rang rdo rje sems dpa' gtso bo rkyang pa'i rnal 'byor du byas la/ lus dur khrod kyi chas kyi brgyan pas sbyin sreg gi sa'i dbus su 'dug la/ lag pa byin gyis brlab pa nas brtsams te bka' bsgo ba'i bar dkyil chog ltar bya zhing*/ 'on kyang dkyil 'khor rgyal po rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba'i tshab tu sbyin sreg gi las rtsom zhes bya ba gzhug go /de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis thab khung gi sa la bskor zhing*/ shar du g.yas brkyang*/ lhor g.yon brkyang*/

nub tu sa ga byang du zlum po rnams byas nas/ thab khung gi gzhi'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal dang*/ dri'i thig le dang mchod gtor bshams la/ tshom bu sa'i lha mor bskyed/ sa 'og nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa nas thim par bsam pa'i bar dkyil chog ltar byas la/ spyan drangs pa la/ dkyil 'khor las ni legs grub mdzod// ces pa sbyin sreg las ni legs grub mdzod// ces par bsgyur/ mkhyen gsol la/ rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// rgyal bar byas te sbyin sreg brtsams// zhes par bsgyur ro// de nas thab khung bur byed na/ rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su khru phyed brkos pa'i nang dkar po bya/ de nas phyir sor bzhi bskyed pa la bzhi bya ste de la pad+ma'i ge sar ser po bya/ de nas dpangs su sor bzhi brtsig pa ni kha khyer te/ de la pad+ma dmar po bya/ de'i steng yang sor bzhi pa ste/ de la rdo rje'i phreng ba sngon por bya/ de'i phyi rol gru bzhi dkar po byas la/ grwa bzhir rdo rjes mtshan par bya/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad byas pa'i dbus su/ rdo rje sngon po zhing du sor bzhi pa/ chur sor brgyad pa/ shar du 'khor lo dkar po/ lhor rin po che ser po/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po/ byang du ral gri ljang gu rnams bya/ bri thab byed na dbus nas khru gang gi tshad kyis zlum por bskor/ de nas sor bzhi bskor ba gzhi dang*/ yang sor bzhir bskor ba kha khyer dang*/ yang sor bzhi bskor ba rdo rje'i phreng ba rnams bya zhing lhag ma sngar dang 'dra'o// sbyin sreg zhi rgyas sogs gang byed kyang thab 'di kho nas chog pa'i phyir las thams cad pa'i thab ces bya'o// yang las so so'i thab byed na/ zhi ba la dkar po/ dbyibs dang rgya dpangs ni 'dra la/ sngar gyi gzhi kha khyer mu ran te/ de gnyis la 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor/ pad+ma'i dbus su 'khor lo/ rgyas pa la gru bzhi ser po rgyar khru do// dpangs su khru gang pa/

kha khyer dang mu ran sor brgyad pa rin po ches bskor ba/ pad+ma'i dbus su rin po che'o// dbang la zla gam dmar po rgya dpangs zhi ba bzhin la/ kha khyer dang mu ran la pad+mas bskor ba/ dbus su pad+ma'o// drag po la gru gsum nag po/ rgyar sor nyi shu/ dpangs su sor bcu/ kha khyer dang mu ran sor gsum pa la rdo rje gdengs pas bskor ba/ dbus su rdo rje'o// las bzhi ka'i thab kyi dbus su phyag mtshan gang bkod pa'i tshab tu rdo rje bri'o// gnyis pa ni dkyil 'khor dang 'brel pa'i dbang du byas na/ zhi ba la shar/ rgyas pa la lho'o// dbang la nub/ drag po la byang du thab bya ste/ rang dkyil 'khor la phyogs par byas pa na/ de dang de'i phyogs su blta zhing*/ drag po la lhor blta ba ni/ dkyil 'khor la rgyab kyis mi phyogs par bya ba'i phyir ro// spyir ni las 'jam po gsum la kha blta phyogs la nges pa med la/ drag po la lhor blta ba ni nges pa'o// dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba rnams la ni/ kha blta phyogs nyid phyogs yin no// gsum pa ni/ zhi ba la dgongs mo/ rgyas pa la snga dro/ dbang la mtshan phyed/ drag po la nyi ma phyed na'o// bzhi pa ni/ zhi ba la mchog sbyin gyi shing gi lcug ma rtse mo'i cha ma nyams shing lo ma dang ldan pa sor bcu gnyis pa/ rgyas pa la sor bcu bzhi/ dbang la sor bcu dang*/ drag po la sor brgyad pa la sogs pa'i bud shing dang*/ de dag ma 'byor na dgon pa'i ba glang gi lci ba srog chags med pas thab khung las cung zad dma' bar brtsig go /lnga pa ni/ las 'jam po gsum la/ gtsub pa las byung ba'i me dang*/ drag po la gdol pa'i khyim mam/ dur khrod nas byung ba'i mes bya'o// drug pa ni/ las 'jam po gsum la/ rang gi g.yas thab khung gi g.yon nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ yam shing dang*/ mar dang*/ til dang*/ 'bras dang*/ zho dang*/ phye mar sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ 'bras so ba dang*/

nas dang*/ sran ma dang*/ gro dang dūr ba dang*/ ku sha rnams bsham/ rang gi g.yon thab khung gis g.yas nas chu bzhi dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ yungs kar te nye reg gi yo byad dang*/ gtor ma gnyis rnams bsham/ las drag po la de las bzlog par bsham mo// rang gi mdun du bzed zhal dang*/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang blugs gzar kha sbyar ba dang*/ nang mchod kyang bzhag go /bdun pa ni/ de nas rnal 'byor pas zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po'i rgyan dang gos gyon no// zhi ba la zhi zhing dul ba'i yid dang*/ rgyas pa la tshim pas mngon par spel ba'i yid dang*/ dbang la chags shing 'dun pa'i yid dang*/ drag po la 'jig rten gsum za ba'i sems kyis so// zhi ba la tsog pu/ rgyas pa la rgyal po rol pa'i stabs/ dbang la pad+ma'i skyil krung*/ drag po la rkang pa g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan pa'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bya ba/ thab dang yo byad bsang zhing sbyang ba/ thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa/ slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ gshegs su gsol ba'i cho ga dang bdun gyi dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na/ zhi ba la spyan ma/ rgyas pa la gos dkar mo// dbang la sgrol ma/ drag po la mā ma kī gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag bskyed bsgom zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar du bya/ 'brel na phyi rol pa'i gtor ma btang nas lhag chad kha bskang tshar ba dang sbyin sreg la 'jug par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ bsang chu nas ku sha'i chun pos blangs nas bsreg rdzas la gtor/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od 'phros nas rdzas rnams la phog pas/ rdzas rnams kyi skyon thams cad dag nas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las sgrub pa'i nus pa ldan par bsams la/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo gnyis gshibs la brkyang ste/ oṃ shrī swā hās mar dang*/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hās 'bru dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas gzhan rnams dang*/ ā+oṃ āḥswā hās yam shing sbyang ba'i sngags te de dag brjod do// yang mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la'i nang du mchod rdzas so sor bskyed la/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ kham̐ sogs kyis sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ yang bsang chu dang a mṛ tas thab dang yo byad thams cad bsangs nas/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur du byas nas des yungs kar bzung la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye/ badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing g.yas kyi g.yas dang*/ g.yon gyi g.yon nas bskor zhing mer dor/ yang khu tshur du chu blugs la/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ ces pas sngar bzhin bskor nas mer dor te nye reg go /gsum pa ni/ de nas hūm̐ las las so so'i thab bris pa bzhin bskyed pa'am/ yang na las thams cad pa'i thab khung rgyar khru gang pa/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ gzhi la pad+ma ge sar ser po/ kha khyer la pad+ma dmar po/ de'i steng rdo rje'i phreng ba sngon pos bskor zhing*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mdzes par byas par bsam mo// bzhi pa ni/ de'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ me lha zhal bzhi pa/ las dang mthun pa'i sku mdog dang zhal can/ phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa'am/ yang na sku mdog dmar po la rtsa zhal las dang mthun pa'am/ yang na sku mdog dang zhal thams cad dmar po me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas shing*/

las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ ag tshom 'phyang zhing gsus khyim che ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba bskyed la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ mar gyi sreg blugs gsum 'bul/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad rtse mo shar du bstan nas dgram zhing*/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /'dis bdag cag la bgegs med cing*// las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes brjod cing tsan+dan la sogs pa'i shing la me sbar nas thab la las 'jam po gsum la g.yas skor dang*/ drag po la g.yon du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ rang rang gi gtso bo'i sngags kyi rjes la/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod pas thab nang du bcug la/ rlung g.yab kyis dal por bus nas/ gzar bu chung bas mar blugs pas me gsos nas hūm̐ dang bsang chus gtor ro// de nas me'i dbus su sngar gyi me lha dran par byas nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can tshim mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// zhes dang*/ lag pa g.yas skyabs sbyin las mthe bong srin lag gi rtsa bar bzhag gung mo'i rgyab nas mdzub mos bkab ste de rna drung du g.yob cing*/ oṃ e h+ye hi ma hā bhū ta de wa ṛ ṣi dwi dza/

satwa ā hūm̐ ti āṃ ha ra a smin san+ni hi to bha bzhes pas spyan drangs la mchod pas mchod nas/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar ba brkyang ste/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung so sor brkyang bas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan nas/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wā la ya sarba bha smin ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas phrin las bcol/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa la bstim/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya ho/ zhes pas dam tshig byin nas/ me lha'i snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa/ dpral bar pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dkar po la oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad zla la gnas pa'i pad+ma dmar po la āḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ de dag las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs nas dbang bskur bas/ zhi ba la rnam snang*/ rgyas pa la rin 'byung*/ dbang la 'od dpag med/ drag po la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ de nas me lha'i lce dang dgang blugs kyi kha la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse gsum pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsgoms la/ lag pa g.yas pas blugs gzar dang*/ g.yon pas dgang gzar bzung nas pus mo gnyis kyi bar du gru mo chud par byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dgang blugs kyi mar blangs nas dgang gzar gang bar bkang la/ oṃ ag+na ye ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod la dgang blugs kha sbyar nas mer dbul te/ de lta bu lan gsum byas la me pra brtags te/ rgyud las/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ bum pa dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ lcags kyu'i dbyibs dang*/ rtse gcig pa dang*/ rtse gnyis pa dang*/ rtse gsum pa dang*/ mchog dang*/ 'bring dang*/ tha ma dang*/ khyad par du g.yas su 'khyil pa 'bar ba'i kha dog dkar po dang*/ bzang po 'khyil pa mkhas pas brtag par bya ba dang*/ brgya byin gyi gzhu lta bur gtsang ba dang*/

snum pa dang*/ ku suṃ bha dang*/ bai ḍūr+ya lta bu dang*/ dri zhim pa dang*/ yid du 'ong ba dang*/ gser dang*/ dngul lta bu dang*/ du ba med pa dang*/ nyi ma lta bur 'bar ba dang*/ dri ma med pa dang*/ zhi ba la kha dog dkar po dang*/ rgyas pa la ni ser po lta bu dang*/ rjes su chags pa la ni dmar po mchog dang*/ mngon spyod la sngon po dang*/ nag po dang*/ me lce mang ba dang*/ du ba dang*/ me stag yang dag par langs pa dang*/ chung ngu chung ngur chad pa dang*/ myur ba gzi brjid chung ba dang*/ nag po dang bcas pa dang*/ pa la sha'i mdog dang*/ rtse gsum dang*/ nyi ma lta bu nyid dang*/ de bzhin du ba glang gi mgo lta bu nyid dang*/ ro'i dri dang*/ nya'i dri dang*/ bong bu dang*/ khyi dang*/ rnga mo ni/ bgegs dang bgegs med pa'i 'bar ba'i mtshan mar byas pa yin zhes gsungs pa ltar brtag go /ngan na bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags dang*/ dri'i chus gtor bas zhi bar bya'o// de nas bsreg rdzas rnams dbul te/ dang po yam shing blangs nas/ de byang chub kyi shing du mos nas/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ zhes sam/ u dum+bā rar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra yadz+nyā ya swā hā// zhes sam/ pa la shar mos nas/ oṃ badz+ra la thā ya swā hā zhes sam/ n+ya gro dhar mos te/ oṃ badz+ra ku be ra ye swā hā/ zhes sam/ a mṛ tar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṭa ka rā ya swā hā// zhes pas dbul/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ sogs nye reg gi skabs su bstan pa'i sngags kyis til nag dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras dang*/ oṃ sarba sam̐ pa de swā hā/ zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ gro dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūr ba dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hā/ ku sha ste/ sngags rnams kyi mjug tu zhi ba'i swā hā'i dod la/

rgyas pa la bau ṣa ṭa/ dbang la dzaḥhri/ drag po la hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes btags nas lan bdun bdun nam/ nyer gcig re dbul ba'i rjes su/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhes sam/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi/ zhi ba la/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa nad gdon dang bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs shīn+taṃ ku ra swā hā/ rgyas pa la tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang legs pa'i yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ rgyal po dang paṇ+ḍi ta dang blon po la sogs pa mi dang mi ma yin pa'i skye 'gro rnams dang zas nor longs spyod thams cad ba shaṃ ku ru dzaḥhri/ drag po la/ rdo rje slob dpon la tho 'tsham zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi la gnod pa'i dam nyams sdig can thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sbyar/ de ltar thun mong gi bsreg rdzas rnams phul nas/ las so so'i bsreg rdzas zhi ba la oṃ pad+ma rak+ṣi ak+ṣe na ma pri na ya a mu ka s+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar dang lhan cig pad+ma'o// oṃ gha gha gha ta ya te dzo rā dza sri na ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'o ma dang lhan cig ut+pa la'o// oṃ su su me ku li be le dza le ni shīṃn+ta ku ru swā hā/ gur gum dang lhan cig ku mu ti'o// oṃ dharme dharmā rā dze da hā da hā sarba bigh+nān shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ tsan+dan dang lhan cig pa'i ha lo'i'o// oṃ ki li su ki li ka la ra ti sarba pā paṃ da dh+ya a mu s+ya shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ til mar dang lhan cig ka ra bī ra'o// rgyas pa la bil ba la sogs pa rdzas lnga dang*/ oṃ ga ga ni ga ga ni lo ki ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ te dzo ra puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dbang la a shwa ka la sogs pa/ oṃ a shwa ki ṇi pu re ge a nu ra ga ya trai lokya ba shaṃ na maḥhri swā hā/ zhes dang*/ drag po la sha lnga la sogs pa/ oṃ ma ra ma ra kī la ya kī la ya sarba sha trūṃ nā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsngags nas dbul te/

de'ang bsreg rdzas rgyas par 'byor na/ zhi ba la 'bras sā lu/ so ba/ til dkar po/ nas/ 'bras/ dūr ba/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi rnams dang lha'i bdud rtsi lnga lhan cig tu bsres pa dang*/ yam shing 'o ma can gyi shing lnga las skyes pa'i rlon zhing yal ga dang bcas pa'i rtse mor sbrang rtsi dang 'o ma dang mar gyis byugs pa dang*/ rgyas pa la til nag po/ mon sran bra'u/ sā lu dmar po// mngar gsum/ zho/ zas mchog sbrang rtsi mar dang ldan pa/ me tog brgya pa/ bil ba'i 'bras bu/ pad+ma/ nas la sogs pa'i 'bru rnams dang*/ yam shing u dum+bā ra sbom du sor bzhi pa srid du khru gang pa'i rtse mor 'o ma dang mar gyis byugs pa dang*/ dbang la til mar/ til nag pri yaṅku/ nā ga ge sar/ tsam+pa ka a shwa ka ba ku la/ ba ṇa/ me tog brgya pa rnams dri dang mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba dang*/ yam shing lha'i shing*/ pa ṭa/ daṃ si sa li/ u dum+bā ra/ sha la ki ku ku la yi shing*/ seng ldeng rnams dri bzang pos byugs pa sor brgyad pa dang*/ drag po la til nag mon sran bra'u/ bha la ta ka'i 'bras bu/ sran ma nag po/ skyes pa'i rus pa/ dri chen/ bong bu'i sbangs/ bong bu'i spu dang*/ khyi'i rtug pa dang*/ spu dang*/ sen mo dang bcas pa 'bru mar gyis byugs pa dang*/ yam shing nag po 'khyog po las skyes pa'i tsher ma dang*/ tsha ba dang kha ba la sogs pa las skyes pa'i shing sor bcu pa khrag gis byugs pa ste/ 'di dag ma 'byor na las dang mthun pa'i rdzas la/ de dag tu mos nas grangs tshang bar dbul lo// de'ang zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni gzar bus blangs nas zhal du phul bar bsam/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas snod bzung ste/ g.yas pas blangs nas 'og nas bskor zhing steng nas dbul ba'i tshul gyis phyag tu phul/ dūr ba dang ku sha yang de bzhin du byas nas gtsug tor du phul/ yam shing ni 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du'o// de dag kyang las dang mthun pa'i khu tshur gyis dbul te/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ zhi ba byang chub mchog gis bzung*// rgyas la rin chen khu tshur gyis// dbang dang dgug pa dag la yang*// pad+ma'i khu tshur gyis ni bzung*// de bzhin khro bo'i khu tshur gyis// nan tan du ni gzhug la bya// zhes pas so// de nas chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces sam/ gzhan yang*/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs// rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi bcud ldan gun+dhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de la bstod cing phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod nas// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra sarba pa paṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ bsang gtor dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyis mchod yon phul la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par bsam par bya'o// lnga pa ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang ma 'brel na/ bsang chu dang*/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ thab kyi dbus su cho ga gsum las/ las kyi khyad par gyis gtso bo 'pho zhing sku mdog gam/ 'od zer ram/ rtsa zhal 'gyur ba'i lha so bdun rdzogs par bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ phyi nang yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod/ dgug gzhug bya/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/

dbang bskur rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab bo// sgrub mchod dang 'brel na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nas las kyi khyad par gyi gtso bo dang*/ sku mdog gam/ 'od zer 'phros pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ rab gnas kyi rten la 'bul na/ rten de nyid thab kyi nang du spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ sbos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyen skur ston pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka badz+ra satwa sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes me tog gis mtshon nas spyan drangs la/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang sgeg sogs brgyad dang*/ nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod/ bstod pas bstod nas/ lha rnams kyis zhal cung zad phye bar bsams la/ gtso bo gang yin gyi snying pos mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyi mar bcus nas dgang gzar bkang la/ oṃ ag+na ye ma hā shri sogs brjod de gzar bu kha sbyar nas thab kyi dbus su lan gsum phul nas/ bsreg rdzas rnams lha rang rang gi snying po sngon du 'gro bas sngar gyi rim pa ltar zhi ba la brgya/ rgyas pa la brgya rtsa brgyad/ dbang la lnga bcu/ drag po la drug cu la sogs pa gang 'byor phul nas/ bdun tsam re'i mjug tu spel tshig sbyar zhing*/ mar blugs pas me gso/ de ltar bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ dri me yid du 'ong ba yi// la sogs pa'i chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa nas bstod pa'i bar mchod phreng ltar rgyas par byas nas/ dku bag can gyi gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ thab nang gi lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/

rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka badz+ra satwa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza sogs kyis dbul nas/ phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod/ rigs lnga'i bstod pa bya/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ bdag cag la las che ge mo zhes bya ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes pas dngos grub blang*/ rdo rje'i glu dang*/ smon lam bya/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol nas/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du gshegs su gsol/ drug pa ni/ de nas thab kyi dbus su 'jig rten pa'i me lha skad cig gis bsams la/ bsang gtor dang*/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas/ bsreg rdzas rnams bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar 'byor pa dang*/ mthar mar dgang blugs gsum phul nas mchod bstod bya/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs kyis dbul/ phyi mchod dang*/ sngar gyi bstod pa rnams bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis phrin las gzhol/ bsang gtor dang mchod yon phul te/ lhag chad kha bskang bar bya'o// bdun pa ni/ de nas spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo phyir bskyed la/ oṃ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyi bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu bar bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ zhi ba la 'o ma/ rgyas pa la gur gum gyi chu/ dbang la tsan+dan dmar po'i chu/

drag po la dug chu la sogs pa la sangs rgyas spyan gyi sngags bzlas pas me zhi bar byas nas/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu zhing 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pas rgyas gdab par bya'o// rgyud las ci skad bshad pa'i phan yon rnams thob par 'gyur te/ lha yi kha ni me ru gsung*// sbyin sreg de nyid rnam par gnas// sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim// tshim nas dngos grub rab tu stsol// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad kun// sbyin sreg gis ni de dag dgang*// sku gsum mchog gi rtse las skyes// de phyir sbyin sreg rab tu bsngags// zhes gsungs te phyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'o// de bzhin du rjes su chags pa'i ye shes kyi me kun nas 'bar ba dang*/ zhes pa'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyong ba'i thab khung du/ rdo rje'i blugs gzar kyis byang chub kyi sems kyis bsreg rdzas blugs par byed pa bde ba chen po'i sbyin sreg dang*/ dri ma med cing rab tu gsal ba'i ye shes kyi me rnam par 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i sprul pa la sogs pa'i 'khor lo rnams kyi thab khung du/ rā sa na dang*/ lwa la na'i blugs gzar dang*/ dgang gzar dag gis khams yongs su sbyangs pa'i bsreg rdzas blugs par byed pa bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/ gtum mo'i me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i lus kyi thab kyi kha'i hoṃ khung du/ lag pa gnyis kyi dgang gzar dang blugs gzar dag gis/ bza' ba dang btung ba'i bsreg rdzas blugs par byed pa nang gi sbyin sreg ste/ de ltar nang gi sbyin sreg tshul gsum mo/ /de bzhin du rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me kun nas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi thab khung du/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi dgang gzar dang blugs gzar dag gis/ khams gsum pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa ma lus pa'i sreg blugs sreg pa bla na med pa'i sbyin sreg go

/de ltar na sbyin sreg phyi nang rnams kyi rtogs pa skyed par byed pa ni/ sbyin sreg phyi ma rnams yin pas so// las dang po pas thog mar phyi'i sbyin sreg la 'bad par bya'o// rgyud 'grel mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs ji bzhin sbyin sreg cho ga 'di sbyar bas// rnam par mi rtog 'bar ba dang bcas chos kyi dbyings kyi thab khung du// zhi gnas lhag mthong dgang blugs dag gis khams gsum sems can ma lus pa'i// sems dang sems byung rnam par rtog pa'i bud shing mtha' dag bsreg gyur cig /dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa 'di ni/ rgyud sde 'dzin pa kun dga' gzhon nu la sogs pas bskul ba'i ngor/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos/ bzang po yongs bzung gi sbyin sreg gi le'u rtsa 'grel la gzhi byas/ rgyud 'grel gyi cho ga gal che ba rnams bsnan cing*/ las sna tshogs pa'i sbyin sreg la sogs pa rnams gtang snyoms su bzhag nas/ shin tu nyung zhing lag len bde bar dga' ba'i lo ma chu'i zla ba'i tshes gcig la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mdo stod pa kun dga' gzhun nu'o// i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+t+wa// // ༄// dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dge legs snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dge legs snye ma zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// brtan g.yo kun khyab stong nyid chos kyi dbyings// dmigs med snying rje'i ros gang bde ba che// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dpal ldan rdor sems kyi// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyon mongs gnas gyur phung po rnam dag cing*// ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das// rnam snang la sogs phyogs kyi rgyal ba bzhi'i// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir bde legs shog

/sa chu me rlung 'byung bzhi rnam dag cing*// byams sogs tshad med bzhi yi ngo bo nyid// spyan ma la sogs rigs kyi yum bzhi yi// bkra shis des ni= /so so yang dag rigs bzhi rnam dag cing*// zag med bde ba chen po'i mdzod 'dzin pa// rdo rje drag mo la sogs phyogs ma bzhi'i// bkra shis des ni= /sbyin dang snyan smra don spyod la sogs pa// bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yi ngo bo nyid// rdo rje gnod sbyin la sogs mtshams ma bzhi'i// bkra shis des ni= /mig sogs nang gi skye mched rnam dag cing*// tshigs dang nyon mongs can yid rnam sbyong ba// byams pa la sogs byang sems brgyad po yi// bkra shis des ni= /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson bsam gtan dang*// shes rab thabs dang smon lam rnam dag pa'i// gling bu ma sogs lha mo brgyad rnams kyi// bkra shis des ni= /phung po la sogs bdud bzhi rnams 'joms shing*// dad brtson dran dang ting 'dzin rnam dag pa// lcags kyu ma sogs sgo srung chen mo bzhi'i// bkra shis des ni= /ma dag phung khams skye mched rnam sbyong zhing*// byang chub phyogs chos so bdun ngo bo nyid// bde gshegs bzhugs gnas gzhal med khang chen gyi// bkra shis des ni= /bstod smad la sogs chos brgyad rnam dag cing*// chos kun gdod nas stong par rtogs byed pa// sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad rang bzhin dur khrod kyi// bkra shis des ni= /bgegs dang bar chad mi mthun phyogs 'joms shing*// lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid// rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur la sogs pa'i// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dge legs snye ma zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal sa skya'i chos grwar sbyar ba'o// i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba sa twa hi to bha wan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/
slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
